function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	--배틀존 분할
	self.random_interval_count_x = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.x / self.shot_interval_range - 2)
	self.random_interval_count_z = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.z / self.shot_interval_range - 2)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:set_monster_list(monster_list, gauge_monster_list)
	self.summon_monster_list = monster_list
	self.summon_gauge_monster_list = gauge_monster_list
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		for _,v in pairs(self.summon_monster_list) do
			if not v.monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				self:kill_monster(v.monster)
			end
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.summon_gauge_monster_list) do
			if not v.monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				self:kill_monster(v.monster)
			end
		end
	end

	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Destroyer, self.character) then
		--게이지 구슬 생성
		local is_gauge_monster, monster_id = self:is_gauge_monster(e.FieldObject)
		if is_gauge_monster then
			local bead_count
			for _,v in pairs(self.bead_count_monster_id_list) do
				if monster_id == v then
					bead_count = self.create_bead_count_list[_]
				end
			end
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
					{ 'expedition_bead_drop_request', e.OldPosition.x, e.OldPosition.y,
					  e.OldPosition.z, bead_count, 1002 }))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_gauge_monster(fo)
	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.summon_gauge_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, fo) then
			return true, v.id
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:check_monster_list(fo)
	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.summon_gauge_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, fo) then
			return true
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.summon_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, fo) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

--	self:create_monsters()

	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.total_shot_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.is_attack_range_start = false
	self.random_pos_index_list = {}
	self.shot_info_list = {}
	self.current_summon_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_total_count = 0
	self.is_hit_cocoon = false
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:hide_attack_range()

	for _,v in pairs(self.poison_egg_attack_range_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			if self.is_use_riskmap then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v.attack_range))
			end
			v.attack_range:Hide()
			v.is_active = false
		end
	end

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end

				if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
					v.trail_effect:Dispose()
					v.trail_effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self.shot_info_list = nil
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.shot_prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.is_start_knockback = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self:init_random_index()
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("each_shot")
		self:shoot_poison()
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shot_count = 0
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot_repeat_dealy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot_repeat_dealy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if not self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack_range", self.target_position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration + self.attack_range_delay)

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:init_random_index()
	--몬스터 인덱스 랜덤 관리리end
	if self.summon_monster_list then
		local index_list = {}
		local total_count = #self.summon_monster_list
		for i = 1, total_count do
			table.insert(index_list, i)
		end

		self.random_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = total_count})
	end

	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list then
		local gauge_index_list = {}
		local gauge_total_count = #self.summon_gauge_monster_list
		for i = 1, gauge_total_count do
			table.insert(gauge_index_list, i)
		end

		self.random_gauge_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(gauge_index_list, {count = gauge_total_count})
	end

	local poison_shot_index_list = {}
	local poison_total_count = self.marker_count
	for i = 1, poison_total_count do
		table.insert(poison_shot_index_list, i)
	end

	self.random_pos_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(poison_shot_index_list, {count = poison_total_count})

end

function local_class:shoot_poison()
	--
	local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.poison_shot_offset
	local dir = (self.target.Position - start_pos).normalized
	local target_pos = start_pos + dir * 10
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("poison", start_pos)
	local trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("poison_trail", start_pos)
	trail_effect.transform:SetParent(effect.transform)
	self.total_shot_count = self.total_shot_count + 1

	local shot_info = {
		index = self.total_shot_count,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		current_pos = start_pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		progress_time = 0,
		effect = effect,
		trail_effect = trail_effect,
		is_active = true,
		state = self.shot_state.shoot
	}

	table.insert(self.shot_info_list, shot_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:check_target()

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_shot(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration then
			--발사 카운트가 지정카운트가 안됐으면 다시 shot_prepare로 이동
			if self.current_shot_count < self.shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_repeat_dealy)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_repeat_interval then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
			elseif not self.is_use_jump_state then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, true)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration - self.attack_range_delay and not self.is_attack_range_start then
				self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)
				self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)

				self.is_attack_range_start = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		--메뉴얼 캐릭 우선 선택
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) and
						battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--없다면 일반 캐릭
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		--알 오브젝트를 맞췄다면...
		if string.find(fo.Name, 'cocoon') and not self.is_hit_cocoon then
			local object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off')
			if object.gameObject.activeSelf then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							--이벤트 이름
							'hit_cocoon',
							--fo 이름
							fo.Name,
						}))
				self.is_hit_cocoon = true
			end
		end

		--fo name체크해서 소환 몬스터면 죽인다.
		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			self:kill_monster(fo)
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_shot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			if v.state == self.shot_state.shoot then
				--구슬 상승 상태

				local h = math.sin(math.pi * v.progress_time) * self.shot_up_height
				local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, v.progress_time)
						+ unity_class.vector3.up * h
				v.effect.transform.position = pos
				v.current_pos = pos
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				if pos.y >= self.shot_up_height - 2 then
					v.state = self.shot_state.waiting
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.waiting then
				if v.progress_time >= self.shot_drop_wait_duration then
					v.state = self.shot_state.drop
					--사이클 첫번째 구슬이 드랍스테이트로 간다면 한사이클의 타겟포지션을 모두 구한다.(겹치지 않도록)
					v.start_pos = v.current_pos
					v.target_pos = self.marker_list[self.random_pos_index_list[v.index]].position
					v.progress_time = 0
					v.diff = v.target_pos - v.current_pos
					v.dist = v.diff.magnitude
					v.move_duration = 0.5

					battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range, v.target_pos)
					self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range:Show(v.move_duration - 0.02)

					if self.is_use_riskmap then
						message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character,
							self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range))
					end
					self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].is_active = true
				else
					v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.drop then
				--구슬 다운 상태
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				if v.progress_time <= v.move_duration then
					--타겟 포지션으로 낙하
					local move_pos = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.move_duration * v.diff
					v.effect.transform.position = move_pos
					v.current_pos = move_pos
				else
					--낙하 완료 후 폭파 데미지 준 뒤 & 포이즌에그 몬스터 생성
					v.effect.transform.position = v.target_pos
					v.is_active = false
					v.state = self.shot_state.none

					self:shot_explosion_damage(v.target_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_explosion", v.target_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.target_pos)
					if v.effect ~= nil then
						v.effect:Dispose()
						v.effect = nil
					end

					if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
						v.trail_effect:Dispose()
						v.trail_effect = nil
					end

					if self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range ~= nil then
						if self.is_use_riskmap then
							CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
								self.character, self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range))
						end

						self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range:Hide()
						self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].is_active = false
					end

					--게이지 몬스터를 먼저 소환하고 이후는 랜덤으로
					if self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count < self.gauge_monster_count then
						self:summon_gauge_monster(v.target_pos)
					else
						local count = self.current_summon_total_count % self.gauge_monster_summon_interval
						if count == 0 then
							self:summon_gauge_monster(v.target_pos)
						else
							self:summon_normal_monster(v.target_pos)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:summon_gauge_monster(target_pos)
	if not self.summon_gauge_monster_list then
		return
	end

	self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count = self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count + 1
	local index = self.random_gauge_index_list[self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count]
	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list[index].monster ~= nil then
		self:summon_monster(self.summon_gauge_monster_list[index].monster, target_pos, self.target)
		self.current_summon_total_count = self.current_summon_total_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:summon_normal_monster(target_pos)
	if not self.summon_monster_list then
		return
	end

	self.current_summon_monster_count = self.current_summon_monster_count + 1
	local index = self.random_index_list[self.current_summon_monster_count]
	if self.summon_monster_list[index].monster ~= nil then
		self:summon_monster(self.summon_monster_list[index].monster, target_pos, self.target)
		self.current_summon_total_count = self.current_summon_total_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:summon_monster(monster, pos, target)
	monster.Position = pos
	monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = monster
	heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
	thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
	monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
			monster, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
end

function local_class:shot_explosion_damage(dest_pos)
	--폭발 데미지 체크
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(dest_pos, self.shot_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:get_target_pos_list(target_pos, idx)
	local info_list = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local pos = self:get_random_position(target_pos, (idx + i) - 1)
		table.insert(info_list, pos)
	end

	return info_list
end

function local_class:get_random_position(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index - 1
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / (self.shot_count - 1)
	local range = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 20, shot_area_angle * index)
	local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(1, 3)

	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, range, 0)
			* unity_class.vector3.right * random_range

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bound.min.x then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bound.max.x then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bound.min.z then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bound.max.z then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	return random_pos
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shot_info_list = nil
	self.target_pos_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.poison_egg_attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shot_state = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.random_index_list = nil
	self.random_gauge_index_list = nil
	self.summon_monster_list = nil
	self.summon_gauge_monster_list = nil
	self.marker_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

	--게이지 구슬 소환 갯수 몬스터 인덱스
	self.bead_count_monster_id_list = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(params, 'BeadCountMonsterIds')

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shot_prepare = 3,
		shot = 4,
		shot_repeat_dealy = 5,
		jump_prepare = 6,
		jump = 7,
		dangling = 8,
		fall = 9,
		stomp = 10,
		post = 11
	}

	self.shot_state = {
		none = 1,
		shoot = 2, --올라가는 상태
		waiting = 3, --올라가서 대기 상태
		drop = 4, --타겟에게 떨어지는 상태
		damage = 5, --바닥에 떨어져서 데미지를 입히고 몬스터로 교환
		cast = 6, --케스팅 상태
		explosion = 7
	}

	local poison_egg_count = self.shot_count * self.shot_repeat_count
	self.poison_egg_attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, poison_egg_count do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.shot_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.poison_egg_attack_range_list,{
				attack_range = range,
				is_active = false
		})
	end

	self.jump_pos_offset = 3
	self.shot_info_list = {}
	self.target_pos_list = {}
	self.target = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.total_shot_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.is_stomp_ani_start = false
	self.target_position = nil
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	self.random_pos_index_list = nil
	self.is_left_dir = false
	self.is_attack_range_start = false
	self.is_monster_loaded = false
	self.current_summon_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_total_count = 0
	self.random_index_list = nil
	self.random_gauge_index_list = nil
	self.summon_monster_list = nil
	self.summon_gauge_monster_list = nil
	self.marker_list = nil
	self.is_hit_cocoon = false

	self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent),
			self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)

	self.on_party_switching_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_party_switching_event(e) end
	--- 파티 스위칭 이벤트 구독
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

	self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent),
			self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	if self.summon_monster_list ~= nil then
		self.summon_monster_list = nil
	end
	self.summon_monster_list = {}

	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list ~= nil then
		self.summon_gauge_monster_list = nil
	end
	self.summon_gauge_monster_list = {}

	local monsters = character_manager:GetAllMonsters()

	for _,v in pairs(monsters) do
		if string.find(v.Name, self.monster_name) then
			v.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			table.insert(self.summon_monster_list, {monster = v})
		end

		if string.find(v.Name, self.gauge_monster_name) then
			v.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
			table.insert(self.summon_gauge_monster_list, {monster = v})
		end
	end

	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	--배틀존 분할
	self.random_interval_count_x = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.x / self.shot_interval_range - 2)
	self.random_interval_count_z = math.floor(self.zone_bound.size.z / self.shot_interval_range - 2)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		for _,v in pairs(self.summon_monster_list) do
			if not v.monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				self:kill_monster(v.monster)
			end
		end
		for _,v in pairs(self.summon_gauge_monster_list) do
			if not v.monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				self:kill_monster(v.monster)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_monster_list(fo)
	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.summon_gauge_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, fo) then
			return true
		end
	end

	for _,v in pairs(self.summon_monster_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.monster, fo) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

--	self:create_monsters()

	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.total_shot_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.is_attack_range_start = false
	self.random_pos_index_list = {}
	self.shot_info_list = {}
	self.current_summon_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count = 0
	self.current_summon_total_count = 0
	self.is_hit_cocoon = false
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:hide_attack_range()

	for _,v in pairs(self.poison_egg_attack_range_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v.attack_range))
			v.attack_range:Hide()
			v.is_active = false
		end
	end

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end

				if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
					v.trail_effect:Dispose()
					v.trail_effect = nil
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self.shot_info_list = nil
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.shot_prepare then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.is_start_knockback = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self:init_random_index()
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot_prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("each_shot")
		self:shoot_poison()
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.current_shot_count = 0
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot_repeat_dealy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("shoot_repeat_dealy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack_range", self.target_position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration + self.attack_range_delay)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:init_random_index()
	--몬스터 인덱스 랜덤 관리리end
	local index_list = {}
	local total_count = #self.summon_monster_list
	for i = 1, total_count do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	self.random_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = total_count})

	local gauge_index_list = {}
	local gauge_total_count = #self.summon_gauge_monster_list
	for i = 1, gauge_total_count do
		table.insert(gauge_index_list, i)
	end

	self.random_gauge_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(gauge_index_list, {count = gauge_total_count})

	local poison_shot_index_list = {}
	local poison_total_count = self.marker_count
	for i = 1, poison_total_count do
		table.insert(poison_shot_index_list, i)
	end

	self.random_pos_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(poison_shot_index_list, {count = poison_total_count})

end

function local_class:shoot_poison()
	--
	local start_pos = self.character.Position + self.poison_shot_offset
	local dir = (self.target.Position - start_pos).normalized
	local target_pos = start_pos + dir * 10
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("poison", start_pos)
	local trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("poison_trail", start_pos)
	trail_effect.transform:SetParent(effect.transform)
	self.total_shot_count = self.total_shot_count + 1

	local shot_info = {
		index = self.total_shot_count,
		start_pos = start_pos,
		current_pos = start_pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		progress_time = 0,
		effect = effect,
		trail_effect = trail_effect,
		is_active = true,
		state = self.shot_state.shoot
	}

	table.insert(self.shot_info_list, shot_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:check_target()

	if self.shot_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_shot(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration then
			--발사 카운트가 지정카운트가 안됐으면 다시 shot_prepare로 이동
			if self.current_shot_count < self.shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_repeat_dealy)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot_repeat_dealy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_repeat_interval then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.shot_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, true)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration - self.attack_range_delay and not self.is_attack_range_start then
				self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)
				self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)

				self.is_attack_range_start = true
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		--메뉴얼 캐릭 우선 선택
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) and
						battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--없다면 일반 캐릭
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		--알 오브젝트를 맞췄다면...
		if string.find(fo.Name, 'cocoon') and not self.is_hit_cocoon then
			local object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off')
			if object.gameObject.activeSelf then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							--이벤트 이름
							'hit_cocoon',
							--fo 이름
							fo.Name,
						}))
				self.is_hit_cocoon = true
			end
		end

		--fo name체크해서 소환 몬스터면 죽인다.
		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			--- 보스가 아닌 경우만 처치한다.
			if battle_manager and battle_manager:IsBoss(fo) == false then
				self:kill_monster(fo)
			end
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_shot(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.shot_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			if v.state == self.shot_state.shoot then
				--구슬 상승 상태

				local h = math.sin(math.pi * v.progress_time) * self.shot_up_height
				local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(v.start_pos, v.target_pos, v.progress_time)
						+ unity_class.vector3.up * h
				v.effect.transform.position = pos
				v.current_pos = pos
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				if pos.y >= self.shot_up_height - 2 then
					v.state = self.shot_state.waiting
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.waiting then
				if v.progress_time >= self.shot_drop_wait_duration then
					v.state = self.shot_state.drop
					--사이클 첫번째 구슬이 드랍스테이트로 간다면 한사이클의 타겟포지션을 모두 구한다.(겹치지 않도록)
					v.start_pos = v.current_pos
					v.target_pos = self.marker_list[self.random_pos_index_list[v.index]].position
					v.progress_time = 0
					v.diff = v.target_pos - v.current_pos
					v.dist = v.diff.magnitude
					v.move_duration = 0.5

					battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range, v.target_pos)
					self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range:Show(v.move_duration - 0.02)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character,
							self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range))
					self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].is_active = true
				else
					v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				end
			elseif v.state == self.shot_state.drop then
				--구슬 다운 상태
				v.progress_time = v.progress_time + dt
				if v.progress_time <= v.move_duration then
					--타겟 포지션으로 낙하
					local move_pos = v.start_pos + v.progress_time / v.move_duration * v.diff
					v.effect.transform.position = move_pos
					v.current_pos = move_pos
				else
					--낙하 완료 후 폭파 데미지 준 뒤 & 포이즌에그 몬스터 생성
					v.effect.transform.position = v.target_pos
					v.is_active = false
					v.state = self.shot_state.none

					self:shot_explosion_damage(v.target_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_explosion", v.target_pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.target_pos)
					if v.effect ~= nil then
						v.effect:Dispose()
						v.effect = nil
					end

					if v.trail_effect ~= nil then
						v.trail_effect:Dispose()
						v.trail_effect = nil
					end

					if self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range ~= nil then
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(
								self.character, self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range))
						self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].attack_range:Hide()
						self.poison_egg_attack_range_list[v.index].is_active = false
					end

					--게이지 몬스터를 먼저 소환하고 이후는 랜덤으로
					if self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count < self.gauge_monster_count then
						self:summon_gauge_monster(v.target_pos)
					else
						local count = self.current_summon_total_count % self.gauge_monster_summon_interval
						if count == 0 then
							self:summon_gauge_monster(v.target_pos)
						else
							self:summon_normal_monster(v.target_pos)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:summon_gauge_monster(target_pos)
	self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count = self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count + 1
	local index = self.random_gauge_index_list[self.current_summon_gauge_monster_count]
	if self.summon_gauge_monster_list[index].monster ~= nil then
		self:summon_monster(self.summon_gauge_monster_list[index].monster, target_pos, self.target)
		self.current_summon_total_count = self.current_summon_total_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:summon_normal_monster(target_pos)
	self.current_summon_monster_count = self.current_summon_monster_count + 1
	local index = self.random_index_list[self.current_summon_monster_count]
	if self.summon_monster_list[index].monster ~= nil then
		self:summon_monster(self.summon_monster_list[index].monster, target_pos, self.target)
		self.current_summon_total_count = self.current_summon_total_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:summon_monster(monster, pos, target)
	monster.Position = pos
	monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = monster
	heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.isRevive = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
	thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
	monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
	message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
			monster, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
end

function local_class:shot_explosion_damage(dest_pos)
	--폭발 데미지 체크
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(dest_pos, self.shot_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:get_target_pos_list(target_pos, idx)
	local info_list = {}
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local pos = self:get_random_position(target_pos, (idx + i) - 1)
		table.insert(info_list, pos)
	end

	return info_list
end

function local_class:get_random_position(center_pos, index)
	local shot_index = index - 1
	local shot_area_angle = 360 / (self.shot_count - 1)
	local range = unity_class.random.Range(shot_area_angle * shot_index + 20, shot_area_angle * index)
	local random_range = unity_class.random.Range(1, 3)

	local random_pos = center_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, range, 0)
			* unity_class.vector3.right * random_range

	if random_pos.x < self.zone_bound.min.x then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.x > self.zone_bound.max.x then
		local offset = random_pos.x - center_pos.x
		random_pos.x = center_pos.x - math.abs(offset)
	end

	if random_pos.z < self.zone_bound.min.z then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z + math.abs(offset)
	elseif random_pos.z > self.zone_bound.max.z then
		local offset = random_pos.z - center_pos.z
		random_pos.z = center_pos.z - math.abs(offset)
	end

	return random_pos
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.shot_info_list = nil
	self.target_pos_list = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.poison_egg_attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shot_state = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.random_index_list = nil
	self.random_gauge_index_list = nil
	self.summon_monster_list = nil
	self.summon_gauge_monster_list = nil
	self.marker_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossArachneSmashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)

		prepare = 2,

	}

	self.attack_range:Hide()

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.hit_target_list = {}

	if self.explosion_hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.explosion_hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.explosion_hit_target_list = {}

	self.current_explosion_count = 0
	self.is_action_ani_start = false
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	if self.is_use_riskmap then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target.Position)

		--타겟 방향 smash_dist만큼 떨어져서 attackrange 표시
		self.is_smash_sound = false
		local dir = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		self.smash_position = self.character.Position + (dir.normalized * self.smash_distance)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.smash_position)

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local dir = self.smash_position - self.character.Position
		self.rush_dir = dir.normalized

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("smash", self.smash_position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.explosion_hit_target_list = nil
		self.explosion_hit_target_list = {}
	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_explosion_count = self.current_explosion_count + 1

		self.current_explosion_radius = self.explosion_radius_list[self.current_explosion_count]
		if self.current_explosion_count == 1 then
			self.current_ignore_radius = self.smash_radius
		else
			self.current_ignore_radius = self.explosion_radius_list[self.current_explosion_count - 1]
		end

		local effect_name = self.explosion_effect_name .. self.current_explosion_count
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(effect_name, self.smash_position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("explosion")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration - self.action_ani_delay and not self.is_action_ani_start then
				self.is_action_ani_start = true
				self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
			end
			if self.time_passed <= self.traking_duration then
				self:update_attack_range(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.smash_damage_duration then
				self:update_smash(dt)

				if not self.is_smash_sound then
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("first_explosion")
					self.is_smash_sound = true
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			if self.current_explosion_count < self.explosion_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.explosion_damage_duration then
				self:update_explosion(dt, self.current_explosion_radius, self.current_ignore_radius)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_range(dt)
	local _, dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_battle_action, self.target,
			direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)))
	self.smash_position = self.character.Position + (dir.normalized * self.smash_distance)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.smash_position)
end

function local_class:update_smash(dt)
	--데미지 업데이트
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.smash_position, self.smash_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.smash_position).normalized

			if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
			damage_info.modifier = self.smash_damage_modifier

			if 0 < self.smash_knockback_force then
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.smash_knockback_force
			end

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.hit_target_list, v)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_explosion(dt, damage_radius, ignore_radius)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.smash_position, damage_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) or self:check_hit_target(self.explosion_hit_target_list, v) then
		else
			local diff = v.Position - self.smash_position
			if math.abs(diff.magnitude) < ignore_radius then
				--smash범위 내에 있다면 데미지를 받지 않도록
			else
				local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.smash_position).normalized

				if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
					dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.target))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = v
				damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
				damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier

				if 0 < self.explosion_knockback_force then
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.explosion_knockback_force
				end

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				table.insert(self.explosion_hit_target_list, v)
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.smash_position = nil
	self.rush_dir = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil
	self.explosion_hit_target_list = nil
	self.explosion_radius_list = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,

			for i = #self.gimmick_list, 1, -1 do
				self:release_lock()

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.target) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.prison_fo.fo) then

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true

		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.web_time_passed = 0
	self.current_web_count = 0
	self.current_total_web_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.web_info_list = {}
	self.web_random_index_list = {}
	self.prison_info_list = {}
	if self.marker_order_list ~= nil then
		self.marker_order_list = nil
	end
	self.sfx_start_web = nil
	self.is_hit_cocoon = false

	if self.is_phase_change then
		self:change_state(self.state.phase_change)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
