function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end

	if self.death_type ~= nil then

		-- 비헤이비어 복구
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty('Instance',
					CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end

		self.death_type = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	end

	if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_start_web ~= nil then
		self.sfx_start_web:FadeOut(1)
	end

	self:reset_ailment()
	self:release_lock()
	self:hide_attack_range()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.phase_change then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_in then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_out then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.phase_change then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		--- prepare immune 이 설정되어 있으면 상태이상 면역
		if self.is_prepare_immune then
			self:set_ailment_resist()
		end

		self:update_knock_back()
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("howling", self.character.Position + vector(0, -1.25, 0))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("howling")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("howling")
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--- 데미지 받지 않게 처리
		if self.is_prepare_immune then
			--상태이상 면역
			self:set_ailment_resist()

			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
			self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()

			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
			self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		end

		--점프 전 좌우 방향 고정
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		--거미줄 발사위치 마커 셋팅
		self:get_marker_list()

		local index_list = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			table.insert(index_list, i)
		end
		local random_index = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list)[1]
		self.marker_order_list = self.order_list[random_index]

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.target_position = self.target.Position

		--- prepare immune 이면 jump 부터 무적 처리를 넣는다.
		if not self.is_prepare_immune then
			--상태이상 면역
			self:set_ailment_resist()

			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
			self.damaged_behaviour_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour:GetType()

			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
			self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_in then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.move_in_start = self.zone_bound.center + vector(0, 0, self.move_top_offset_z + 15)
		local move_in_pos = self.zone_bound.center + vector(0, 0, self.move_top_offset_z)
		self.move_in_diff = move_in_pos - self.move_in_start
	elseif next_state == self.state.web_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.sfx_start_web == nil then
			self.sfx_start_web = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("start_web", self.zone_bound.center)
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.web then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.web_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_web_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_out then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.move_out_start = self.character.Position
		local move_out_pos = self.move_out_start + vector(0, 0, 15)
		self.move_out_diff = move_out_pos - self.move_out_start
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, self.jump_height)
		self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)

		if self.sfx_start_web ~= nil then
			self.sfx_start_web:FadeOut(1)
		end

		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_jump_start = false
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 비헤이비어 복구
		if self.damaged_behaviour_type ~= nil then
			if self.damaged_behaviour_type == typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) then
				self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
			else
				local instance_info = self.damaged_behaviour_type:GetProperty('Instance',
					CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public | CS.System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Static)

				if instance_info ~= nil then
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = instance_info:GetValue(nil)
				else
					self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.System.Activator.CreateInstance(self.damaged_behaviour_type)
				end
			end

			self.damaged_behaviour_type = nil
		end

		self.death_type = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		if not self.is_prepare_immune then
			self:reset_ailment()
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.is_prepare_immune then
			self:reset_ailment()
		end

		self:release_lock()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if not self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack_range", self.target.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration + self.fall_prepare_duration)

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_marker_list()
	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.web_marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.web_marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end

	local index_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.web_marker_count do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	self.web_random_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = self.web_repeat_count})
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_prison(dt)
	self:update_web_shot(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:check_target()

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.phase_change then
		if self.time_passed >= self.howling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, true)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.move_in)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_in then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_in_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web_prepare)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed,
					0, 1, self.move_in_duration))
			self.character.Position = self.move_in_start + (self.move_in_diff * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web_interval)
		else
			self:web_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_repeat_interval_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.web_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.web)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.move_out)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_out then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_out_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall_prepare)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed,
					0, 1, self.move_out_duration))
			self.character.Position = self.move_out_start + (self.move_out_diff * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		else
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:web_update(dt)
	--interval간격으로 발사
	if self.time_passed >= self.web_shot_interval_duration * self.current_web_count then
		if self.current_web_count < self.web_shot_count then
			self.current_total_web_count = self.current_total_web_count + 1
			self.current_web_count = self.current_web_count + 1
			local start_pos = self.character.Position + vector(0, 3, 0)
			local target_pos = self.marker_list[self.marker_order_list[self.current_total_web_count]].position
			local diff = target_pos - start_pos
			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("web", start_pos)

			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.web_attack_range_list[self.current_total_web_count], target_pos)
			self.web_attack_range_list[self.current_total_web_count]:Show(self.web_move_duration)

			if self.is_use_riskmap then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.web_attack_range_list[self.current_total_web_count]))
			end

			table.insert(self.web_info_list, {
				start_pos = start_pos,
				target_pos = target_pos,
				diff = diff,
				effect = effect,
				time_passed = 0,
				is_active = true,
				index = self.current_total_web_count
			})
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.web_interval)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_web_shot(dt)
	if self.web_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.web_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			if v.time_passed < self.web_move_duration then
				local move_pos = v.start_pos + v.time_passed / self.web_move_duration * v.diff
				v.effect.transform.position = move_pos
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			else
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end

				self.web_attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()

				if self.is_use_riskmap then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.web_attack_range_list[v.index]))
				end

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("web_explosion", v.target_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("web_explosion", v.target_pos)
				self:update_web_hit(v.target_pos)
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		--메뉴얼 캐릭 우선 선택
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) and
						battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--없다면 일반 캐릭
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:release_lock()
	if self.prison_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				self:return_gimmick_object(v.prison_fo)

				if not self.is_use_web_lock then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", v.pos)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_explosion", v.pos)
				end

				self:release_target(v.target)
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end

		self.prison_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:release_lock_for_target(target)
	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.prison_info_list[idx].target) then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end

				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				if not self.is_use_web_lock then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				end

				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_web_hit(target_pos)
	-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.web_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, self.target) and
				not character_util.has_active_buff(self.target, 'expedition_damage_immune') then
			--스위칭 무적이 안걸려있다면 움직임 봉쇄
			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
					v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
			else
				if not self:check_hit_target(self.prison_info_list, v) then
					self:lock_target(v)
				else
					--이미 감옥상태면 시간만 초기화
					for _,v2 in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(v2.target, v) then
							v2.time_passed = 0
						end
					end
				end

				--- 웹 피격 시 넉백을 넣어야 한다면
				if self.is_use_web_knockback then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, v)
					local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.target_position).normalized

					if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
						dir = direction_util.to_vector3(v.Direction)
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = v
					damage_info.modifier = self.web_damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.web_knockback_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		--알 오브젝트를 맞췄다면...
		if string.find(fo.Name, 'cocoon') and not self.is_hit_cocoon then
			local object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off')
			if object.gameObject.activeSelf then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							--이벤트 이름
							'hit_cocoon',
							--fo 이름
							fo.Name,
						}))
				self.is_hit_cocoon = true
			end
		end

		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			self:kill_monster(fo)
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
		else
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.prison_info_list[idx].target) then
						--감옥 종료
						if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
							self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
							self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
						end

						--감옥 폭파 이펙트
						if not self.is_use_web_lock then
							self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
						end

						self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

						self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
						self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
						--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
						table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.stomp_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_prison(dt)
	if self.prison_info_list == nil then return end

	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
			self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed = self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed + dt
			if self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.prison_duration then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end

				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				if not self.is_use_web_lock then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				end

				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)

			elseif self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.prison_damage_term * self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1 then
				--1초마다 퍼뎀
				self:prison_damage(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count = self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:prison_damage(target)
	if not self.is_use_web_dot_damage then
		return
	end

	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, target.EntityGroup) or
			target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, target) then
	else
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.prison_damage_ratio)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

-- 타겟 락
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 캐릭터 조작 금지

		-- 속박 이팩트
		local prison_fo = nil

		if self.is_use_web_lock then
			--애니메이션 세트, 루프
			target:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
			--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
			-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
			target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
			target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

			prison_fo = self:init_gimmick(target.Position)

			-- 스피드캡 버프
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
			if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
				-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
			else
				local controller = target.FieldObjectController
				cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
				controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
			end
		end

		table.insert(self.prison_info_list, {
			effect = nil,
			pos = target.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_active = true,
			target = target,
			damage_count = 0,
			prison_fo = prison_fo
		})
	end
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 타겟 락 해제
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not self.is_use_web_lock then
		return
	end

	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
			end
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	for i = #self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, 1, -1 do
		local gimmick_object = table.remove(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, i)
		-- FieldObject 컴포넌트 파괴
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gimmick_object.fo)
		-- 이펙트 해제
		if gimmick_object.effect ~= nil then
			gimmick_object.effect:Dispose()
		end

		gimmick_object.fo = nil
		gimmick_object.effect = nil
	end

	self.prison_gimmick_pool_list = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.web_attack_range_list = nil
	self.web_info_list = nil
	self.prison_info_list = nil
	self.marker_list = nil
	self.web_random_index_list = nil
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.marker_order_list = nil
	self.order_list = nil
	self.death_type = nil
	self.sfx_start_web = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:on_field_object_destryed_event(e)

				self:release_lock()
			end
		end
	else
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.target) or
					lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, v.prison_fo.fo) then
				self:release_lock_for_target(v.target)

		end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.gimmick_pool_size = self.gimmick_count
	for i = 1, self.gimmick_pool_size do
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(i)
		table.insert(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
	end
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_object()
	if #self.prison_gimmick_pool_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list)
	else
		self.gimmick_pool_size = self.gimmick_pool_size + 1
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(self.gimmick_pool_size)
		return gimmick_object
	end
end

function local_class:create_gimmick_object(index_number)
	-- HACK: 풀링 한 오브젝트에 FieldObject 컴포넌트 직접 붙여서 내부에서 핸들링
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison", self.default_gimmick_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local go = effect.gameObject
	local fo = go:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))

	fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.gimmick_size)
	fo.Name = 'arachne_prision_' .. index_number

	-- 타격 가능한 물체
	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

	-- 오브젝트 스펙 생성
	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.FieldObjectSpec()
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecHpBase(fo_spec, self.gimmick_max_hp)
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecGrowthRate(fo_spec, 1)

	--기본 NullFieldObjectStatsBehaviour 이기 때문에 새로 설정함.
	local stats_behaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour()
	stats_behaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec
	fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour = stats_behaviour

	-- 데미지 1씩 들어가도록
	fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	go:SetActive(false)

	local gimmick_object = { }
	gimmick_object.fx = effect
	gimmick_object.fo = fo

	return gimmick_object
end

function local_class:return_gimmick_object(gimmick_object)
	gimmick_object.fo.Position = self.default_gimmick_position
	gimmick_object.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	table.insert(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
end

function local_class:init_gimmick(pos)
	local gimmick_object = self:get_gimmick_object()
	local fo = gimmick_object.fo

	-- 기믹 활성화 하는 시점에 heal 을 해준다.
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = self.gimmick_max_hp
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = fo

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	fo.Position = pos
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison", fo.Position)

	return gimmick_object
	-- 마커 표시
end

function local_class:set_phase_change()
	self.is_phase_change = true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.web_time_passed = 0
	self.current_web_count = 0
	self.current_total_web_count = 0
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.web_info_list = {}
	self.web_random_index_list = {}
	self.prison_info_list = {}
	if self.marker_order_list ~= nil then
		self.marker_order_list = nil
	end
	self.sfx_start_web = nil

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end

	if self.death_type ~= nil then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.death_type = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	end

	if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.sfx_start_web ~= nil then
		self.sfx_start_web:FadeOut(1)
	end

	self:release_lock()
	self:hide_attack_range()
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_in then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_out then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

		--점프 전 좌우 방향 고정
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		--거미줄 발사위치 마커 셋팅
		self:get_marker_list()

		local index_list = {}
		for i = 1, 3 do
			table.insert(index_list, i)
		end
		local random_index = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list)[1]
		self.marker_order_list = self.order_list[random_index]

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_in then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.move_in_start = self.zone_bound.center + vector(0, 0, self.move_top_offset_z + 15)
		local move_in_pos = self.zone_bound.center + vector(0, 0, self.move_top_offset_z)
		self.move_in_diff = move_in_pos - self.move_in_start
	elseif next_state == self.state.web_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.sfx_start_web == nil then
			self.sfx_start_web = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("start_web", self.zone_bound.center)
		end
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.web_casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.web_casting_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.web then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
	elseif next_state == self.state.web_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_web_count = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.move_out then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.move_out_start = self.character.Position
		local move_out_pos = self.move_out_start + vector(0, 0, 15)
		self.move_out_diff = move_out_pos - self.move_out_start
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, self.jump_height)
		self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)

		if self.sfx_start_web ~= nil then
			self.sfx_start_web:FadeOut(1)
		end

		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.is_jump_start = false
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
		self.death_type = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:release_lock()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack_range", self.target.Position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration + self.fall_prepare_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:get_marker_list()
	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.web_marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.web_marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end

	local index_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.web_marker_count do
		table.insert(index_list, i)
	end

	self.web_random_index_list = random_util.get_values_in_array(index_list, {count = self.web_repeat_count})
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_prison(dt)
	self:update_web_shot(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:check_target()

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.phase_change then
		if self.time_passed >= self.howling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, true)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.move_in)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_in then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_in_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web_prepare)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed,
					0, 1, self.move_in_duration))
			self.character.Position = self.move_in_start + (self.move_in_diff * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web_casting)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.web_interval)
		else
			self:web_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.web_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.web_repeat_interval_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.web_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.web_casting)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.move_out)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_out then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_out_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall_prepare)
		else
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed,
					0, 1, self.move_out_duration))
			self.character.Position = self.move_out_start + (self.move_out_diff * progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		else
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:web_update(dt)
	--interval간격으로 발사
	if self.time_passed >= self.web_shot_interval_duration * self.current_web_count then
		if self.current_web_count < self.web_shot_count then
			self.current_total_web_count = self.current_total_web_count + 1
			self.current_web_count = self.current_web_count + 1
			local start_pos = self.character.Position + vector(0, 3, 0)
			local target_pos = self.marker_list[self.marker_order_list[self.current_total_web_count]].position
			local diff = target_pos - start_pos
			local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("web", start_pos)
			local ar = self.web_attack_range_list[self.current_total_web_count]
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, target_pos)
			battle_range_util.show(ar, self.web_move_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.web_attack_range_list[self.current_total_web_count]))

			table.insert(self.web_info_list, {
				start_pos = start_pos,
				target_pos = target_pos,
				diff = diff,
				effect = effect,
				time_passed = 0,
				is_active = true,
				index = self.current_total_web_count
			})
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.web_interval)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_web_shot(dt)
	if self.web_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.web_info_list) do
		if v.is_active then
			if v.time_passed < self.web_move_duration then
				local move_pos = v.start_pos + v.time_passed / self.web_move_duration * v.diff
				v.effect.transform.position = move_pos
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			else
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end

				self.web_attack_range_list[v.index]:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.web_attack_range_list[v.index]))
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("web_explosion", v.target_pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("web_explosion", v.target_pos)
				self:update_web_hit(v.target_pos)
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		--메뉴얼 캐릭 우선 선택
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) and
						battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--없다면 일반 캐릭
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:release_lock()
	if self.prison_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
			if v.is_active then
				if v.effect ~= nil then
					v.effect:Dispose()
					v.effect = nil
				end
				self:return_gimmick_object(v.prison_fo)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", v.pos)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prison_explosion", v.pos)
					self:release_target(v.target)
				v.is_active = false
			end
		end

		self.prison_info_list = nil
	end
end

function local_class:release_lock_for_target(target)
	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.prison_info_list[idx].target) then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end
				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_web_hit(target_pos)
	-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.web_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, self.target) and
				not character_util.has_active_buff(self.target, 'expedition_damage_immune') then
			--스위칭 무적이 안걸려있다면 움직임 봉쇄
			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
					v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
			else
				if not self:check_hit_target(self.prison_info_list, v) then
					self:lock_target(v)
				else
					--이미 감옥상태면 시간만 초기화
					for _,v2 in pairs(self.prison_info_list) do
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(v2.target, v) then
							v2.time_passed = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		--알 오브젝트를 맞췄다면...
		if string.find(fo.Name, 'cocoon') and not self.is_hit_cocoon then
			local object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off')
			if object.gameObject.activeSelf then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							--이벤트 이름
							'hit_cocoon',
							--fo 이름
							fo.Name,
						}))
				self.is_hit_cocoon = true
			end
		end

		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			--- 보스가 아닌 경우만 처치한다.
			if battle_manager and battle_manager:IsBoss(fo) == false then
				self:kill_monster(fo)
			end
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
		else
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.prison_info_list[idx].target) then
						--감옥 종료
						if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
							self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
							self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
						end
						--감옥 폭파 이펙트
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
						self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

						self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
						self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
						--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
						table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:update_knock_back(dt)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.stomp_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(v))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			local cmd = CS.Oak.DamageCommand.Create(damage_info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(damage_info.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_prison(dt)
	if self.prison_info_list == nil then return end

	for idx = #self.prison_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active then
			self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed = self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed + dt
			if self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.prison_duration then
				--감옥 종료
				if self.prison_info_list[idx].effect ~= nil then
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect:Dispose()
					self.prison_info_list[idx].effect = nil
				end
				--감옥 폭파 이펙트
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison_explosion", self.prison_info_list[idx].pos)
				self.prison_info_list[idx].is_active = false

				self:return_gimmick_object(self.prison_info_list[idx].prison_fo)
				self:release_target(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				--끝났으면 감옥정보 삭제
				table.remove(self.prison_info_list, idx)

			elseif self.prison_info_list[idx].time_passed >= self.prison_damage_term * self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1 then
				--1초마다 퍼뎀
				self:prison_damage(self.prison_info_list[idx].target)
				self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count = self.prison_info_list[idx].damage_count + 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:prison_damage(target)
	if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, target.EntityGroup) or
			target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, target) then
	else
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreOptions | CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.prison_damage_ratio)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
end

-- 타겟 락
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 캐릭터 조작 금지

		--애니메이션 세트, 루프
		target:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
		-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
		target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
		target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		-- 속박 이팩트
		--local prison_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prison", target.Position)
		local prison_fo = self:init_gimmick(target.Position)

		-- 스피드캡 버프
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
		end

		table.insert(self.prison_info_list, {
			effect = prison_effect,
			pos = target.Position,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_active = true,
			target = target,
			damage_count = 0,
			prison_fo = prison_fo
		})
	end
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(list, target)
	for _,v in pairs(list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 타겟 락 해제
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			local state = target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
			if state ~= nil and	lua_helper.type_compare(state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
				target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
			end
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func)
		self.on_field_object_destryed_event_func = nil
	end

	for i = #self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, 1, -1 do
		local gimmick_object = table.remove(self.prison_gimmick_pool_list, i)
		-- FieldObject 컴포넌트 파괴
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(gimmick_object.fo)
		-- 이펙트 해제
		if gimmick_object.effect ~= nil then
			gimmick_object.effect:Dispose()
		end

		gimmick_object.fo = nil
		gimmick_object.effect = nil
	end

	self.prison_gimmick_pool_list = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.web_attack_range_list = nil
	self.web_info_list = nil
	self.prison_info_list = nil
	self.marker_list = nil
	self.web_random_index_list = nil
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_start_position = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.marker_order_list = nil
	self.order_list = nil
	self.death_type = nil
	self.sfx_start_web = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}
