	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_sprite_setup, self))
end

function local_class:routine_sprite_setup()
	self:get_custom_sprite()

	-- 커스텀 스프라이트용 아틀러스 준비
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('spritesheets/items', 'items_custom'), function(prefab)
			self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
		end))
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:set_change_phase(is_change_phase)
	self.is_change_phase = is_change_phase
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.is_shoot_proj = false
	if self.is_change_phase then
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end

	if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:hide_attack_range()

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dealy then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self:set_dir_for_target()
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		if self.enhanced then
			self:shoot_radial_shot(self.character.Position)
		end

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.dealy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end


function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if not self.attack_range.gameObject.activeSelf then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.dangling_duration + self.fall_duration)

		if self.is_use_riskmap then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_buff(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:check_target()

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration - self.stomp_ani_delay and not self.is_stomp_ani_start then
			self.is_stomp_ani_start = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.targeting_duration then
				self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)

				if self.is_use_riskmap then
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 낙하 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.dealy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dealy then
		-- 낙하 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.jump_interval_delay then
		else
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_target()
	if is_unity_null(self.target) or self.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
		local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if target_list == nil then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

		--메뉴얼 캐릭 우선 선택
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) and
						battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--없다면 일반 캐릭
		for _,v in pairs(target_list) do
			if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, v) then
					self.target = v
				end
				return
			end
		end

		--새로운 타겟을 못구하면 배틀액션 종료
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if string.find(fo.Name, 'cocoon') then
			local object = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off')
			if object.gameObject.activeSelf then
				self:hit_cocoon(fo)
			end
		end

		--fo name체크해서 소환 몬스터면 죽인다.
		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			self:kill_monster(fo)
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
end

function local_class:hit_cocoon(fo)
	self:change_object_state(fo)
	self:update_cocoon_explosion(fo.Position)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cocoon_explosion', fo.Position)
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:update_buff(dt)
	if self.buff_info_list == nil then return end

	if self.is_change_buff then
		if self.boss_buff_delay > 0 then
			if not self.is_remove_buff then
				self:remove_buff(self.character)
				self.is_remove_buff = true
			end
			self.boss_buff_delay = self.boss_buff_delay - dt
		else
			self:update_boss_buff()
			self.is_change_buff = false
			self.boss_buff_delay = 0
		end
	end

	for i = #self.buff_info_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.buff_info_list[i].is_active then
			if self.buff_info_list[i].time_passed < self.buff_duration then
				self.buff_info_list[i].time_passed = self.buff_info_list[i].time_passed + dt
			else
				if self.buff_info_list[i].buff_effect ~= nil then
					self.buff_info_list[i].buff_effect:Dispose()
					self.buff_info_list[i].buff_effect = nil
				end

				for _,v in pairs(self.buff_info_list[i].buff_icon) do
					if v ~= nil then
						v:Dispose()
						v = nil
					end
				end

				self.buff_info_list[i].is_active = false

				if self.buff_info_list[i].target == self.character then
					self.current_buff_count = 0
				end
				table.remove(self.buff_info_list, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_boss_buff()
	local is_buff, index = self:check_buff_target(self.character)
	--현재 파괴한 알 갯수에 맞게 버프를 셋팅해 준다.
	if is_buff then
		if self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count > self.buff_max_count then
			self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count = self.buff_max_count
		else
			local add_count = self.current_buff_count - self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count
			for i = 1, add_count do
				local buff_icon = self:add_buff_icon(self.character)
				table.insert(self.buff_info_list[index].buff_icon, buff_icon)
			end
			self:set_pos_buff_icon(self.buff_info_list[index].buff_icon, true, self.current_buff_count)
		end

		self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count = self.current_buff_count
	end

	local buff_level = self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count * self.buff_level
	self:add_buff(self.character, buff_level)

	local scale_index = self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count
	if scale_index > 3 then
		scale_index = 3
	end
	local scale = self.buff_effect_scale_list[scale_index]
	self.buff_info_list[index].buff_effect.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)
	self.buff_info_list[index].time_passed = 0
	if self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count >= self.buff_max_count and not self.is_groggy then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					--이벤트 이름
					'debuff_groggy'
				}))
		self.is_groggy = true
	end
end

function local_class:update_cocoon_explosion(pos)
	-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.cocoon_radius)

	--알이 터지면 보스는 무조건 디버프 걸린다.
	local is_buff, index = self:check_buff_target(self.character)
	if is_buff then
		--카운트만 올리고(2개 동시 터졌을 떄를 대비)실제 보스의 버프는 업데이트에서 카운트를 기준으로 돌려준다.
		self:remove_buff(self.character)
		if self.current_buff_count < self.buff_max_count then
			self.current_buff_count = self.current_buff_count + 1
		end
		self.is_change_buff = true
		self.is_remove_buff = false
		self.boss_buff_delay = 0.1
	else
		self:add_buff(self.character, self.buff_level)
		local buff_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('buff_aura', self.character.Position,
				unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.Transform)
		local scale_index = 1
		local scale = self.buff_effect_scale_list[scale_index]
		buff_effect.transform.localScale = vector(scale, scale, scale)

		local buff_icon = self:add_buff_icon(self.character)
		self.current_buff_count = 1
		self.is_groggy = false

		table.insert(self.buff_info_list, {
			target = self.character,
			buff_count = 1,
			buff_effect = buff_effect,
			time_passed = 0,
			buff_icon = {buff_icon},
			is_active = true})
	end

	for _,v in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, v.EntityGroup) or
				v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, v) then
		else
			local is_buff, index = self:check_buff_target(v)
			if is_buff then
				self:remove_buff(v)
				self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count = self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count + 1

				if self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count > 3 then
					self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count = 3
				else
					local buff_icon = self:add_buff_icon(v)
					table.insert(self.buff_info_list[index].buff_icon, buff_icon)
					self:set_pos_buff_icon(self.buff_info_list[index].buff_icon, false)
				end

				local buff_level = self.buff_info_list[index].buff_count * self.buff_level
				self:add_buff(v, buff_level)
				self.buff_info_list[index].time_passed = 0
			else
				self:add_buff(v, self.buff_level)
				local buff_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('buff_aura', v.Position,
						unity_class.vector3.zero, v.Transform)

				local buff_icon = self:add_buff_icon(v)

				table.insert(self.buff_info_list, {
					target = v,
					buff_count = 1,
					buff_effect = buff_effect,
					time_passed = 0,
					buff_icon = {buff_icon},
					is_active = true})
			end
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:set_pos_buff_icon(buff_icon_list, is_boss, count)
	local buff_count = #buff_icon_list
	if count ~= nil then
		buff_count = count
	end

	if is_boss then
		local start_pos = buff_icon_list[1].transform.position
		for _,v in pairs(buff_icon_list) do
			v.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		end

		local offset = vector(0, self.character.Bounds.size.y + 2, 0)
		start_pos = self.character.Position + offset

		if buff_count == 2 then
			buff_icon_list[1].transform.position = start_pos + vector(-0.8, 0, 0)
			buff_icon_list[1].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			buff_icon_list[2].transform.position = start_pos + vector(0.8, 0, 0)
			buff_icon_list[2].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		elseif buff_count == 3 then
			buff_icon_list[1].transform.position = start_pos + vector(-1.2, 0, 0)
			buff_icon_list[1].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			buff_icon_list[2].transform.position = start_pos + vector( 0.0, 0, 0)
			buff_icon_list[2].transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
			buff_icon_list[3].transform.position = start_pos + vector(1.2, 0, 0)

			buff_icon_list[2].transform.localScale = vector(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)
			buff_icon_list[3].transform.position = start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)

			buff_icon_list[4].transform.position = start_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0)
			buff_icon_list[4].transform.localScale = vector(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)

function local_class:check_buff_target(target)
	if self.buff_info_list == nil then return false end

	for _,v in pairs(self.buff_info_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) then
			return true, _
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:add_buff(target, buff_level)
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.buff_name, buff_level, true, false)
end

-- 시간 지났을때 버프 해제시키는 함수
function local_class:remove_buff(target)
	buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.buff_name)
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:change_object_state(fo)
	CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'on').gameObject:SetActive(true)
	CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(fo.Transform, 'off').gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:shoot_radial_shot(pos)
	for i = 1, self.radial_shot_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.radial_shot_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, dir, i, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:add_buff_icon(target)
	-- image의 오프셋은 count의 y축 오프셋 * 0.8배가 적당
	local offset = vector(0, target.Bounds.size.y + 0.5, 0)
	local scale = 0.7
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.character) then
		scale = 1.5
		offset = vector(0, target.Bounds.size.y + 0.5, 0)
	end
	local buff_icon = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(target.Bounds.center + offset,
			unity_class.quaternion.identity, target.Transform)
	local buff_sprite = buff_icon.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	buff_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(10, 0, 0))
	buff_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()

	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.target_position = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.jump_trail_effect = nil

	self.buff_info_list = nil
end

create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

local local_class = newclass('BossArachneStompSingleRaidBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, stomp_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	self.state = {

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_jump_start = false
	self.is_shoot_proj = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end

	if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
		self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
		self.jump_trail_effect = nil
	end

	if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
		self.casting_effect:Dispose()
		self.casting_effect = nil
	end

	self:hide_attack_range()

	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.casting_effect ~= nil then
			self.casting_effect:Dispose()
			self.casting_effect = nil
		end
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		self:hide_attack_range()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dealy then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
		self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("prepare", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self:set_dir_for_target()
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:set_dir_for_target()
		self.is_stomp_ani_start = false
		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.target.Position
		self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump_prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.is_left_dir then
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_L",
					self.character.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.jump_trail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump_trail_R",
					self.character.Position + vector(-1.82, 1.09, 0), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end
		self.jump_trail_effect.transform.parent = self.character.transform

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("jump")
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.jump_trail_effect ~= nil then
			self.jump_trail_effect:Dispose()
			self.jump_trail_effect = nil
		end
		self:show_attack_range(self.target_position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self:shoot_radial_shot(self.character.Position)

		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.dealy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_dir_for_target()
	local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
	local dir = diff.normalized
	local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(dir)
	if side_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_left_dir = true
	else
		self.is_left_dir = false
	end
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
end


function local_class:show_attack_range(position)
	if self.attack_range == nil then return end

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.dangling_duration + self.fall_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		local offset_x
		if self.is_left_dir then
			offset_x = self.jump_offset_x
		else
			offset_x = -self.jump_offset_x
		end
		self.move_offset = vector(offset_x * progress, 0, 0)
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position + self.move_offset,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration - self.stomp_ani_delay and not self.is_stomp_ani_start then
			self.is_stomp_ani_start = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position) + self.jump_height)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		else
			if self.time_passed < self.targeting_duration then
				self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(self.target.Position)
				battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 낙하 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.action_duration then
			self:update_stomp(dt)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.dealy)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dealy then
		-- 낙하 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.jump_interval_delay then
		else
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.jump_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_stomp(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		--fo name체크해서 소환 몬스터면 죽인다.
		if fo.EntityGroup == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) then
			--- 보스가 아닌 경우만 처치한다.
			if battle_manager and battle_manager:IsBoss(fo) == false then
				self:kill_monster(fo)
			end
		end

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.stomp_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:kill_monster(monster)
	monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = monster
	damage_info.damage = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos

function local_class:trigger()

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

		self.egg_info_list = nil

	self.get_support_time_passed = 0
	self.current_active_egg_count = 0
	self.current_linked_count = 0
	self.current_egg_count = 0

	self.is_start_action = false

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.is_jump_start then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position))
	end
	self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	self:reset_ailment()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 end event 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.is_start_knockback = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.active_egg then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.is_start_action = false
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.jump_start_position = self.character.Position
		self.target_position = self.zone_bound.center
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self:set_ailment_resist()
		self:set_next_wave()
		self.is_wave_start = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("jump", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("jump", self.character.Position)
		self.is_jump_start = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.dangling then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("stomp")
	elseif next_state == self.state.stomp then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.is_jump_start = false
		self.is_start_knockback = true
		self.is_start_action = true
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("stomp", self.character.Position)
		self:set_eggs()
	elseif next_state == self.state.casting then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.casting_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.active_egg then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.current_active_egg_count = self.current_active_egg_count + 1
		self:set_active_egg(self.current_active_egg_count)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)

end

-- 상태이상 면역 해제
function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:set_eggs()
	for i = 1, self.casting_repeat_count do
		local egg_pos = self:get_pos_egg_for_index(i)
		local egg_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("egg", egg_pos)
		local egg_info = {
			index = i,
			egg_effect = egg_effect,
			pos = egg_pos
		}

		table.insert(self.egg_info_list, egg_info)
		self.current_egg_count = self.current_egg_count + 1
	end
end

function local_class:set_active_egg(index)
	local active_egg_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("active_egg", self.egg_info_list[index].pos)
	self.egg_info_list[index].active_egg_effect = active_egg_effect
	if self.egg_info_list[index].egg_effect ~= nil then
		self.egg_info_list[index].egg_effect:Dispose()
		self.egg_info_list[index].egg_effect = nil
	end

	self.egg_energy_effect_start_pos = self.egg_info_list[index].pos
	self.egg_energy_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("energy_line", self.egg_energy_effect_start_pos)
	self.is_egg_energy_effect_start = true
	self.egg_energy_progress_time = 0
	self.egg_energe_diff = self.character.Position - self.egg_energy_effect_start_pos
end

function local_class:get_pos_egg_for_index(index)
	--인덱스 별로 알의 포지션을 반환해준다.
	--간격 = 마진 + 가로라인 size / total_count
	local start_x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.egg_radius
	local start_z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.egg_radius
	local interval_x = (self.zone_bound.size.x - self.egg_radius * 2) / (self.casting_repeat_count - 1)
	local pos = vector(start_x + (interval_x * (index - 1)), 0, start_z)
	pos = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))

	return pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_start_support then
		--스턴기가 들어오면 시작
		if self.get_support_time_passed < self.support_linked_duration then
			self.get_support_time_passed = self.get_support_time_passed + dt
		else
			--다음 스턴기가 설정한 시간안에 안들어오면 버프 발동
			self:add_buff()
			self.is_start_support = false
		end
	end

	if self.is_wave_start then
		self:update_wave(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.is_start_knockback then
		self:update_knockback(dt)
	end

	if self.is_egg_energy_effect_start then
		self:update_energy(dt)
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.jump_start_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * progress

		if self.time_passed >= self.jump_duration then
			local target_pos = CS.Oak.BattleUtils.GetAvoidObstaclePosition(self.character, self.jump_start_position, self.target_position, false)
			-- 보정위치 계산후 존 밖으로 벗어나는지에 대한 재검사를 하는 편이 맞다.
			self.target_position = self:check_jump_target_pos(target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.dangling)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dangling then
		if self.time_passed >= self.dangling_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuart(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_duration))
		self.character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_position,
				battle_util.get_height(self.jump_start_position)) + unity_class.vector3.up * self.jump_height * (1 - progress)
		if self.time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		-- 낙하 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed >= self.stomp_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.casting)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.casting then
		if self.time_passed >= self.casting_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.active_egg)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.active_egg then
		if self.time_passed >= self.active_egg_duration then
			if self.current_active_egg_count < self.casting_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.casting)
			else
				self:add_buff()
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_energy(dt)
	if self.egg_energy_progress_time < self.egg_energy_move_duration then
		local move_pos = self.egg_energy_effect_start_pos + self.egg_energy_progress_time /
				self.egg_energy_move_duration * self.egg_energe_diff
		self.egg_energy_effect.transform.position = move_pos
		self.egg_energy_effect_current_pos = move_pos
		self.egg_energy_progress_time = self.egg_energy_progress_time + dt
	else
		if self.egg_energy_effect ~= nil then
			self.egg_energy_effect:Dispose()
			self.egg_energy_effect = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("absorption", self.character.Position)
		self.is_egg_energy_effect_start = false
	end
end

function local_class:check_jump_target_pos(dest_pos)
	local final_dest_pos = dest_pos
	if dest_pos.x <= self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.min.x + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.x >= self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.x = self.zone_bound.max.x - self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z <= self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.min.z + self.jump_pos_offset
	end
	if dest_pos.z >= self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset then
		final_dest_pos.z = self.zone_bound.max.z - self.jump_pos_offset
	end

	return final_dest_pos
end

function local_class:add_buff()
	--활성화된 알 갯수에 따라 버프강도 변경해서 부여
	local buff_level = self.add_buff_level * self.current_active_egg_count
	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character,
			self.add_buff_name, buff_level * self.current_egg_count, false, false)
	--알이펙트들 삭제
	self:remove_all_eggs()
end

function local_class:remove_all_eggs()
	if self.egg_info_list == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.egg_info_list) do
		if v.egg_effect ~= nil then
			v.egg_effect:Dispose()
			v.egg_effect = nil
		end

		if v.active_egg_effect ~= nil then
			v.active_egg_effect:Dispose()
			v.active_egg_effect = nil
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.pos)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_egg()
	if self.current_egg_count > 0 then
		--역으로 삭제
		if self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].egg_effect ~= nil then
			self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].egg_effect:Dispose()
			self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].egg_effect = nil
		end

		if self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].active_egg_effect ~= nil then
			self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].active_egg_effect:Dispose()
			self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].active_egg_effect = nil
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.egg_info_list[self.current_egg_count].pos)
		self.current_egg_count = self.current_egg_count - 1
	end
end

function local_class:update_knockback(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_position).normalized

			if dir:IsAlmostZero() then
				dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)

end

function local_class:set_next_wave()
	-- 다음 웨이브 몬스터 위치 리셋
	if self.current_wave_index < self.max_wave_index then
		self.current_wave_index = self.current_wave_index + 1
		self:reset_monster_pos(self.current_wave_index)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.BattleGroupSpawnNextWaveEvent.Create(self.wave_group_name))
	end

function local_class:reset_monster_pos(wave_num)
	local monsters = self.wave_battle_group:GetMonsters(wave_num)

	for _, monster in pairs(monsters) do
		if is_unity_null(stage.BattleManager:GetBattleFor(monster)) then
			--monster.Position = self.monster_init_pos[monster]
			local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
			thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
			local cmd = CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeCommand.Create(monster, user_party_leader, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle)
			command_util.publish_cmd(monster.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.is_start_action then return end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.character) then
			if e.Info.forceAilment then
				if e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Down] == self.max_ailment_gauge
						or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Poison] == self.max_ailment_gauge
						or e.Info[CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial] == self.max_ailment_gauge then
					--연계기가 들어왔다?
					self.get_support_time_passed = 0
					self.current_linked_count = self.current_linked_count + 1
					if self.current_linked_count == self.casting_repeat_count then
						--8번 연계기에 성공하면 끝
						self.is_start_support = false
					end

					self:remove_egg()
					--연계기가 들어올때마다 알하나씩삭제
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.AerialEvent) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PoisonEvent) or
			lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DownEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.character) then
			--스턴이 시작됐다면 서포트액션 카운트가 시작
			if not self.is_start_support then
				self.is_start_support = true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	self.wave_battle_group = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleGroup(self.wave_group_name)
	self.wave_battle_group.SpawnNextWaveAutomatically = false

	self.wave_monster_init_pos = {}
	local monsters = self.wave_battle_group:GetMonsters()
	for _, monster in pairs(monsters) do
		self.wave_monster_init_pos[monster] = monster.Position
		monster.FieldObjectController.PatrolAI = CS.Oak.PatrolAI.None
	end
end

	self:set_next_wave()
	return true
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	self:remove_all_eggs()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_stage_start_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), self.on_stage_start_event_func)
		self.on_stage_start_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_battlegroup_wave_clear_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), self.on_battlegroup_wave_clear_event_func)
		self.on_battlegroup_wave_clear_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
end

return {
create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.3)

	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.25)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChargeSpeed", 1.0)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_length, charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Size = unity_class.vector3(charge_width, 2, charge_width)
	info.IsCenterToSide = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)

	self.zone_bounds = nil

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 이동 방향
	self.charge_direction = nil
	-- 이동 시작 지점 ( 거리재기용 )
	self.start_position = nil

	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.action_key = 'action'
	self.post_key = 'post'

	self.charge_key = 'charge'
	-- 이펙트
	self.fx_charge = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	-- 무조건 사용하도록 함.
	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 배틀존 중앙으로 가는 방향으로 트리거 생성
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(self.zone_bound.center - self.character.Position)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.charge_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(info:GetDirectionAt(0), 0)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide(0)
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
		self.fx_charge:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_charge = nil
	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			-- 취소되서 순서가 꼬인경우 어택레인지 종료
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if self.sfx_charge ~= nil then
			self.sfx_charge:FadeOut()
			self.sfx_charge = nil
		end
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.charge_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bound, self.character.Bounds, self.charge_direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, 1)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key, self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.charge_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.start_position = self.character.Position

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.fx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Position, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.sfx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key, self.character.Position)
		--self.sfx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.dash_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 업데이트
		self:update_charge(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local distance = vector_util.distance(self.start_position, self.character.Position)
	if distance < self.charge_length then
		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
		move_info.magnitude = self.charge_length / self.action_duration * dt * self.charge_speed

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

		self.sfx_charge:SetPosition(self.character.Position)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
				local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
				local xz_move_direction = self.charge_direction:GetXz().normalized
				local knock_direction
				if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.charge_direction
				else
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.charge_direction
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	else
		-- 이동 종료하고 이후 단계로
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
-- 이벤트
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then

-- 패턴 설명
--1 페이즈(hp > 70%) : 용암을 n회 쏘아 올리고(연출) 낙석 공격을 n회 시행 한다
--2 페이즈(hp <= 70%) : 용암을 n회 쏘아 올리고(연출) 낙석 공격을 n회 시행 한다. 거대 종유석이 떨어진다
--  					이때 거대 종유석은 스테이지에 남아 BossBalockMeteor(유성)패턴의 회피에 사용된다
-- https://kong-project-oak.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/TS/pages/2290745406/v2.45+3#%EC%9C%A0%EC%84%B1(BossBalockMeteor)

local stalactite_class =
{
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	index = nil,
	position = nil,

	fall_duration = nil,
	fall_height = nil,

	destroy_bead_event_id = nil
}
stalactite_class.mt = { __index = stalactite_class }

function stalactite_class:new(parent_class, index, pos, delay, fall_duration, fall_height, is_enhanced)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.index = index
	obj.position = pos
	obj.delay = delay
	obj.fall_duration = fall_duration
	obj.fall_height = fall_height

	self.rock_vfo = nil
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.state = parent_class.stalactite_state

	self.fall_time_passed = 0.0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.tracking_time = parent_class.large_rock_tracking_time

	self.fx_stalactite = nil
	self.fx_erupted_rock = nil
	self.need_check_collision = true

	self.on_event_func = nil

	-- vfo active를 n프레임 미뤄 캐릭터 넉백이 정상적으로 이뤄지게 하기 위함
	self.vfo_delay = 1
	self.vfo_delay_count = 0

		self.damage_calculator = parent_class.rockfall_calculator
		self.damage_modifier = parent_class.rockfall_damage_modifier

	else
		-- 강화 종유석만 커스텀 이벤트 수신 한다.
		self.on_event_func = function(e)
			self:on_custom_event(e)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.damage_calculator = parent_class.rockfall_large_calculator
		self.damage_modifier = parent_class.rockfall_large_damage_modifier
		parent_class.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot")
	end

	return obj
end

-- BossBalockMeteorBattleAction에서 종유석 파괴 용으로 사용
function stalactite_class:force_destroy()
	self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
end

function stalactite_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.move then
		-- 데미지 처리 여기서
		self:stalactite_damage()
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.is_enhanced then
			self.attack_range = self.action.large_rock_ar
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.action.target.Position)
			self.attack_range:Show()
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.move then

		if self.is_enhanced then
			self.fx_stalactite = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("stalactite_big", self.position + (vector_util.up * self.fall_height))
		else
			self.fx_stalactite = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("stalactite_small", self.position + (vector_util.up * self.fall_height))
			self.attack_range = self.action:get_attack_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.position)
			self.attack_range:Show(self.fall_duration)
		end

		if self.attack_range ~= nil then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.stay then
		if self.is_enhanced then
			--self.rock_vfo = self.action:get_large_rock_vfo()
			--self.rock_vfo.Position = self.position
			--self.rock_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
			self.fx_erupted_rock = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("rock_big", self.position)
			self.need_check_collision = true
			self.cs_action:PlaySfx("rock_large_fall", self.position)
			self.vfo_delay_count = 0

			-- 이벤트 파라메터
			-- 위치, 생성될 구슬 갯수, 해당 구슬에 할당될 이벤트 id
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
					{ 'expedition_bead_drop_request', self.position.x, self.position.y, self.position.z,
					  self.create_bead_count, self.create_bead_event_id }))
		end

		if self.attack_range ~= nil then
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.destroy then
		if self.is_enhanced then
			if self.rock_vfo ~= nil then
				self.rock_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				self.action:return_large_rock_vfo(self.rock_vfo)
				self.rock_vfo = nil
			end

			self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("rock_explosion_big", self.position)
			self.cs_action:PlaySfx("rock_explosion", self.position)

			-- 이벤트 파라메터
			-- 위치, 생성될 구슬 갯수, 해당 구슬에 할당될 이벤트 id
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
					{ 'expedition_bead_drop_request', self.position.x, self.position.y, self.position.z,
					  self.destroy_bead_count, self.destroy_bead_event_id }))
		else

			self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect("rock_explosion_small", self.position)
			self.cs_action:PlaySfx("rock_large_explosion", self.position)
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function stalactite_class:stalactite_damage()
	if not self.damage_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.damage_calculator:Start()
	end
	self.damage_calculator.Position = self.position
	local objects = self.damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.action.character, fo) then
			local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.action.character, fo).normalized
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.action.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = knockback_direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction
			if self.is_enhanced then
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.action.rockfall_large_knockback_force
			else
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.action.rockfall_knockback_force
			end
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.damage_calculator:End()
end

function stalactite_class:check_collision()
	if not self.is_enhanced then
		return false
	end

	if not self.need_check_collision then
		return false
	end

	self.need_check_collision = false

	if not self.damage_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.damage_calculator:Start()
	end
	self.damage_calculator.Position = self.position

	local character = self.action.character
	local r_val = false
	local objects = self.damage_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if fo == character then
			r_val = true
			break
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.damage_calculator:End()
	return r_val
end

function stalactite_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.delay then
			if not self.is_enhanced then
				self:change_state(self.state.move)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
			end
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
			return
		end

		if self.is_enhanced then
			self.position = self.action.target.Position
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.position)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		self.fall_time_passed = self.fall_time_passed + dt

		-- time over
		if self.fall_time_passed >= self.fall_duration then
			if self.is_enhanced and self.fx_stalactite ~= nil then
				local end_pos = self:get_stalactite_end_pos(self.position)
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_stalactite, end_pos, vector_util.zero)
			end
			self:change_state(self.state.stay)
			return
		end

		-- update
		if self.fx_stalactite ~= nil then
			local pg = self.fall_time_passed / self.fall_duration
			local current_height = (1 - pg * pg) * self.fall_height
			local end_pos = self:get_stalactite_end_pos(self.position)
			local current_pos = end_pos + current_height * vector_util.up
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_stalactite, current_pos, vector_util.zero)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stay then
		if self.is_enhanced then
			if self.vfo_delay >= self.vfo_delay_count and self.rock_vfo == nil then
				self.rock_vfo = self.action:get_large_rock_vfo()
				self.rock_vfo.Position = self.position
				self.rock_vfo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			end

			if self.time_passed >= self.action.large_rock_life_time then
				self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
				return
			end

			-- 거대 종유석이 보스몬스터와 겹치는지 체크, 겹친다면 바로 박살
			if self:check_collision() then
				self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
			end
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
		end
	end
end

function stalactite_class:set_bead_data(create_count, create_event_id, destroy_count, destroy_event_id)
	self.create_bead_count = create_count
	self.create_bead_event_id = create_event_id
	self.destroy_bead_count = destroy_count
	self.destroy_bead_event_id = destroy_event_id
end

function stalactite_class:get_stalactite_end_pos(t_pos)
	if not self.is_enhanced then
		return t_pos
	end

	return unity_class.vector3(t_pos.x, t_pos.y + 1.3, t_pos.z)
end

function stalactite_class:on_custom_event()
	if self.action == nil or self.action.character == nil then
		return
	end

	if not self.is_enhanced then
		return
	end

	if not e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'stalactite_destroy' then
		self:change_state(self.state.destroy)
	end
end

function stalactite_class:dispose()
	if self.rock_vfo ~= nil then
		self.action:return_large_rock_vfo(self.rock_vfo)
		self.rock_vfo = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		if not self.is_enhanced then
			self.action:return_attack_range(self.attack_range)
		else
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
			self.attack_range:Hide()
		end
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	if self.fx_stalactite ~= nil then
		self.fx_stalactite:Dispose()
		self.fx_stalactite = nil
	end

	if self.fx_erupted_rock ~= nil then
		self.fx_erupted_rock:Dispose()
		self.fx_erupted_rock = nil
	end

	if self.on_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

end

function shot_class:new(parent_class, start_pos, speed, distance, direction, degree, fx_fire, fx_contrail)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.start_pos = start_pos
	obj.speed = speed
	obj.distance = distance
	obj.direction = direction
	obj.degree = degree
	obj.fx_fire = fx_fire
	obj.fx_contrail = fx_contrail

	self.current_pos = vector_util.zero
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.need_dispose = false

	return obj
end

function shot_class:update_frame(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.distance / self.speed)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	self.current_pos = self.start_pos + self.direction * (self.distance * progress)
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_fire, self.current_pos, self.direction)

	if progress >= 1 then
		self.need_dispose = true
	end
end

function shot_class:dispose()
	if self.fx_fire ~= nil then
		self.fx_fire:Dispose()
		self.fx_fire = nil
	end

	if self.fx_contrail ~= nil then
		self.fx_contrail:Dispose()
		self.fx_contrail = nil
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
