		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target

	self:make_rockfall_area_array()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		--battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key)
		self.rock_sfx_running = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_interval_passed = self.shot_interval
		self.shot_count = 0

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_rockfall(dt)
	self:update_shot(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.shot_interval_passed = self.shot_interval_passed + dt

		if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
			if self.shot_count >= self.shot_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
				return
			end
		else
			if self.shot_count >= self.shot_max_count + self.enhance_shot_max_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
				return
			end
		end

		if self.shot_interval_passed >= self.shot_interval then
			-- 강화 샷 검사 및 발사, 종유석 생성
			-- 랜덤 각도 계산
			local rand_num = unity_class.random.Range(0, self.shot_spread_degree) - self.shot_spread_degree / 2
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rand_num, vector_util.up).normalized
			local rand_dir = rot * vector_util.forward
			local pos = nil
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.two and self.enhance_shot_start == self.shot_count then
				pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset
				local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_proj_blue", pos)
				local fx_contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_blue_contrail", pos, vector_util.zero, fx.transform)
				local new_shot = shot_class:new(self, self.character.Position + self.shot_offset,
						self.shot_speed, self.shot_distance, rand_dir, rand_num, fx, fx_contrail)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_proj_fire_blue", pos)
				table.insert(self.shot_holders, new_shot)

				local delay = self.rock_delay + self.rock_interval * self.shot_count
				local new_rock = stalactite_class:new(self, self.shot_count, self.target.Position, delay,
						self.rock_falling_time, self.rock_falling_height, true)
				new_rock:set_bead_data(self.bead_count_for_create, self.event_id_for_create, self.bead_count_for_destroy, self.event_id_for_destroy)

				table.insert(self.rock_holders, new_rock)
				new_rock:change_state(self.stalactite_state.prepare)
			else
				pos = self.character.Position + self.shot_offset
				local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_proj", pos)
				local fx_contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_contrail", pos, vector_util.zero, fx.transform)
				local new_shot = shot_class:new(self, self.character.Position + self.shot_offset,
						self.shot_speed, self.shot_distance, rand_dir, rand_num, fx, fx_contrail)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("erupted_proj_fire", pos)
				table.insert(self.shot_holders, new_shot)


				local delay = self.rock_delay + self.rock_interval * self.shot_count
				pos = self:get_rand_rockfall_pos(self.shot_count)
				local new_rock = stalactite_class:new(self, self.shot_count, pos, delay,
						self.rock_falling_time, self.rock_falling_height, false)
				table.insert(self.rock_holders, new_rock)
				new_rock:change_state(self.stalactite_state.prepare)
			end

			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.erupt)
			self.shot_count = self.shot_count + 1
			self.shot_interval_passed = 0
			stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:make_rockfall_area_array()
	-- 기존 맵 삭제
	for i = #self.rand_rockfall_map, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(self.rand_rockfall_map, i)
	end

	local f_num = math.sqrt(self.shot_max_count)
	local a, b = math.modf(f_num)
	local s_num = a
	if b > 0 then
		s_num  = s_num  + 1
	end

	local x_length = self.zone_bound.size.x / s_num
	local z_length = self.zone_bound.size.z / s_num
	local map_temp = {}

	for z = 0, s_num - 1 do
		for x = 0, s_num - 1 do
			local v = {}
			v.x_min = self.zone_bound.min.x + x * x_length
			v.x_max = v.x_min + x_length
			v.z_min = self.zone_bound.min.z + z * z_length
			v.z_max = v.z_min + z_length
			v.pass = false
			table.insert(map_temp, v)
		end
	end

	local count = 0

	-- 한번 쓰까
	for _ = #map_temp, 1, -1 do
		local r_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #map_temp)
		local temp = table.remove(map_temp, r_idx)
		table.insert(self.rand_rockfall_map, temp)
		count = count + 1
	end

	-- 딱 떨어지면 계산 필요 없음
	if b == 0 then
		return
	end

	local m_num = s_num * s_num - self.shot_max_count
	local div_num = (#self.rand_rockfall_map - 1) / m_num
	local pass_num = 0.0

	local iter = 1
	for i = 1, m_num do
		local max_num, pass = math.modf(div_num)
		pass_num = pass_num + pass
		local pass_a, pass_b = math.modf(pass_num)
		if pass_a > 0 then
			max_num = max_num + pass_a
			pass_num = pass_b
		end

		-- 다음애를 pass로 만들어야함
		local rand_idx = random_util.get_random_int(iter, iter + max_num - 2)
		self.rand_rockfall_map[rand_idx + 1].pass = true
		iter = iter + max_num
	end
end

function local_class:get_rand_rockfall_pos(shot_count)
	-- 페이즈 2에서 shot_count가 강화 샷 스타트 넘버 이상이라면 shot_count -1 을 하여 맵을 올바르게 가져오도록 한다
	if shot_count > self.enhance_shot_start then
		shot_count = shot_count - 1
	end

	if #self.rand_rockfall_map == self.shot_max_count then
		local rand_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[shot_count + 1]
		local r_x = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.x_min, rand_map.x_max)
		local r_z = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.z_min, rand_map.z_max)
		return unity_class.vector3(r_x, 0, r_z)
	end

	local rand_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[shot_count + 1]
	local next_map = self.rand_rockfall_map[shot_count + 2]
	-- 만약 다음 map이 pass라면 랜덤으로 두개 중 하나를 픽
	if next_map ~= nil and next_map.pass then
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1)
		if rand == 1 then
			rand_map = next_map
		end
	end

	local r_x = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.x_min, rand_map.x_max)
	local r_z = unity_class.random.Range(rand_map.z_min, rand_map.z_max)

	return unity_class.vector3(r_x, 0, r_z)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.sfx_earthquake ~= nil then
		self.sfx_earthquake:FadeOut()
		self.sfx_earthquake = nil
	end

	for idx = #self.rock_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.rock_holders[idx]
		holder:dispose()
		table.remove(self.rock_holders, idx)
	end

	for idx = #self.shot_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.shot_holders[idx]
		holder:dispose()
		table.remove(self.shot_holders, idx)
	end

	self:cancel()
end
function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'earthquake_sound_fadeout' then
		if self.sfx_earthquake ~= nil then
			self.sfx_earthquake:FadeOut()
			self.sfx_earthquake = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switch_event(e)
	self.target = e.CurrentParty.Leader
end

-- 전투 종료시 사운드 계속 나오기 때문에 여기서 해제해준다
function local_class:on_battle_end_event(e)
	if self.sfx_earthquake ~= nil then
		self.sfx_earthquake:Stop()
		self.sfx_earthquake = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	if self.on_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_event_func)
		self.on_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_expedition_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_expedition_event_func)
		self.on_expedition_event_func = nil
	end


	if self.subscribe_func == nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.rockfall_calculator = nil
	self.rockfall_large_calculator = nil
	self.rock_holders = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.rand_rockfall_map = nil
end

function local_class:update_rockfall(dt)
	if self.rock_holders == nil then
		self.rock_holders = {}
		return
	end

	if #self.rock_holders == 0 then
		return
	end

	for idx = #self.rock_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.rock_holders[idx]
		holder:update_frame(dt)

		if not self.rock_sfx_running then
			-- 암석 중 어떤것인가 떨어지는 상태가 되었다면 지진 사운드 실행
			if holder.current_state == self.stalactite_state.move then
				self.rock_sfx_running = true
				self.sfx_earthquake = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("earthquake", self.zone_bound.center)
			end
		end

		if holder.current_state == self.stalactite_state.destroy then
			holder:dispose()
			table.remove(self.rock_holders, idx)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_shot(dt)
	if self.shot_holders == nil then
		self.shot_holders = {}
		return
	end

	if #self.shot_holders == 0 then
		return
	end

	for idx = #self.shot_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.shot_holders[idx]
		holder:update_frame(dt)

		if holder.need_dispose then
			holder:dispose()
			table.remove(self.shot_holders, idx)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_attack_range()
	if #self.ar_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.ar_list)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.rock_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_attack_range(range)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))

	if self.ar_list == nil then
		self.ar_list = {}
	end

	range:Hide()
	table.insert(self.ar_list, range)
end

function local_class:get_large_rock_holder()
	for idx = #self.rock_holders, 1, -1 do
		local holder = self.rock_holders[idx]
		if holder.is_enhanced then
			return holder
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_large_rock_vfo()
	if #self.large_rock_vfo_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.large_rock_vfo_list)
	else
		local v = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		v.Name = string.format("%s", "balock_large_rock")
		v.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(2, 1.5, 2))
		v.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		v.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		return v
	end
end

function local_class:return_large_rock_vfo(vfo)
	if self.large_rock_vfo_list == nil then
		self.large_rock_vfo_list = {}
	end

	table.insert(self.large_rock_vfo_list, vfo)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.target = table.remove(new_party, pick_index)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.main_attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 휘두르기 모션 끝난 이후 락 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:update_target_direction()
		self.target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_direction, 0)
		-- 준비모션이 내려찍는 애니메이션
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)

		-- 공 발사될 위치 조정
		local look_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, look_dir)
		self.shoot_offset = unity_class.vector3.zero
		if self.character.LockedDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			self.shoot_offset.x = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		elseif self.character.LockedDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			self.shoot_offset.x = -self.character.Bounds.extents.x
		end

		--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key, nil)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.main_attack_range, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, self.target_direction, 1)
		self.main_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
	elseif next_state == self.state.smash then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 내려치기 모션 끝난 직후 action = fx_balock_lavabomb_attack 이펙트 출력
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action_key, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset)

		-- 공 생성
		self.ball_gen_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset + self.ball_gen_offset
		self.fx_ball = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.ball_key, self.ball_gen_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		-- 여기서 휘두르기 애니메이션 실행 이후
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 스매시 대기기간 끝난 이후 이쪽에서 이펙트 및 데미지
		self:smash_ground()
		if self.fx_ball ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_ball, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, vector_util.zero)
		end

		self.target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_direction, 0)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.current_combo_count = self.current_combo_count + 1

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.swing_key, self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.swing_key, self.character.Bounds.center)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 실제 발사되는 타이밍
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_ball) then
			self.fx_ball:Dispose()
			self.fx_ball = nil
		end
		self.main_shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(
				self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, --shoot pos
				self.target_direction, -- target dir
				self.current_combo_count, -- label
				-1, --distance
				nil, -- target to follow
				false, -- calc inner target
				0) -- atkmodifier
--[[				nil, -- targetpos
				0,  -- delay
				false) -- delay on damage]]
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

-- 지면을 내리쳐서 데미지 들어가는 부분
function local_class:smash_ground()

	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.character.Bounds.center, self.smash_radius, 3.5)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
			end
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.smash_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.stunFactor = CS.Oak.DamageStunConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.stunDuration = 0.2
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self.is_smashed = true
	self.smash_time_passed = 0
	-- 바닥 찍힘. 이 시점에 프로젝타일 출력 할것.
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)

end

function local_class:update_target_direction()
	if self.target ~= nil then
		self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))
	else
		self.target_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self:update_target_direction()
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.main_attack_range, self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset, self.target_direction, 1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.main_attack_range))

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.smash)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.smash then
		if self.time_passed >= self.smash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
			return
		end

		local distance = (self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset - self.ball_gen_pos).magnitude
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.smash_duration)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)

		local ball_pos = self.ball_gen_pos + vector_util.up * (distance * progress)
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_ball, ball_pos, vector_util.zero)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.swing_duration then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				if self.current_combo_count < self.max_combo_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.main_shoot_helper == nil or self.sub_shoot_helper == nil then
		return
	end
		-- 직사 프로젝타일
	if label <= self.max_combo_count then
		if not is_unity_null(hit_info.target) then
			-- 2페이즈에서 벽에 부딛힌 경우 곡사 프로젝타일 발사를 위해서
			if hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
				if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
					local point_offset =  hit_info.position - self.character.Position
					self.sub_shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(self.target.Position, point_offset, label + self.max_combo_count)

					local pick_range = self.sub_attack_ranges[label]
					local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(self.target.Position):GetHeightAt(self.target.Position)
					battle_range_util.setup_by_position(pick_range, self.target.Position, floor_height)

					local dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position, 0))
					local arrive_time = dist / self.sub_projectile_speed
					pick_range:Show(arrive_time)
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, pick_range))
				end
				stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.splash_key, hit_info.position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.splash_key, hit_info.position)
			end
		end
		self.main_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	else
		-- 곡사 프로젝타일
		local idx = label - self.max_combo_count
		local pick_range = self.sub_attack_ranges[idx]
		pick_range:Hide(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, pick_range))
		--현재 히트시 이펙트 존재하지 않음.
		local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(hit_info.position):GetHeightAt(hit_info.position)
		local mod_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hit_info.position, floor_height)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.break_key, mod_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.break_key, mod_pos)
		self.sub_shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.main_projectile_name = nil
	self.main_projectile_width = nil
	self.sub_projectile_name = nil
	self.sub_projectile_range = nil
	self.max_combo_count = nil
	self.camera_shake_magnitude = nil
	self.camera_shake_duration = nil
	self.main_shoot_helper = nil
	self.sub_shoot_helper = nil
	self.sub_projectile_speed = nil
	self.main_attack_range = nil
	self.sub_attack_ranges = nil
	self.phase = nil
	self.target_direction = nil
	self.current_phase = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.action_key = nil
	self.post_key = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

	self.target = target

	self:set_ailment_resist()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)

function local_class:force_cancel()
	if self.fx_trail ~= nil then
		self.fx_trail:Dispose()
		self.fx_trail = nil
	end

	if self.fx_stalactite_shadow ~= nil then
		self.fx_stalactite_shadow:Dispose()
		self.fx_stalactite_shadow = nil
	end

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'earthquake_sound_fadeout'}))
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:reset_ailment()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.tracking_range ~= nil then
		self.tracking_range:Hide()
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리

		if next_state ~= self.state.jump then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		if next_state ~= self.state.fly then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		if next_state ~= self.state.impact then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')

	elseif next_state == self.state.jump then
		self.jump_start_pos = self.character.Position
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.jump_degree, vector_util.back).normalized
		self.jump_direction = rot * vector_util.up
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dust', self.character.Position)
		self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('trail', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero, self.character.Transform)
		self.fx_trail.transform.localEulerAngles = unity_class.vector3(0, -self.jump_degree, 0)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.jump_key, self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.fly then
		self.tracking_range:Show()
		if self.fx_trail ~= nil then
			self.fx_trail:Dispose()
			self.fx_trail = nil
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.fall then
		-- 끼이는 위치라면 보정해서 fall
		self.tracking_range:Hide()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.fall_end_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.fly_duration - self.tracking_duration)
		self.fall_ani_start = false

		self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('trail_in', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero, self.character.Transform)
		self.fx_trail.transform.localEulerAngles = unity_class.vector3(0, self.fall_degree, 0)
		-- 위치 상관 없이 플레이 하도록 함.
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.inair_key, self.zone_bound.center)
		self:check_obstacle_escape()

	elseif next_state == self.state.impact then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.safe_zone:Hide()
		self:publish_impact_damage()
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)

		if self.fx_stalactite_shadow ~= nil then
			self.fx_stalactite_shadow:Dispose()
			self.fx_stalactite_shadow = nil
		end

		if self.fx_trail ~= nil then
			self.fx_trail:Dispose()
			self.fx_trail = nil
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, self.character.Position)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_left))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_right))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_up))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_down))
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'earthquake_sound_fadeout'}))
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self:reset_ailment()
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('groggy')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.jump)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.jump then
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_distance / self.jump_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		self.character.Position = self.jump_start_pos + self.jump_direction * (self.jump_distance * progress)
		self.spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, -self.character.Position.y + 0.03, 0)

		if progress >= 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.fly)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fly then
		if self.time_passed >= self.fly_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fall)
			return
		end

		if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
			self.fall_end_pos = self.target.Position
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.tracking_range, self.fall_end_pos)
		end

		self:set_safe_zone(false)
		self:set_danger_zone(self.safe_zone_bound)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fall then
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.fall_distance / self.fall_speed)
		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
		self.character.Position = self.fall_start_pos + self.fall_direction * (self.fall_distance * progress)
		self.spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, -self.character.Position.y + 0.03, 0)

		self:set_safe_zone(true)

		-- attack ani 재생
		if progress >= 1 - self.fall_ani_start_per and self.fall_ani_start == false then
			self.fall_ani_start = true
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		end

		if progress >= 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.impact)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.impact then
		self:change_state(self.state.groggy)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:publish_impact_damage()
	local rock_holder = self.erupted_lava_action.MetaTable:get_large_rock_holder()
	if rock_holder == nil then
		-- TODO FIXME buff 검사 추가해야함
		-- 바로 데미지 맥임
		if not self.meteor_calculator.IsStarted then
			self.meteor_calculator:Start()
		end
		self.meteor_calculator.Position = self.fall_end_pos

		local objects = self.meteor_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- continue 문 조심
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then goto continue end
			if character_util.has_active_buff(fo, 'expedition_damage_immune') then goto continue end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			local hp = character_util.get_max_hp_mod(fo)
			local shield = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield
			local kill_damage = math.floor((hp + shield) * 2)

			damage_info.damage = kill_damage
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			::continue::
		end
		self.meteor_calculator:End()
		return
	end

	if self.hit_target_list ~= nil then
		self.hit_target_list = nil
	end
	self.hit_target_list = {}

	rock_holder:force_destroy()

	if not self.meteor_calculator.IsStarted then
		self.meteor_calculator:Start()
	end
	self.meteor_calculator.Position = self.fall_end_pos

	local objects = self.meteor_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- continue 문 조심
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then goto continue end
		if character_util.has_active_buff(fo, 'expedition_damage_immune') then goto continue end
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.safe_zone_bound, fo.Position) then goto continue end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		local hp = character_util.get_max_hp_mod(fo)
		local shield = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield
		local kill_damage = math.floor((hp + shield) * 2)

		damage_info.damage = kill_damage
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		::continue::
	end
	self.meteor_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:check_hit_target(target)
	for _,v in pairs(self.hit_target_list) do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(v, target) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_danger_zone(bounds)
	local y_pos = self.target.Position.y

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.danger_zone_left, vector(bounds.min.x - 20, 0, bounds.center.z), y_pos)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.danger_zone_right, vector(bounds.max.x + 20, 0, bounds.center.z), y_pos)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.danger_zone_up, vector(bounds.center.x, 0, bounds.min.z - 20), y_pos)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.danger_zone_down, vector(bounds.center.x, 0, bounds.max.z + 20), y_pos)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_left))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_right))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_up))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.danger_zone_down))
end

function local_class:set_safe_zone(enable)
	local rock_holder = self.erupted_lava_action.MetaTable:get_large_rock_holder()
	if rock_holder == nil or rock_holder.current_state ~= 5 then
		if self.fx_stalactite_shadow ~= nil then
			self.fx_stalactite_shadow:Dispose()
			self.fx_stalactite_shadow = nil
		end
		return
	end

	local rock_pos = rock_holder.position
	if self.fx_stalactite_shadow == nil then
		self.fx_stalactite_shadow = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stalactite_big_shadow", rock_pos)
	end

	local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(rock_pos - self.fall_end_pos).normalized
	local target_pos = rock_pos + (dir * self.safe_zone_distance)
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_stalactite_shadow, target_pos, vector_util.zero)
	self.safe_zone_bound.center = target_pos

	if enable then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.safe_zone, target_pos)
		self.safe_zone:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:check_obstacle_escape()
	local pivot = self.character.Bounds.center - self.character.Position
	local extents_x = self.character.Bounds.extents.x
	local extents_z = self.character.Bounds.extents.z

	-- top
	if self.fall_end_pos.z + pivot.z + extents_z > self.zone_bound.max.z then
		local diff = self.fall_end_pos.z + pivot.z + extents_z - self.zone_bound.max.z
		self.fall_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fall_end_pos.x, self.fall_end_pos.y, self.fall_end_pos.z - diff - 0.5)
	end

	-- right
	if self.fall_end_pos.x + pivot.x + extents_x > self.zone_bound.max.x then
		local diff = self.fall_end_pos.x + pivot.x + extents_x - self.zone_bound.max.x
		self.fall_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fall_end_pos.x - diff - 0.5, self.fall_end_pos.y, self.fall_end_pos.z)
	end

	-- bot
	if self.fall_end_pos.z + pivot.z - extents_z < self.zone_bound.min.z then
		local diff = self.fall_end_pos.z + pivot.z - extents_z - self.zone_bound.min.z
		self.fall_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fall_end_pos.x, self.fall_end_pos.y, self.fall_end_pos.z - diff + 0.5)
	end

	-- left
	if self.fall_end_pos.x + pivot.x - extents_x < self.zone_bound.min.x then
		local diff = self.fall_end_pos.x + pivot.x - extents_x - self.zone_bound.min.x
		self.fall_end_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.fall_end_pos.x - diff + 0.5, self.fall_end_pos.y, self.fall_end_pos.z)
	end

	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.fall_degree, vector_util.forward).normalized
	local s_dir = rot * vector_util.up

	self.fall_start_pos = self.fall_end_pos + self.fall_distance * s_dir
	self.fall_direction = (self.fall_end_pos - self.fall_start_pos).normalized
	self.character.Position = self.fall_start_pos
end


function local_class:on_party_switch_event(e)
	self.target = e.CurrentParty.Leader
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.meteor_calculator = nil
	self.hit_target_list = nil

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.target_direction = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	if self.on_expedition_event_func then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_expedition_event_func)
		self.on_expedition_event_func = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	}

	self.post_key = 'post'

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.target_direction = nil

	-- 상태 초기화

function local_class:is_loaded()

end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)

end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟의 4way 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction_util.to_vector3(direction))
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.action_key, self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.action_key, self.character.Bounds.center)
		stage_camera:Shake(self.camera_shake_magnitude, self.camera_shake_duration)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		--state exit 에서 처리 안하고 enter 에서 처리 할수 있도록..
		self:start_ignition()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:start_ignition()
	local zone = battle_util.get_zone(self.character.Position)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, {'start_ignition', self.character.Name, zone.Name }))
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)
end

function local_class:create_gimmick_object(index_number)
	-- HACK: 풀링 한 오브젝트에 FieldObject 컴포넌트 직접 붙여서 내부에서 핸들링
	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.gimmick_key, self.default_gimmick_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	local go = effect.gameObject
	local fo = go:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObject))

	--fo.Position = self.default_gimmick_position
	fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(self.gimmick_size)
	fo.Name = 'balock_prision_' .. index_number

	-- 타격 가능한 물체
	fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

	-- 오브젝트 스펙 생성
	local fo_spec = CS.Oak.FieldObjectSpec()
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecHpBase(fo_spec, self.gimmick_max_hp)
	fo_spec = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.SetFieldObjectSpecGrowthRate(fo_spec, 1)

	--기본 NullFieldObjectStatsBehaviour 이기 때문에 새로 설정함.
	local stats_behaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour()
	stats_behaviour.FieldObjectSpec = fo_spec
	fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour = stats_behaviour

	-- 데미지 1씩 들어가도록
	fo.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.FieldObjectConstantDamagedBehaviour()
	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	go:SetActive(false)

	local gimmick_object = { }
	gimmick_object.fx = effect
	gimmick_object.fo = fo

	return gimmick_object
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.gimmick_pool_size = self.charge_count + 1
	for i = 1, self.gimmick_pool_size do
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(i)
		table.insert(self.lock_target_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone_bound)
	self.zone_bounds = zone_bound
end

function local_class:set_phase(phase)
	self.current_phase = phase
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	self.target = target
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position, 0)  - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	info:AppendDirection(direction)
	info:AppendTarget(target)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.current_charge_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide(0)
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
		self.fx_charge:Dispose()
	end
	self.fx_charge = nil

	self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
	-- 보스의 배틀액션이 캔슬되었을때 lock 된 캐릭터들은 기믹의 유지시간이 지났을때 릴리즈 되어야 하므로 여기에서 릴리즈 하지 않음.
	-- 중간에 캔슬된 경우 캐릭터들 조작 원상복구 해야 함.
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			-- 취소되서 순서가 꼬인경우 어택레인지 종료
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil
		if self.sfx_charge ~= nil then
			self.sfx_charge:FadeOut()
			self.sfx_charge = nil
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		stage_camera:CancelShake(self.camera_shake_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 반복 위해서 여기서 타겟 재설정
		self.current_charge_count = self.current_charge_count + 1

		-- 돌진 타겟 선정 시 가장 먼 AI 파티원을 타겟으로 잡는다
		-- 파티원이 없을 경우(사망 등) 메뉴얼 캐릭터를 타겟으로 삼고 기믹은 사용하지 않는다
		if self.current_charge_count <= self.charge_count then
			-- 최대 탐색 갯수를 알기위해 fo list 를 받아올거라면 그냥 여기서 다 처리 하는 편이 나을것.
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.zone_bounds, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			local target = nil
			local dist = 0
			for i, v in pairs(fo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, v) and not battle_util.is_manual_local(v) then
					local tmp_dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0), vector_util.get_x0z(v.Position, 0))
					if tmp_dist > dist then
						dist = tmp_dist
						target = v
					end
				end
			end
			fo_list:Dispose()
			if target == nil then
				self.target = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance.UserParty.Leader
			else
				self.target = target
				self:init_gimmick()
			end
		else
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
				-- 마지막 플레이어에게 돌격 할때는 lock 걸지 않음.
				self.target = CS.Oak.PartyManager.Instance.UserParty.Leader
			end
		end

		local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0)  - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))
		self.target_direction = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.ModifyChargeDirection(self.zone_bounds, self.character.Bounds, direction)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction, 1)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		local side_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, side_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_key, self.character.Position)

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction

		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.start_position = self.character.Position
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.action_key)
		self.fx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)
		self.sfx_charge = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key, self.character.Position)

		-- 어차피 cancle 될것이기 때문에 시간 넉넉하게
		local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
		shake_info.name = self.camera_shake_key
		shake_info.magnitude = self.camera_shake_magnitude
		shake_info.duration = 20
		stage_camera:Shake(shake_info)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_battle_action, self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	-- 기믹은 해당 배틀액션 종료 되더라도 동작하고 있어야 함.
	self:update_gimmick(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 돌진 업데이트
		self:update_charge(dt)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	local distance = vector_util.distance(self.start_position, self.character.Position)
	if distance <= self.charge_length then

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = self.target_direction
		move_info.magnitude = self.charge_length / self.action_duration * dt * self.charge_speed

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

				-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
				local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
				local xz_move_direction = self.target_direction:GetXz().normalized
				local knock_direction
				if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_direction
				else
					knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_direction
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				-- 타겟과 같다면 릴리즈 하는데..
				self:release_gimmick(fo)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	else
		-- 이동 종료하고 이후 단계로
		self:check_next_charge()
	end
end

function local_class:check_next_charge()
	local count = self.charge_count
	if self.current_phase == self.phase.two then
		count = count + 1
	end
	if self.current_charge_count < count then
		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
	else
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	-- 이벤트
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 벽에 부딛히면 종료
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if not is_unity_null(blocker) then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					-- 부딛힌게 벽이면 이동 종료하고 post 로
					self:check_next_charge()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroy(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.character) then
		-- 보스의 사망판정이라면 속박 걸려있는 모든 캐릭터를 풀어줌.
		if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
			for i = #self.gimmick_list, 1, -1 do
				self:release_gimmick(self.gimmick_list[i].target)
			end
		end
	else
		self:release_gimmick(e.FieldObject)
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switch_event(e)
		-- 파티가 변경되었다면 기존에 기믹에 걸려있는 캐릭터들의 상태를 해제한다.
	if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
		for i = #self.gimmick_list, 1, -1 do
			self:release_gimmick(self.gimmick_list[i].target)
		end
	end
	-- 그리고 타겟이 잘못되었을 것이므로 타겟 재설정 해봄
	-- 어차피 prepare 단계에서 새로 잡게 될 것이지만..
	local new_party = { }
	for i = 0, e.CurrentParty.Count-1 do
		if not character_util.is_dead(e.CurrentParty[i]) then
			table.insert(new_party, e.CurrentParty[i])
		end
	end
	local pick_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, #new_party)
	self.target = table.remove(new_party, pick_index)
end

function local_class:get_gimmick_object()
	if #self.lock_target_gimmick_pool_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.lock_target_gimmick_pool_list)
	else
		self.gimmick_pool_size = self.gimmick_pool_size + 1
		local gimmick_object = self:create_gimmick_object(self.gimmick_pool_size)
		return gimmick_object
	end
end

function local_class:return_gimmick_object(gimmick_object)
	gimmick_object.fo.Position = self.default_gimmick_position
	gimmick_object.fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	table.insert(self.lock_target_gimmick_pool_list, gimmick_object)
end

function local_class:init_gimmick()
	local gimmick_object = self:get_gimmick_object()
	local fo = gimmick_object.fo

	-- 기믹 활성화 하는 시점에 heal 을 해준다.
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = self.gimmick_max_hp
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = fo

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

	fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	fo.Position = self.target.Position
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.gimmick_key, fo.Position)

	local gimmick = { }
	gimmick.gimmick_object = gimmick_object
	gimmick.target = self.target
	gimmick.time_passed = 0
	-- 기믹 업데이트 시작 했는지 여부
	gimmick.is_start = true
	self:lock_target(gimmick.target)
	table.insert(self.gimmick_list, gimmick)

	-- 마커 표시
	CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('prison', 0, false, fo)
end

function local_class:update_gimmick(dt)
	if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
		for i, v in pairs(self.gimmick_list) do
			if v.is_start then
				-- 포지션 락
				-- 다른 액션에 의해 (넉백 등) 밀리고 있는 경우 캐릭터의 위치를 고정시키기 위함.
				v.target.Position = v.gimmick_object.fo.Position
				v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
				if v.time_passed > self.gimmick_max_duration then
					self:release_gimmick(v.target)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_gimmick_list()
	if not self.gimmick_list == nil then
		if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
			for i = #self.gimmick_list, 1, -1 do
				self:return_gimmick_object(self.gimmick_list[i].gimmick_object)
				table.remove(self.gimmick_list, i)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 타겟 락
function local_class:lock_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 캐릭터 조작 금지

		--애니메이션 세트, 루프
		target:SetAnimation('damaged', true)
		--persistant 배틀 액션류는 EndBattleAction 호출하여 종료 처리 해야 함.
		-- 배틀액션 캔슬 되기 전에 호출 해야 한다.
		target.CharacterBehaviour:EndAllPersistentBattleActions()
		target.CharacterBehaviour:CancelAllBattleActions(true)

		-- 스피드캡 버프
		buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name, 1, false, false)
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 입력을 막음
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RequestDisableControl(target, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Suspended
		end
	end
end

-- 타겟 락 해제
function local_class:release_target(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		-- 애니메이션 제거
		target:RemoveAnimation()
		-- 스피드캡 버프 제거
		buff_manager:RemoveBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, target, self.speed_cap_buff_name)

		if battle_util.is_manual_local(target) then
			-- 현재 조작하는 캐릭터라면 막혀있던 입력을 풀어줌
			target.FieldObjectController.CurrentState:RemoveDisableControl(target)
		else
			local controller = target.FieldObjectController
			cast(controller, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectController))
			controller.FieldObjectControllerState = CS.Oak.FieldObjectControllerState.Enabled
		end

		-- 마커 제거
		CS.Oak.UIQuestMarkersController.Instance:RemoveQuestMarker('prison')
	end
end

-- 기믹 제거
function local_class:release_gimmick(target)
	if #self.gimmick_list > 0 then
		for i, v in pairs(self.gimmick_list) do
			-- 타겟과 현재 부딛힌 타겟이 같다면
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.target, target) or lua_helper.reference_equals(v.gimmick_object.fo, target) then
				local gimmick = table.remove(self.gimmick_list, i)

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.break_key, target.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.break_key, target.Position)
				-- 오브젝트 재사용 가능하도록 리셋
				self:release_target(gimmick.target)
				self:return_gimmick_object(gimmick.gimmick_object)

				gimmick.target = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	if not is_unity_null(self.target) then

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟의 4way 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction_util.to_vector3(direction))
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

	self.move_speed = 0
	self.current_melee_count = 0

	local new_party = { }

-- 0.5초마다 설치 ,
function local_class:update_explosion(dt)
	local activation_count = 0

	for i = #self.explosions, 1, -1 do
		local v = self.explosions[i]
		if not self.is_explosion_next_step then
			if self.current_explosion_index == v.index and not v.start then
				-- 딜레이만큼 표시
				v.start = true
				-- 현재 self.current_explosion_index 에 맞는 폭탄이 전부 활성화 되었는지 체크하기 위한 카운트
				activation_count = activation_count + 1
			end
		end

		if v.start then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			-- 첫번쩨 타이밍 동안 대기 후 폭발
			if v.time_passed >= self.explosion_set_time then
				self:damage(v)
				table.remove(self.explosions , i)
			end
		end

		if activation_count == self.explosion_line_count and not self.is_explosion_next_step then
			self.is_explosion_next_step = true
		end
	end

	if self.is_explosion_next_step then
		if self.current_explosion_index <= self.explosion_count_per_line then
			self.explosion_interval_time_passed = self.explosion_interval_time_passed + dt
			if self.explosion_interval_time_passed >= self.explosion_interval then
				-- 인터벌 타임 지나서 다음 스텝
				self.is_explosion_next_step = false
				self.current_explosion_index = self.current_explosion_index + 1
				self.explosion_interval_time_passed = 0
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 폭파될때
function local_class:damage(explosion)
	if explosion == nil then
		return
	end

	explosion.start = false

	local fx_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(explosion.position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0)
	fx_dir = vector_util.normalized(fx_dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.explosion_key, explosion.position, fx_dir)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_key, explosion.position)

	local candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(explosion.position, self.explosion_attack_radius)
	for index = 0, candidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = candidates[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 쿨타임 확인
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = vector_util.get_x0z(explosion.position - fo.Position).normalized

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end

	candidates:Dispose()
end

function local_class:init_explosions()
	self:clear_explosions()
	self.current_explosion_index = 1
	-- 생성이 아니라 위치 배치..
	for i = 1, self.explosion_line_count do
		-- 각 라인별로 explosion_count_per_line 갯수만큼.
		for j = 1, self.explosion_count_per_line do
			--폭발 반경 계산시의 회전각도
			-- 주어진 각도로 라인 카운트 만큼 계산 후 최종적으로 self.explosion_angle * (self.explosion_line_count - 1) / 2 만큼 역회전 시켜 최종 위치를 구한다.
			local rot_angle =  self.explosion_angle * (i - 1)
			rot_angle = rot_angle - (self.explosion_angle * (self.explosion_line_count - 1) / 2)
			-- 타겟 방향
			local rot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rot_angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
					* vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_direction, 0)

			local attack_position = self.character.Position
					+ vector_util.get_x0z(rot_dir * (self.explosion_attack_radius * j * 2), 0)
			-- 기존 휘두루기 어택레인지만큼 더 전진 시켜야 한다.
					+ vector_util.get_x0z(rot_dir * self.melee_attack_radius * 0.5, 0)

			local explosion = {
				line = i,
				index = j,
				position = attack_position,
				start = false,
				time_passed = 0,
			}
			table.insert(self.explosions, explosion)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:clear_explosions()
	if self.explosions ~= nil then
		if #self.explosions > 0 then
			for i = #self.explosions, 1 -1 do
				table.remove(self.explosions, i)
			end
		end
	end

	self.explosions = { }
end
function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self:update_explosion(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.current_prepare_state == self.prepare_state.pre then
			-- 이전 스테이트
			self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.melee_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
			local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_direction)
			if self.character.LockedDirection ~= dir then
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
			end
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_delay_duration then
				self.current_prepare_state = self.prepare_state.post
			end
		else
			-- post 스테이트에서는 공격범위 위치 업데이트 하지 않는다.
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.attack_1)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_1 then
		--첫번째 공격
		self:update_attack(dt)
		if not self.is_slash_fx_run then
			if self.time_passed >= self.slash_fx_delay then
				local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0)
				if self.effect_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_2_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				else
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_1_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				end
				self.is_slash_fx_run = true
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.swing_duration then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
				if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.attack_2)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare_next_1)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_next_1 then

		if self.current_prepare_state == self.prepare_state.pre then
			-- 이전 스테이트
			self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.melee_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
			local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_direction)
			if self.character.LockedDirection ~= dir then
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
			end
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_delay_duration then
				self.current_prepare_state = self.prepare_state.post
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
				if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
					self:change_state(self.state.attack_2)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_2 then
		-- 두번째 공격
		self:update_attack(dt)
		if not self.is_slash_fx_run then
			if self.time_passed >= self.slash_fx_delay then
				local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0)
				if self.effect_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_1_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				else
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_2_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				end
				self.is_slash_fx_run = true
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.swing_duration then
			if self.current_phase == self.phase.one then
				if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
					-- 공격 카운트 끝나지 않았으면 다시 반대편 공격
					self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.post)
				end
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare_next_2)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_next_2 then
		if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
			-- 공격 카운트 끝나지 않았으면 다시 반대편 공격
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			-- 동작 다 끝나면 폭팔 끝날때까지 대기했다가 최종 상태로
			if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)

	local distance = vector_util.distance(self.start_position, self.character.Position)
	-- 일정 거리만큼만 움직이면서 공격
	if distance <= self.melee_attack_move_length then
		-- 공격중 전진 있으므로..
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.attack_calculator, self.character.Position)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.attack_calculator, self.target_direction)

		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.melee_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.melee_attack_range = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.melee_damage_modifier = nil
	self.melee_attack_move_length = nil
	self.melee_attack_radius = nil
	self.move_speed = nil
	self.melee_count = nil
	self.current_melee_count = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.explosion_damage_modifier = nil
	self.explosion_attack_radius = nil
	self.explosion_interval = nil
	self.explosion_line_count = nil
	self.explosion_count_per_line = nil
	self.explosion_first_time = nil
	self.explosion_second_time = nil
	self.explosion_angle = nil

	self.phase = nil
	self.start_position = nil
	self.explosion_duration = nil
	self.prepare_key = nil
	self.attack_1_key = nil
	self.attack_2_key = nil
	self.post_key = nil
	self.explosion_key = nil
	self.field_key = nil
	self.explosions = nil
	self.target_direction = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:update_hook_shot(progress, character_pos)
	if self.hook_shot_effect == nil or self.hook_shot == nil then
		return
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - character_pos)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	local from = character_pos + direction * self.offset_forward
	local to = from * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress
	self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(from, to)

	if progress <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local from_to_diff = to - from
	if vector_util.is_almost_zero(from_to_diff) then
		return
	end

	local up_dir = vector_util.normalized(unity_class.vector3(0, 1, -1))
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(from_to_diff)
	local rot = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(dir, up_dir)

	self.hook_shot_effect.transform.rotation = rot
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_up)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_up then
		if self.time_passed < self.shoot_up_duration then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.shoot_up_duration
			self:update_hook_shot(progress, self.character.Position)
		else
			self:update_hook_shot(1, self.character.Position)
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.move_duration))
		local height_before = self.character.Position.y
		local prev_pos = self.character.Position
		self.character.Position = self:bezier(progress, self.control_points)
		self.character.Direction = prev_pos.x < self.character.Position.x and CS.Oak.Direction.Right or CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		self:update_hook_shot(1, self.character.Position)

		if height_before < 1.5 and self.character.Position.y >= 1.5 then
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		end

		if progress == 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.aim)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.aim then
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.target_pos)
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local move_amount = math.min(dist, self.aim_chase_speed * dt)
		self.target_pos = self.target_pos + dir * move_amount
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		if self.time_passed >= self.aim_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_down)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_down then
		if self.time_passed < self.shoot_down_duration then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.shoot_down_duration
			self:update_hook_shot(progress, self.character.Position)
		else
			self:apply_damage(self.target_pos, self.hook_knock_back_factor, self.hook_knock_back_force)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('chain', self.target_pos)
			self:update_hook_shot(1, self.character.Position)
			self:change_state(self.state.stomp)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stomp then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.stomp_duration))
		self.character.Position = self.stomp_start_pos * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress
		self:update_hook_shot(1, self.character.Position)

		if progress == 1 then
			self:apply_damage(self.target_pos, self.stomp_knock_back_factor, self.stomp_knock_back_force)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('stomp', self.target_pos)
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:apply_damage(target_pos, knock_back_factor, knock_back_force)
	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(target_pos, self.damage_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - target_pos))

			if vector_util.magnitude(direction) == 0 then
				direction = unity_class.vector3.right
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, fo) and self.damage_modifier or self.party_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.stomp_preset_name, target_pos)
	stage_camera:Shake(0.15, 0.1)
end

function local_class:reset_character_position()
	local pos = self.character.Position
	local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(pos):GetHeightAt(pos)
	self.character.Position = unity_class.vector3(
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(pos.x, self.battle_zone_bound.min.x, self.battle_zone_bound.max.x),
			floor_height,
			unity_class.mathf.Clamp(pos.z, self.battle_zone_bound.min.z, self.battle_zone_bound.max.z)
	)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
	self.battle_zone_bound = nil

	self.factorials = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:get_n_factorial(n)
	if n == 0 then
		return 1
	end

	local length = #self.factorials
	if n <= length then
		return self.factorials[n]
	end

	while length ~= n do
		table.insert(self.factorials, self.factorials[length] * (length + 1))
		length = length + 1
	end

	return self.factorials[n]
end

function local_class:binomial(n, i)
	local a1 = self:get_n_factorial(n)
	local a2 = self:get_n_factorial(i)
	local a3 = self:get_n_factorial(n - i)
	return a1 / (a2 * a3)
end

function local_class:bezier(t, control_points)
	local n = #control_points - 1

	if n == 0 then
		return control_points[1]
	end
	if t <= 0 then
		return control_points[1]
	end
	if t >= 1 then
		return control_points[n + 1]
	end

	local res = unity_class.vector3.zero
	for i = 0, n do
		res = res + self:binomial(n, i) * t ^ i * (1 - t) ^ (n - i) * control_points[i + 1]
	end

	return res
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then

		local target_pos, dist = self:get_marker_pos_furthest()
		dist = math.max(dist - self.offset_forward, 0)

		local start_pos = self.character.Position + direction * self.offset_forward
		self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(start_pos,
				unity_class.vector2(dist, self.chain_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, start_pos, direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		self.target_pos = target_pos

		self.shoot_duration = dist / self.chain_projectile_speed

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = self.character.Position
		info.DamageTerm = -1

		self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
