function local_class:rotate_vector_xz(input_vector, angle)
	return unity_class.vector3(
			input_vector.x * math.cos(angle) - input_vector.z * math.sin(angle),0,
			input_vector.x * math.sin(angle) + input_vector.z * math.cos(angle))
end

function local_class:update_velocity(dt)
	local target_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - self.character.Position)
	self.speed_forward = math.max(0, self.speed_forward + dt * self.accel_forward)
	self.speed_toward_target = self.speed_toward_target + dt * self.accel_toward_target
	local angle = self.clockwise and - self.angle_forward or self.angle_forward
	local forward_direction = self:rotate_vector_xz(target_direction, angle)
	self.velocity = forward_direction * self.speed_forward + target_direction * self.speed_toward_target
end

function local_class:update_hook_shot(progress)
	if self.hook_shot == nil then
		return
	end

	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - self.character.Position)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	local from = self.character.Position + direction * self.offset_forward
	local to = from * (1 - progress) + self.target_pos * progress
	self.hook_shot:SetFromTo(from, to)

	self.collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(progress * vector_util.magnitude(diff), 2, self.chain_width)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	self.attack_calculator.Direction = direction

	return direction
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 발사 후 착탄 대기
		if self.time_passed < self.shoot_duration then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.shoot_duration
			local direction = self:update_hook_shot(progress)
			self:update_damage_calculator(dt, direction)
		else
			local direction = self:update_hook_shot(1)
			self:update_damage_calculator(dt, direction)
			self:change_state(self.state.move)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move then
		-- 이동
		local move_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.velocity)
		local move_dist = vector_util.magnitude(self.velocity) * dt
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_move_pos - self.character.Position)
		local current_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		local move_end = false
		local look_dir = unity_class.vector3.zero
		if current_dist < move_dist then
			move_end = true
			move_dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			move_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			move_info.direction = move_dir
			move_info.magnitude = move_dist
		else
			local destination = self.character.Position + self.velocity * dt
			destination, look_dir = self:clamp_vector_in_bound(destination, self.move_bound)
			diff = vector_util.get_x0z(destination - self.character.Position)
			move_dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			move_dist = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			move_info.direction = move_dir
			move_info.magnitude = move_dist
		end
		move_info.types = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreSlope | CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameTypes.IgnoreCrash

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, CS.Oak.Direction.None,
				false, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		self:update_hook_shot(1)
		self:update_damage_calculator(dt, move_dir)

		if move_end then
			self.velocity = unity_class.vector3.zero
			self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(look_dir)
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:update_velocity(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage_calculator(dt, direction)
	if direction == nil then
		direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, fo) and self.damage_modifier or self.party_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('hit')
			if has_value then
				damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, sfx_info.sfxName)
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:get_marker_pos_furthest()
	local furthest_marker_pos = self.battle_zone_bound.center
	local furthest_dist = 0
	local target_pos = self.target.Position
	local is_east = self.character.Position.x < target_pos.x
	local marker_list = is_east and self.east_markers or self.west_markers

	for _,pos in ipairs(marker_list) do
		local dist = vector_util.distance(vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position), vector_util.get_x0z(pos))
		if dist > furthest_dist then
			furthest_dist = dist
			furthest_marker_pos = pos
		end
	end

	return furthest_marker_pos, furthest_dist
end

function local_class:clamp_vector_in_bound(v, bound)
	local min = bound.min
	local max = bound.max
	local dir = unity_class.vector3.zero
	local res = v

	if v.x <= min.x then
		res.x = min.x
		dir = dir + unity_class.vector3.left
	elseif v.x >= max.x then
		res.x = max.x
		dir = dir + unity_class.vector3.right
	end

	if v.z <= min.z then
		res.z = min.z
		dir = dir + unity_class.vector3.back
	elseif v.z >= max.z then
		res.z = max.z
		dir = dir + unity_class.vector3.forward
	end

	return res, dir
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.state = nil

	self.battle_zone_bound = nil
	self.move_bound = nil
	self.east_markers = nil
	self.west_markers = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone_bound = bound
	self.move_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(bound.center, bound.size - bounds_util.get_size(self.character))
end

function local_class:set_marker_list(marker_list)
	if marker_list == nil or self.battle_zone_bound == nil then return end

	local center = self.battle_zone_bound.center

local local_class = newclass('BossBgeneralHookSentenceBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level
	self.params_dict = params

	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		prepare = 1,
		shoot = 2,
		pull_prepare = 3,
		pull = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.pull_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PreparePullDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0)
	self.chain_projectile_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChainSpeed", 30)
	self.chain_projectile_pull_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChainPullSpeed", self.chain_projectile_speed)

	self.chain_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChainWidth", 1)
	self.spread = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Spread", 1)

	self.offset_forward = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ChainOffsetForward", 0.5)

	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.party_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PartyDamageModifier", 1)
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackFactor", 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1)

	self.hook_shot_preset_name = 'hook'

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return target ~= nil
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end
	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self.target = nil
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- Exit Current State
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		-- 어택레인지 제거
		for i, attack_range in ipairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			attack_range:Hide()
			self.attack_range_list[i] = nil
		end
		self.attack_range_list = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if next_state ~= self.state.pull_prepare then
			for i, hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(hook.effect)
				hook.attack_calculator:End()
				self.hook_effect_list[i] = nil
			end
			self.hook_effect_list = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pull_prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if next_state ~= self.state.pull then
			for i, hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(hook.effect)
				hook.attack_calculator:End()
				self.hook_effect_list[i] = nil
			end
			self.hook_effect_list = nil
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pull then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		for i, hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(hook.effect)
			hook.attack_calculator:End()
			self.hook_effect_list[i] = nil
		end
		self.hook_effect_list = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- Enter Next State
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + dir * self.offset_forward
		local dist, target_pos = self:get_ray_dist_to_bound(shoot_pos, dir, self.battle_zone_bound)
		self.target_list = self:pick_closest_marker_pos_list(target_pos, 2, self.spread)
		table.insert(self.target_list, {distance = dist, position = target_pos})

		self.attack_range_list = {
			CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(shoot_pos,
				unity_class.vector2(dist, self.chain_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		}
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[1], shoot_pos, dir)
		self.attack_range_list[1]:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		for _, marker in ipairs(self.target_list) do
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(marker.position - self.character.Position)
			local start_pos = self.character.Position + direction * self.offset_forward
			local distance = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(marker.position - start_pos))
			local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(start_pos,
					unity_class.vector2(distance, self.chain_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(attack_range, start_pos, direction)
			attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
			table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)
		end

		--- set locked direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		self.hook_effect_list = {}
		for _, marker in ipairs(self.target_list) do
			local hook_shot_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.hook_shot_preset_name, self.character.Position)
			local hook_shot = hook_shot_effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.HookShot))
			local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
			info.Center = self.character.Position
			info.DamageTerm = -1
			info.Duration = 99
			info.Size = unity_class.vector3(0, 2, self.chain_width)
			info.IsCenterToSide = true
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(marker.position - self.character.Position)
			local distance = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			local attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
			attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			attack_calculator.Direction = direction
			attack_calculator:Start()
			local shoot_duration = math.max(0, distance - self.offset_forward + 0.5) / self.chain_projectile_speed
			table.insert(self.hook_effect_list, {
				effect = hook_shot_effect,
				hook_cs = hook_shot,
				target_pos = marker.position + direction * 0.5,
				collision_info = info,
				attack_calculator = attack_calculator,
				shoot_duration = shoot_duration
			})
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
	elseif next_state == self.state.pull_prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare_pull')
	elseif next_state == self.state.pull then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('pull')

		for _, hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
			hook.attack_calculator:End()
			hook.attack_calculator:Start()
			hook.shoot_duration = hook.shoot_duration * self.chain_projectile_speed / self.chain_projectile_pull_speed
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('pull')
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:update_hook_shot(hook_shot, progress)
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(hook_shot.target_pos - self.character.Position)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)

	local from = self.character.Position + direction * self.offset_forward
	local to = from * (1 - progress) + hook_shot.target_pos * progress
	hook_shot.hook_cs:SetFromTo(from, to)

	hook_shot.collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(progress * vector_util.magnitude(diff), 2, self.chain_width)
	hook_shot.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
	hook_shot.attack_calculator.Direction = direction

	return direction
end

function local_class:update_damage_calculator(attack_calculator, dt, direction)
	if direction == nil then
		direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end

	local objects = attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = lua_helper.reference_equals(user_party.Leader, fo) and self.damage_modifier or self.party_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('hit')
			if has_value then
				damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, sfx_info.sfxName)
			end

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', self.character)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- 발사 후 착탄 대기
		local finished = true
		for _,hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
			if self.time_passed < hook.shoot_duration then
				finished = false
				local progress = self.time_passed / hook.shoot_duration
				local direction = self:update_hook_shot(hook, progress)
				self:update_damage_calculator(hook.attack_calculator, dt, direction)
			else
				local direction = self:update_hook_shot(hook, 1)
				self:update_damage_calculator(hook.attack_calculator, dt, direction)
			end
		end

		if finished then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.15, 0.1)
			self:change_state(self.state.pull_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pull_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.pull_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.pull)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pull then
		local finished = true
		for _,hook in ipairs(self.hook_effect_list) do
			if self.time_passed < hook.shoot_duration then
				finished = false
				local progress = self.time_passed / hook.shoot_duration
				local direction = self:update_hook_shot(hook, 1 - progress)
				self:update_damage_calculator(hook.attack_calculator, dt, -direction)
			else
				self:update_hook_shot(hook, 0)
			end
		end

		if finished then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:pick_closest_marker_pos_list(pos, n, min_dist)
	if min_dist == nil then
		min_dist = 0
	end

	local res = {}
	for _, marker_pos in ipairs(self.marker_list) do repeat
		local dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(pos - marker_pos))

		if dist < min_dist then
			break;
		end

		if #res < n then
			table.insert(res, {distance = dist, position = marker_pos})
			if #res == n then
				table.sort(res, function(a,b) return a.distance > b.distance end)
			end
		else
			local i = 0
			for _, cached_marker in ipairs(res) do
				local cached_dist = cached_marker.distance
				if cached_dist < dist then
					break
				else
					i = i + 1
				end
			end
			if i > 0 then
				for j = 2, i do
					res[j - 1] = res[j]
				end
				res[i] = {distance = dist, position = marker_pos}
			end
		end
	until true end

	return res
end

function local_class:get_ray_dist_to_bound(pos, dir_vector3, bound)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(pos.x, pos.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > bound.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(bound.min.x,bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(bound.max.x,bound.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2),
					unity_class.vector3(intersection.x, pos.y, intersection.y)
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < bound.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(bound.min.x,bound.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(bound.max.x,bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2),
					unity_class.vector3(intersection.x, pos.y, intersection.y)
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > bound.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(bound.min.x,bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(bound.min.x,bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2),
					unity_class.vector3(intersection.x, pos.y, intersection.y)
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < bound.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(bound.max.x,bound.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(bound.max.x,bound.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2),
					unity_class.vector3(intersection.x, pos.y, intersection.y)
		end
	end
	return 0, unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	self.current_state = nil
	self.state = nil

	self.marker_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_marker_list(marker_list)
	self.marker_list = marker_list
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		if not is_unity_null(self.spawn_table[i].monster) then
			self.spawn_table[i].monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.FieldObject) then
		self:kill_all_monsters()
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	if not self:assign_monsters() then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:assign_monsters()
	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		if self.spawn_table[i].monster == nil then
			local monster = get_character(self.spawn_table[i].monster_name)
			if monster == nil then
				return false
			end

			self.spawn_table[i].monster = monster
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:dispose_thorn_action()
		self:dispose_spawn_action()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.plant_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('raise_arm')
		self.is_enhanced = self:kill_all_monsters()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:initialize_thorn_action()
		self:initialize_spawn_action()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.plant_end_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('end_arm')
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
end

function local_class:kill_all_monsters()
	local killed = false
	for _, table in ipairs(self.spawn_table) do
		if not is_unity_null(table.monster) then
			if not table.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and (table.monster.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled) then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(table.monster.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
					table.monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				else
					table.monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour()
					table.monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
				damage_info.sender = table.monster
				damage_info.target = table.monster
				damage_info.noCritical = true
				damage_info.damage = table.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('kill_monster_fx', table.monster.Position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('kill')
				table.monster.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
				killed = true
			end
		end
	end
	return killed
end

function local_class:initialize_thorn_action()
	self.current_thorn_count = 1
	if self.is_enhanced then
		self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator:Start()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.enhanced_thorn_range, self.target.Position)
		self.enhanced_thorn_range:Show(self.enhanced_thorn_interval)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.enhanced_thorn_range))
	else
		self.thorn_attack_calculator:Start()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.thorn_range, self.target.Position)
		self.thorn_range:Show(self.thorn_interval)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.thorn_range))
	end

end

function local_class:dispose_thorn_action()
	self.current_thorn_count = 0
	if self.is_enhanced then
		self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator:End()
		self.enhanced_thorn_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.enhanced_thorn_range))
	else
		self.thorn_attack_calculator:End()
		self.thorn_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.thorn_range))
	end

end

function local_class:initialize_spawn_action()
	self.spawn_done = false
	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		local ar = self.spawn_table[i].range
		local pos = self.spawn_table[i].position
		local calc = self.spawn_table[i].calculator

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos)
		battle_range_util.show(ar, self.spawn_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spawn_table[i].range))

		calc.Position = pos
		calc:Start()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_spawn_action()
	for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
		self.spawn_table[i].calculator:End()
		self.spawn_table[i].range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spawn_table[i].range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.crack_instantiate_time and self.time_passed - dt < self.crack_instantiate_time then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.crack_key, self.character.Position + vector(-2.5, 0, -2))
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.crack_key, self.character.Position + vector(2.5, 0, -2))
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('smash')

			-- [KYU] 한, 영, 일, 중 모든 보이스에 대응되었기 때문에 조건문이 필요없다 판단, 제외한다.
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self:get_sfx_name('04_dialogue_morian_09'))
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		local done = self:update_thorn(dt)
		done = self:update_spawn(dt) and done
		if done then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.state.post then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:get_sfx_name(origin_name)
	if music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage ~= 'ko' then
		return origin_name .. '_' .. music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage
	end

	return origin_name
end

function local_class:update_thorn(dt)
	return self.is_enhanced and self:update_enhanced_thorn(dt) or not self.is_enhanced and self:update_normal_thorn(dt)
end

function local_class:update_normal_thorn(dt)
	if self.current_thorn_count > self.thorn_attack_count then
		return true
	end

	if self.time_passed > self.current_thorn_count * self.thorn_interval then
		self.current_thorn_count = self.current_thorn_count + 1

		self.thorn_attack_calculator.Position = self.thorn_range.transform.position
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thorn_normal_key, self.thorn_attack_calculator.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('thorn')

		local fo_list = self.thorn_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local target = fo_list[i]

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.thorn_attack_calculator.Position))
			damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		if self.current_thorn_count > self.thorn_attack_count then
			return true
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.thorn_range, self.target.Position)
		self.thorn_range:Show(self.thorn_interval)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.thorn_range))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_enhanced_thorn(dt)
	if self.current_thorn_count > self.enhanced_thorn_attack_count then
		return true
	end

	if self.time_passed > self.current_thorn_count * self.enhanced_thorn_interval then
		self.current_thorn_count = self.current_thorn_count + 1

		self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator.Position = self.enhanced_thorn_range.transform.position
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.thorn_strong_key, self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('thorn')

		local fo_list = self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			local target = fo_list[i]

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = target
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio_enhanced)
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position - self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator.Position))
			damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		fo_list:Dispose()

		if self.current_thorn_count > self.enhanced_thorn_attack_count then
			return true
		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.enhanced_thorn_range, self.target.Position)
		self.enhanced_thorn_range:Show(self.enhanced_thorn_interval)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.enhanced_thorn_range))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:update_spawn(dt)
	if not self.spawn_done then
		if self.time_passed > self.spawn_duration + self.spawn_delay then
			self:spawn_monsters()
			self.spawn_done = true

		elseif self.time_passed > self.spawn_duration and self.time_passed - dt < self.spawn_duration then
			for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
				self.spawn_table[i].range:Hide()
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spawn_table[i].range))

				local fo_list = self.spawn_table[i].calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.spawn_key, self.spawn_table[i].position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('summon')
				for j = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
					local target = fo_list[j]

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = target
					damage_info.modifier = 0
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.spawn_table[i].position)
					damage_info.knockBackForce = self.spawn_knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()
			end

		elseif self.time_passed > self.spawn_duration then
			for i = 1, #self.spawn_table do
				local fo_list = self.spawn_table[i].calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
				for j = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
					local target = fo_list[j]

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = target
					damage_info.modifier = 0
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.spawn_table[i].position)
					damage_info.knockBackForce = self.spawn_knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()
			end
		end
	end

	return self.spawn_done
end

function local_class:spawn_monsters()
	for _, table in ipairs(self.spawn_table) do
		if table.monster.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled or
				(table.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead or not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(table.monster)) then
			table.monster.Position = table.position
			table.monster.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = table.monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = table.monster

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(table.monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(table.monster.FieldObjectController,
					CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(table.monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.spawn_table)
	self.spawn_table = nil

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)

	self.thorn_range = nil
	self.thorn_attack_calculator = nil

	self.enhanced_thorn_range = nil
	self.enhanced_thorn_attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		action = 4,

	}

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.scream_key = 'scream'
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)

	self.action_key = 'action'
	self.left_generate_pos_candidate = {}
	self.right_generate_pos_candidate = {}

	self.damage_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageRatio', 0.1)

	self.stem_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StemLength', 14)

	self.stem_speed = self.stem_length / self.stem_generate_duration
	local size = vector(self.stem_length, self.stem_width)

	self.infection_value = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'InfectionValue', 1)

	self.stem_persistent_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StemPersistentDuration', 10)

	self.stem_trace_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StemTraceTime', 1.5)
	self.stem_attack_range_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StemRangeTime', 2)

	self.left_stem_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.left_stem_range:Hide()
	self.current_left_stem_pos = nil
	self.left_stem_direction = nil
	self.left_stem_fo = nil

	self.right_stem_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.right_stem_range:Hide()
	self.current_right_stem_pos = nil
	self.right_stem_direction = nil
	self.right_stem_fo = nil

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

			self.stem_generate_duration + self.stem_persistent_duration, 0.5)

	info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(self.stem_length, 2, self.stem_width),
			self.stem_generate_duration + self.stem_persistent_duration, 0.5)
	self.right_stem_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, -1)

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)

		self:destruct_stem()
	end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		self.left_stem_range:Hide()
		self.right_stem_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.left_stem_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.right_stem_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.destruct then
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.scream_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('roar', self.character.Position + vector(0, 3, 0))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('raise_arm')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('04_dialogue_morian_10')
		stage_camera:Shake(1.5, 0.5)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self:set_random_stem_positions()

		self.left_stem_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.current_left_stem_pos))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.left_stem_range, self.current_left_stem_pos, self.left_stem_direction, self.character.Position.y)
		self.left_stem_range:Show(self.stem_attack_range_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.left_stem_range))

		self.right_stem_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.current_right_stem_pos))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.right_stem_range, self.current_right_stem_pos, self.right_stem_direction, self.character.Position.y)
		self.right_stem_range:Show(self.stem_attack_range_time)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.right_stem_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.left_stem_calculator.Position = self.current_left_stem_pos - self.left_stem_direction * self.stem_length / 2
		self.left_stem_calculator.Direction = self.left_stem_direction
		self.left_stem_calculator:Start()
		self.left_stem_fo = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				'stem1', self.current_left_stem_pos, self.left_stem_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('left_stem')

		self.right_stem_calculator.Position = self.current_right_stem_pos - self.right_stem_direction * self.stem_length / 2
		self.right_stem_calculator.Direction = self.right_stem_direction
		self.right_stem_calculator:Start()
		self.right_stem_fo = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(
				'stem1', self.current_right_stem_pos, self.right_stem_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('right_stem')

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.destruct then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	else
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end
end

function local_class:set_random_stem_positions()
	self.current_left_stem_pos = self.left_generate_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.left_generate_pos_candidate)]
	self.current_right_stem_pos = self.right_generate_pos_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.right_generate_pos_candidate)]
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.trace)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		if self.time_passed <= self.stem_trace_time then
			self:trace_manual_character()

		elseif self.time_passed > self.stem_attack_range_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed > self.stem_generate_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.destruct)
			return
		elseif self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		end

		self.left_stem_calculator.Position = self.left_stem_calculator.Position + self.left_stem_direction * self.stem_speed * dt

		self.right_stem_calculator.Position = self.right_stem_calculator.Position + self.right_stem_direction * self.stem_speed * dt
		self:update_stem(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.destruct then
		if self.time_passed > self.stem_persistent_duration then
			self:destruct_stem()
			return
		end

		self:update_stem(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:trace_manual_character()
	self.left_stem_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.current_left_stem_pos))
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.left_stem_range, self.current_left_stem_pos, self.left_stem_direction, self.character.Position.y)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.left_stem_range))

	self.right_stem_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.current_right_stem_pos))
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.right_stem_range, self.current_right_stem_pos, self.right_stem_direction, self.character.Position.y)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.right_stem_range))
end

function local_class:update_stem(dt)
	self:update_left_stem(dt)
	self:update_right_stem(dt)
end

function local_class:update_left_stem(dt)
	local fo_list = self.left_stem_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local target = fo_list[i]

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
		local target_dir = target.Position - self.left_stem_calculator.Position
		local knock_back_dir = vector(self.left_stem_direction.z, 0, -self.left_stem_direction.x)
		if self:dot(target_dir, knock_back_dir) < 0 then
			knock_back_dir = -knock_back_dir
		end
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_back_dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_right_stem(dt)
	local fo_list = self.right_stem_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local target = fo_list[i]

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.knock_back_factor
		local target_dir = target.Position - self.right_stem_calculator.Position
		local knock_back_dir = vector(self.right_stem_direction.z, 0, -self.right_stem_direction.x)
		if self:dot(target_dir, knock_back_dir) < 0 then
			knock_back_dir = -knock_back_dir
		end
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_back_dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = self.knock_back_force *  CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dot(v1, v2)
	return v1.x * v2.x + v1.y * v2.y + v1.z * v2.z
end

function local_class:destruct_stem()
	self.left_stem_calculator:End()
	self.right_stem_calculator:End()

	if self.left_stem_fo ~= nil then
		self.left_stem_fo:Dispose()
		self.left_stem_fo = nil
	end

	if self.right_stem_fo ~= nil then
		self.right_stem_fo:Dispose()
		self.right_stem_fo = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare or self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
	table.insert(self.left_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center - vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.left_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center - vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, 0))
	table.insert(self.left_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center - vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, -self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.left_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center - vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x/2, 0, self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.left_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center - vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x/2, 0, -self.battle_zone.extents.z))

	table.insert(self.right_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center + vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.right_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center + vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, 0))
	table.insert(self.right_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center + vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x, 0, -self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.right_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center + vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x / 2, 0, -self.battle_zone.extents.z))
	table.insert(self.right_generate_pos_candidate,
			self.battle_zone.center + vector(self.battle_zone.extents.x / 2, 0, self.battle_zone.extents.z))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self:destruct_stem()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.left_generate_pos_candidate = nil
	self.right_generate_pos_candidate = nil


	self.left_stem_range = nil
	self.right_stem_range = nil


	self.left_stem_calculator = nil
	self.right_stem_calculator = nil

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_destroyed_event)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.generate then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_fx = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate then
		if next_state ~= self.state.trace then
			self:hide_all_attack_range()
			self:dispose_all_prepare_fx()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		self:hide_all_attack_range()
		self:dispose_all_prepare_fx()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_explosion', self.character.Position + vector(0,2,0))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self:dispose_all_projectile()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_ani_key)
		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position + vector(0,2,0))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.generate_time = self.generate_interval

		self:set_center_projectile()
		self:refresh_round_info()
		self.current_generate_count = 0
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:shoot_projectiles()

		-- [KYU] 한, 영, 일, 중 모든 보이스에 대응되었기 때문에 조건문이 필요없다 판단, 제외한다.
		if random_util.get_random_value() > 0.5 then

		end

function local_class:dispose_all_prepare_fx()
	for i = 1, #self.projectile_table do
		if self.projectile_table[i].prepare_effect ~= nil then
			self.projectile_table[i].prepare_effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.projectile_table[i].prepare_effect = nil
	end
	if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
		self.cast_fx:Dispose()
		self.cast_fx = nil
	end
end



function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.generate)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate then
		if self.time_passed > self.generate_time then
			self.current_generate_count = self.current_generate_count + 1
			if self.generate_round then
				self:generate_projectile_round()
			else
				self:generate_projectile_linear()
			end

			if self.generate_set_count <= self.current_generate_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.trace)
				return
			end

			self.generate_time = self.generate_time + self.generate_interval
		end
		self:update_projectile()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.trace then
		if self.time_passed > self.trace_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
			return
		end
		self:update_projectile()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.repeat_count > self.current_repeat_count then
			self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
			self:change_state(self.state.generate)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self .state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_center_projectile()
	self.center_projectile_pos, _ = pattern_util.random_direction_point(self.target, self.generate_radius)

	local direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.center_projectile_pos)
	local wait_time = (self.generate_set_count) * self.generate_interval + self.trace_duration
	self.projectile_table[1].position = self.center_projectile_pos
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.projectile_table[1].range, self.center_projectile_pos, direction, self.character.Position.y)
	self.projectile_table[1].range:Show(wait_time)
	self.projectile_table[1].prepare_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.projectile_table[1].position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('generate')
end

function local_class:refresh_round_info()
	self.round_center_point = self.target.Position
end

function local_class:generate_projectile_linear()
	local right_target_pos = self.center_projectile_pos + vector_util.right * self.current_generate_count * self.generate_distance
	local left_target_pos = self.center_projectile_pos + vector_util.left * self.current_generate_count * self.generate_distance

	local wait_time = (self.generate_set_count - self.current_generate_count) * self.generate_interval + self.trace_duration
	local right_idx = self.current_generate_count * 2
	local left_idx = right_idx + 1

	self.projectile_table[left_idx].position = left_target_pos
	self.projectile_table[left_idx].range:Show(wait_time)
	self.projectile_table[left_idx].prepare_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.projectile_table[left_idx].position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('generate')

	self.projectile_table[right_idx].position = right_target_pos
	self.projectile_table[right_idx].range:Show(wait_time)
	self.projectile_table[right_idx].prepare_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.projectile_table[right_idx].position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('generate')
end

function local_class:generate_projectile_round()
	local pos_vector = self.center_projectile_pos - self.round_center_point
	local left_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, self.round_generate_angle * self.current_generate_count, 0))
	local right_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, -self.round_generate_angle * self.current_generate_count, 0))
	local right_target_pos = self.round_center_point + left_rot * pos_vector
	local left_target_pos = self.round_center_point + right_rot * pos_vector

	local wait_time = (self.generate_set_count - self.current_generate_count) * self.generate_interval + self.trace_duration
	local right_idx = self.current_generate_count * 2
	local left_idx = right_idx + 1

	self.projectile_table[left_idx].position = left_target_pos
	self.projectile_table[left_idx].range:Show(wait_time)
	self.projectile_table[left_idx].prepare_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.projectile_table[left_idx].position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('generate')

	self.projectile_table[right_idx].position = right_target_pos
	self.projectile_table[right_idx].range:Show(wait_time)
	self.projectile_table[right_idx].prepare_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.prepare_key, self.projectile_table[right_idx].position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('generate')
end

function local_class:update_projectile()
	for i = 1, #self.projectile_table do
		if self.projectile_table[i].position ~= nil then
			local direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.projectile_table[i].position)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.projectile_table[i].range, self.projectile_table[i].position, direction, self.character.Position.y)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.projectile_table[i].range))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_projectiles()
	for i = 1, #self.projectile_table do
		local direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.projectile_table[i].position)
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.projectile_table[i].position, direction)
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fire')
end


function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(zone)
	self.battle_zone = zone
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			local damage = math.floor(hit_info.target.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)

			--- 데미지 정보 생성
			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = hit_info.target
			damage_info.damage = damage
			damage_info.direction = hit_info.direction

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		elseif lua_helper.type_compare(hit_info.target.CrashBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour)) then
			return true
		end

	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.map_hit then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil

	self.projectile_table = nil
	self.center_projectile_pos = nil

	self.shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	else
		self.calc_info.Radius = self.radius
	end

	if self.calc == nil then
		self.calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, self.calc_info)
	end

	self.act_safes = act_safe_list

	self.is_play_expl = explosion

	self.is_blue = is_blue

	self.current_color = is_blue and self.color.blue or self.color.red

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function proj_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.vanish then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.arrive then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.fx_proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_name, self.position, self.direction)
		--if self.fx_trail_name then
		--	self.fx_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_trail_name, self.position, vector_util.zero, self.fx_proj.transform)
		--end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.calc:Start()
		if self.is_play_expl then
			if self.current_color == self.color.blue then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blue_move', self.zone_bound.center)
			else
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('red_move', self.zone_bound.center)
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.fx_proj ~= nil then
			self.fx_proj:Dispose()
			self.fx_proj = nil
			--self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_expl_name, self.position)
		end

		if self.current_color == self.color.blue then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blue_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('red_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.vanish then
		if self.fx_proj ~= nil then
			self.fx_proj:Dispose()
			self.fx_proj = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.fx_expl_name, self.position)

			if self.current_color == self.color.blue then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blue_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
			else
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('red_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
			end
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.arrive then
		if self.is_play_expl == true then
			if self.current_color == self.color.blue then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blue_expl2', self.position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('blue_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
			else
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('red_expl2', self.position)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('red_expl', self.zone_bound.center)
			end
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function proj_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		local is_goal = self:update_move(dt)
		local is_hit = self:publish_damage(dt)
		if is_goal then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		elseif is_hit then
			self:change_state(self.state.vanish)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		--self:change_state(self.state.none)
		local is_goal = self:update_move(dt)
		if is_goal then
			self:change_state(self.state.arrive)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.vanish then
		local is_goal = self:update_move(dt)
		if is_goal then
			self:change_state(self.state.arrive)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.arrive then

	end
end

--- return true -> goal
function proj_class:update_move(dt)
	self.angle = (self.angle + self.rot_speed * dt) % 360
	self.distance = math.max(0, (self.distance - self.speed * dt))

	local rad = math.rad(self.angle)
	self.direction = vector(math.cos(rad) - math.sin(rad), 0, math.sin(rad) + math.cos(rad))
	self.position = self.target_pos + self.direction * self.distance

	if self.fx_proj ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_proj, self.position, self.direction)
	end

	return float_util.is_almost_zero((self.position - self.target_pos).magnitude)
end

function proj_class:publish_damage(dt)
	self.calc.Position = self.position

	local result = false
	local objects = self.calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		for _, safe in pairs(self.act_safes) do
			local r = safe.radius
			local magn = (safe.position - fo.Position).magnitude
			if safe.current_state >= safe_class.state.action and r >= magn then
				objects:Dispose()
				return true
			end
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		result = true
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	return result
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blue_proj then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.red_proj then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.bp_blue then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.bp_red then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_wait then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_proj then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fusion then
		if self.fx_fusion_proj ~= nil then
			self.fx_fusion_proj:Dispose()
			self.fx_fusion_proj = nil
		end

		battle_range_util.hide(self.ar_explosion)

		self.fusion_calc:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		--self.explosion_calc:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.blue_big_proj = self:pop_big_proj(true)
		self.red_big_proj = self:pop_big_proj(false)

		self.death_type = self.character.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible
		self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Visible

		--self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")

		self.origin_size = stage_camera.Size

		stage_camera:Move(self.character, self.character.Position, self.zoom_in_duration)
		stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.zoom_in_camera_size, self.zoom_in_duration)


	elseif next_state == self.state.blue_proj then
		self.blue_proj_action_count = self.blue_proj_action_count + 1
		local data = self.blue_proj_datas[self.blue_proj_action_count]
		local amount = data.amount
		local space = data.space
		local offset = data.offset
		for i = amount, 1, -1 do
			local angle = i * space + offset
			local explosion = i == 1 and true or false
			self:pop_proj(self.zone_bound.center, angle, data, explosion, true)
		end

		if self.safe_active then
			self:pop_safe_zone(true, data.safe_radius, data.safe_delay, data.safe_prepare, data.safe_action, data.safe_post)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.red_proj then
		self.red_proj_action_count = self.red_proj_action_count + 1
		local data = self.red_proj_datas[self.red_proj_action_count]
		local amount = data.amount
		local space = data.space
		local offset = data.offset
		for i = amount, 1, -1 do
			local angle = i * space + offset
			local explosion = i == 1 and true or false
			self:pop_proj(self.zone_bound.center, angle, data, explosion, false)
		end

		if self.safe_active then
			self:pop_safe_zone(true, data.safe_radius, data.safe_delay, data.safe_prepare, data.safe_action, data.safe_post)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.bp_blue then
		--self.blue_big_proj = self:pop_big_proj(true)

	elseif next_state == self.state.bp_red then
		--self.red_big_proj = self:pop_big_proj(false)

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		local datas = self.current_state == self.state.blue_proj and self.blue_proj_datas or self.red_proj_datas
		local idx = self.current_state == self.state.blue_proj and self.blue_proj_action_count or self.red_proj_action_count
		local data = datas[idx]
		-- intervalDuration을 해당 데이터에서 뽑아온다
		if data.interval ~= nil and data.interval > 0 then
			self.interval_duration = data.interval
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_wait then

	elseif next_state == self.state.move_proj then
		self.blue_big_proj:change_state(bp_class.state.move_in)
		self.red_big_proj:change_state(bp_class.state.move_in)

	elseif next_state == self.state.fusion then
		self.fx_fusion = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fusion', self.zone_bound.center)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.ar_explosion, self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fusion', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif next_state == self.state.explosion then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.zone_bound.center)
		self:publish_damage_zone(dt)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fusion_expl', self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		if self.death_type ~= nil then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
			self.death_type = nil
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
			self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end

		self:teleport_center()

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")

		if self.origin_size ~= nil then
			stage_camera:Move(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position, self.camera_duration, user_party_leader)
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)
			self.origin_size = nil
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character.OverrideDamageBehaviour = nil

		if self.wave_calc ~= nil then
			self.wave_calc:End()
		end

		if self.fx_vortex ~= nil then
			self.fx_vortex:Dispose()
			self.fx_vortex = nil
		end

		if self.sfx_vortex ~= nil then
			self.sfx_vortex:FadeOut(0.5)
			self.sfx_vortex = nil
		end

		if self.fx_vortex_contrail_list ~= nil then
			for _, v in pairs(self.fx_vortex_contrail_list) do
				v:Dispose()
			end
			self.fx_vortex_contrail_list = nil

			for _, fo in pairs(party_manager.UserParty) do
				stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(fo)
			end
		end

		if self.origin_size ~= nil then
			stage_camera:Move(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position, self.camera_duration, user_party_leader)
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.origin_size, self.camera_duration)
		end

		if self.blue_big_proj ~= nil then
			self.blue_big_proj:cancel()
		end

		if self.red_big_proj ~= nil then
			self.red_big_proj:cancel()
		end

		if self.zone_bound ~= nil and not self.zone_bound:Contains(self.character.Position) then
			self:teleport_center()
		end

		if self.death_type ~= nil then
			self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(self.death_type)
			self.death_type = nil
			self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
			self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
			self.character.FieldObjectController.UpdateActiveStateFlag = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.prev_state = self.current_state
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_projs(dt)
	self:update_safes(dt)

	if self.blue_big_proj ~= nil then
		self.blue_big_proj:update_frame(dt)
	end

	if self.red_big_proj ~= nil then
		self.red_big_proj:update_frame(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:publish_damage_wave(dt)
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= 1.8 and self.play_cast_ani == false then
			--self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("cast")
			stage_camera:Move(self.zone_bound.center, self.camera_duration)
			stage_camera:ResizeTo(self.camera_size, self.camera_duration)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= 3.0 and self.fx_vortex == nil then
			self.wave_calc:Start()
			self.fx_vortex = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('vortex_long', self.zone_bound.center)
			self.sfx_vortex = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('vortex', self.zone_bound.center)
			self.fx_vortex_contrail_list = {}
			for _, fo in pairs(party_manager.UserParty) do
				local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('vortex_contrail', fo.Position, vector_util.zero, fo.transform)
				table.insert(self.fx_vortex_contrail_list, fx)
				stage.SmokeManager:UnsetCharacterSmoke(fo)
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.blue_proj)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blue_proj then
		self:change_state(self.state.interval)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.red_proj then
		self:change_state(self.state.interval)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			if self.prev_state == self.state.blue_proj then
				if self.blue_proj_action_count >= #self.blue_proj_datas then
					self:change_state(self.state.red_proj)
				else
					self:change_state(self.prev_state)
				end

			elseif self.prev_state == self.state.red_proj then
				if self.red_proj_action_count >= #self.red_proj_datas then
					self:change_state(self.state.move_wait)
				else
					self:change_state(self.prev_state)
				end
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_wait then
		if self.blue_big_proj.current_state == bp_class.state.ready and self.red_big_proj.current_state == bp_class.state.ready then
			self:change_state(self.state.move_proj)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.move_proj then
		if self.time_passed >= 0.2 and self.fx_fusion_blue == nil then
			local fx = self.blue_big_proj.fx_proj.transform
			local pos = self.blue_big_proj.position
			self.fx_fusion_blue = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fusion_blue', pos, vector_util.forward, fx)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= 0.2 and self.fx_fusion_red == nil then
			local fx = self.red_big_proj.fx_proj.transform
			local pos = self.red_big_proj.position
			self.fx_fusion_red = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fusion_red', pos, vector_util.back, fx)
		end

		if self.blue_big_proj:is_ready_fusion() and self.red_big_proj:is_ready_fusion() then
			self:change_state(self.state.fusion)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fusion then
		self:publish_damage_fusion(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= 0.5 and self.fx_expl2 == nil then
			self.fx_expl2 = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion2', self.zone_bound.center)

			self.blue_big_proj:cancel()
			self:push_big_proj(self.blue_big_proj)
			self.blue_big_proj = nil

			self.red_big_proj:cancel()
			self:push_big_proj(self.red_big_proj)
			self.red_big_proj = nil

			self.fx_fusion_proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fusion_proj', self.zone_bound.center)

			self:pop_safe_zone(false, self.safe_radius, 0, self.safe_prepare_duration, self.safe_action_duration, self.safe_post_duration)

			self.wave_calc:End()

			if self.fx_vortex_contrail_list ~= nil then
				for _, v in pairs(self.fx_vortex_contrail_list) do
					v:Dispose()
				end
				self.fx_vortex_contrail_list = nil

				for _, fo in pairs(party_manager.UserParty) do
					stage.SmokeManager:SetCharacterSmoke(fo)
				end
			end

			if self.fx_vortex ~= nil then
				self.fx_vortex:Dispose()
				self.fx_vortex = nil
			end

			self.fusion_calc:Start()
		end

		if self.time_passed >= 1.5 and self.is_ar_show == false then
			self.is_ar_show = true
			battle_range_util.show(self.ar_explosion, self.fusion_duration - 1.5 - 0.1)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.fusion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_projs(dt)
	for i = #self.act_proj_list, 1, -1 do
		local p = self.act_proj_list[i]
		p:update_frame(dt)

		for _, s in pairs(self.act_safe_list) do
			if s.current_state >= safe_class.state.action and (s.position - p.position).magnitude <= s.radius then
				p:change_state(proj_class.state.vanish)
				break
			end
		end

		if p.current_state == proj_class.state.arrive then
			self:push_proj(table.remove(self.act_proj_list, i))

			if p.idx < 10 then
				if self.blue_big_proj ~= nil then
					self.blue_big_proj:change_radius(p.idx, #self.blue_proj_datas)
				end
			else
				if self.red_big_proj ~= nil then
					self.red_big_proj:change_radius(p.idx % 10, #self.red_proj_datas)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_safes(dt)
	for i = #self.act_safe_list, 1, -1 do
		local s = self.act_safe_list[i]
		s:update_frame(dt)
		if not s:is_active() then
			self:push_safe_zone(table.remove(self.act_safe_list, i))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_proj()
	return proj_class:new(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.params)
end

function local_class:pop_proj(target_pos, angle, data, explosion, is_blue)
	local p = #self.idle_proj_list > 0 and table.remove(self.idle_proj_list, 1) or self:create_proj()
	p:start(target_pos, angle, data, self.act_safe_list, explosion, is_blue, self.zone_bound)
	table.insert(self.act_proj_list, p)
	return p
end

function local_class:push_proj(p)
	if p == nil then
		return
	end

	p:cancel()
	table.insert(self.idle_proj_list, p)
end

function local_class:clear_proj()
	for i = #self.act_proj_list, 1, -1 do
		local p = self.act_proj_list[i]
		p:cancel()
		self:push_proj(table.remove(self.act_proj_list, i))
	end
end

function local_class:create_big_proj()
	return bp_class:new(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.params)
end

function local_class:pop_big_proj(is_blue)
	local p = #self.idle_big_proj_list > 0 and table.remove(self.idle_big_proj_list, 1) or self:create_big_proj()
	local start_p = is_blue and field:GetMarker('ww_chain_proj_a').position or field:GetMarker('ww_chain_proj_b').position
	local end_p = self.zone_bound.center
	local fx_proj_name = is_blue and 'big_blue_proj' or 'big_red_proj'
	local fx_trail_name = is_blue and 'big_blue_contrail' or 'big_red_contrail'
	p:start(start_p, end_p, fx_proj_name, fx_trail_name, self.zone_bound)
	return p
end

function local_class:pop_fusion_proj()

	local pos = self.zone_bound.center
	p:start(pos, pos, 'fusion_proj', nil)
	return p
end

function local_class:push_big_proj(p)

		return
	end

	p:cancel()
	table.insert(self.idle_big_proj_list, p)

function local_class:clear_big_proj()

		self.blue_big_proj:cancel()
	end

	end
