function local_class:create_safe_class()
	return safe_class:new(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.params)
end

function local_class:pop_safe_zone(is_split, radius, delay_dur, prepare_dur, action_dur, post_dur)
	if radius <= 0 and action_dur <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local p = #self.idle_safe_list > 0 and table.remove(self.idle_safe_list, 1) or self:create_safe_class()
	local min = self.current_state == self.state.fusion and self.safe_range_fusion_min_radius or self.safe_range_min_radius
	local max = self.current_state == self.state.fusion and self.safe_range_fusion_max_radius or self.safe_range_max_radius
	local rand_r = unity_class.random.Range(min, max)
	--- 세이프존 로직 수정: 세이프존의 반대편으로부터 좌우 각도 110도씩.
	--- 개선이유: 본래 의도가 세이프존 간 이격을 의도. 근데 4분면이라고 해서 그리 구현됨. 인접면끼리는 아무리해도 붙을 각도가 있어서 이와 같이 개선 (훈재)
	local offset = unity_class.random.Range(-self.safe_zone_isolate_angle, self.safe_zone_isolate_angle)
	local new_angle = (self.last_safe_zone_angle + 180 + offset) % 360
	self.last_safe_zone_angle = new_angle

	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.last_safe_zone_angle, 0).normalized
	local pos = self.zone_bound.center + (dir * vector_util.forward).normalized * rand_r
	p:start(pos, radius, delay_dur, prepare_dur, action_dur, post_dur, self.zone_bound)
	table.insert(self.act_safe_list, p)
	return p
end

-- 세이프존 생성할 곳 맵 4분할 해서 랜덤
--- [3.23] bugfix 4분면 분할 방식에서 개선함에 따라서 미사용
function local_class:set_rand_split_quad()
	local indices = {}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(indices, i)
	end

	for i = 4, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		indices[i], indices[j] = indices[j], indices[i]
	end
	return indices
end

function local_class:push_safe_zone(s)
	if s == nil then
		return
	end

	s:cancel()
	table.insert(self.idle_safe_list, s)
end

function local_class:clear_safe_zone()
	for i = #self.act_safe_list, 1, -1 do
		local s = self.act_safe_list[i]
		self:push_safe_zone(s)
		table.remove(self.act_safe_list, i)
	end
end

function local_class:publish_damage_zone(dt)
	self.explosion_calc:Start()
	self.explosion_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	local objects = self.explosion_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local is_hit = true
		for _, v in pairs(self.act_safe_list) do
			local magn = (fo.Position - v.position).magnitude
			if v.current_state == safe_class.state.action and magn <= v.radius then
				is_hit = false
				break;
			end
		end

		if is_hit then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * self.expl_damage_ratio)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	self.explosion_calc:End()
end

function local_class:publish_damage_wave(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.post then
		return
	end

	if self.wave_calc.IsStarted == false then
		return
	end

	self.wave_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	local objects = self.wave_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local magn = (fo.Position - self.zone_bound.center).magnitude
		if magn > self.wave_safe_radius then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.wave_damage_modifier
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:publish_damage_fusion(dt)
	if self.fusion_calc.IsStarted == false then
		return
	end

	self.fusion_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	local objects = self.fusion_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.fusion_damage_modifier
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:parse_proj_move_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)
	if not has_value then
		return nil
	end

	local result = {}
	for _, info in pairs(value) do
		local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, 'Index', _)
		local amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, 'Amount', _)
		local space = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Space', _)
		local offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Offset', _)
		local distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Distance', _)
		local radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Radius', _)
		local delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Delay', _)
		local speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Speed', _)
		local rot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'RotSpeed', _)
		local dmg_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'DmgTerm', _)
		local dmg_mod = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'DmgMod', _)
		local fx_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(info, 'FxName', '')
		local fx_trail_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(info, 'FxTrailName', '')
		local fx_expl_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(info, 'FxExplName', '')
		local interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'Interval', 0.0)
		local safe_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'SafeRadius', 0.0)
		local safe_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'SafeDelay', 0.0)
		local safe_prepare = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'SafePrepare', 0.0)
		local safe_action = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'SafeAction', 0.0)
		local safe_post = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, 'SafePost', 0.0)

		table.insert(result, {
			index = index,
			amount = amount,
			space = space,
			offset = offset,
			distance = distance,
			radius = radius,
			delay = delay,
			speed = speed,
			rot_speed = rot_speed,
			dmg_term = dmg_term,
			dmg_mod = dmg_mod,
			fx_name = fx_name,
			fx_trail_name = fx_trail_name,
			fx_expl_name = fx_expl_name,
			interval = interval,
			safe_radius = safe_radius,
			safe_delay = safe_delay,
			safe_prepare = safe_prepare,
			safe_action = safe_action,
			safe_post = safe_post
		})
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:teleport_center()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blink', self.character.Position)
	self.character.Position = self.zone_bound.center
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blink', self.character.Position)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(bound.size, self.expl_damage_duration, -1)
	self.explosion_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(bound.size, 29.0, self.wave_damage_term)
	self.wave_calc = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)

	local size = vector(bound.size.x, bound.size.z)
	self.ar_explosion = battle_range_util.create_rect(size, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.params = nil

	self:clear_proj()
	self:clear_big_proj()
	self:clear_safe_zone()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		if self.remain_proj_count <= 0 then
			--파란프로젝타일이 없으면 prepare 이후 그로기로 간다.
			self.is_groggy = true
		else
			--blue_proj effect생성(숨쉬기효과)
			self:init_pillar()

			self.pillar_count = #self.pillar_info_list
			self.current_pillar_shoot_count = 1

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
					{ 'start_pillar' }))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("shoot")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shoot", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("groggy", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self:dispose_pillar()
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:init_pillar()
	self.pillar_info_list = {}
	for idx, pos in pairs(self.blue_proj_info) do
		local ar = self:get_attack_range()
		local ac = self:get_attack_calculator()
		local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('blue_proj', pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
		ar:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

		ac.Position = pos

		table.insert(self.pillar_info_list, {
			state = self.pillar_state.blue_proj,
			start_pos = pos,
			pos = pos,
			time_passed = 0,
			attack_range = ar,
			attack_calc = ac,
			proj_effect = effect,
			aoe_count = 0
		})

		ac:Start()
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.pillar_info_list ~= nil then
		self:update_pillar(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			if not self.is_groggy then
				self:change_state(self.state.action)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		else
			if not self.is_groggy then
				self:update_pillar(dt)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_start_pillar(dt)
		if self.current_pillar_shoot_count >= self.pillar_count then
			if self.time_passed >= #self.pillar_info_list * self.shoot_interval + self.shoot_term then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_pillar(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.pillar_info_list) do
		v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
		if v.state == self.pillar_state.blue_proj then
			local time = (v.time_passed % self.pillar_time_cycle) / self.pillar_time_cycle
			-- 크기 계산 (1에서 0.6 사이를 왕복)
			local scale = self.pillar_max_scale - (self.pillar_max_scale - self.pillar_min_scale) * math.abs(2 * time - 1)
			-- 효과의 크기 설정
			v.proj_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * scale
			self:update_pillar_damage(dt, v.attack_calc)

		elseif v.state == self.pillar_state.init_pillar then
			if v.time_passed >= self.shoot_term then
				v.state = self.pillar_state.shoot
				v.time_passed = 0
				v.speed = self.shot_distance / self.shot_duration
			end
			self:update_pillar_damage(dt, v.attack_calc)
		elseif v.state == self.pillar_state.shoot then
			if v.time_passed <= self.shot_duration then
				v.pos = v.pos + (v.target_dir * dt * v.speed)
				v.pillar_effect.transform.position = v.pos
				v.attack_calc.Position = v.pos

				self:update_pillar_damage(dt, v.attack_calc)

				--이동하는동안 이동거리 체크해서 aoe생성해줘야한다.
				local diff = v.pos - v.start_pos
				if math.abs(diff.magnitude) > self.aoe_interval_range * v.aoe_count + (self.shot_radius / 2) then
					self:set_aoe(v)
				end
			else
				if v.pillar_effect ~= nil then
					v.pillar_effect:Dispose()
					v.pillar_effect = nil
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('pillar_end', v.pos)
				end

				v.attack_calc:End()
				v.state = self.pillar_state.none
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_start_pillar(dt)
	if self.current_pillar_shoot_count > self.pillar_count then
		return
	end

	if self.time_passed < (self.current_pillar_shoot_count * self.shoot_interval) - self.shoot_interval then
		return
	end

	if self.pillar_info_list[self.current_pillar_shoot_count].state ~= self.pillar_state.blue_proj then
		return
	end

	self:start_pillar(self.pillar_info_list[self.current_pillar_shoot_count])
	self.current_pillar_shoot_count = self.current_pillar_shoot_count + 1
end

function local_class:set_aoe(info)
	local aoe_pos = info.start_pos + (info.target_dir * (self.aoe_interval_range * info.aoe_count + (self.shot_radius / 2)))

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, aoe_pos,
			self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool('aoe'), self.aoe_spec, nil, nil, self.on_aoe_finish_func)

	info.aoe_count = info.aoe_count + 1

	--if not self.start_aoe_sfx then
	--	self.aoe_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("aoe")
	--	self.start_aoe_sfx = true
	--end

	--self.aoe_sfx_duration = self.aoe_spec.duration
end

function local_class:on_aoe_finish(is_immediate, pos)
	if not self.cs_battle_action then return end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('aoe_end', pos)
end

function local_class:start_pillar(info)
	if info.proj_effect ~= nil then
		info.proj_effect:Dispose()
		info.proj_effect = nil
	end

	self:return_attack_range(info.attack_range)
	info.attack_range = nil

	info.time_passed = 0
	info.state = self.pillar_state.init_pillar

	local effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('pillar', info.pos, vector_util.zero)
	local trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('trail', info.pos, vector_util.zero, effect.transform)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("init")

	info.pillar_effect = effect
	info.pillar_trail = trail
	info.target_dir = (self.target.Position - info.pos):GetX0z().normalized

	--info.attack_calc:Start()
end

function local_class:dispose_pillar()
	if self.pillar_info_list ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.pillar_info_list) do
			if v.attack_range ~= nil then
				self:return_attack_range(v.attack_range)
				v.attack_range = nil
			end

			if v.attack_calc ~= nil then
				v.attack_calc:End()
			end

			if v.proj_effect ~= nil then
				v.proj_effect:Dispose()
				v.proj_effect = nil
			end

			if v.pillar_effect ~= nil then
				v.pillar_effect:Dispose()
				v.pillar_effect = nil
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('pillar_end', v.pos)
			end

			if v.pillar_trail ~= nil then
				v.pillar_trail:Dispose()
				v.pillar_trail = nil
			end

			v.state = self.pillar_state.none
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_pillar_damage(dt, calc)
	local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	self.on_aoe_finish_func = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossCalypsoBlueProjBattleAction')

--파란구체를 마커위치로 발사하는패턴
--마커위치에 도달하면 대기 후 다른 패턴의 영향을 받는다.
--RedProj : 해당패턴의 폭파범위안에 들어가면 제거 후 제거위치를 RedProj에 넘겨줘서 이후 패턴 이어가도록
--AquaPillar : 생성, 삭제 시 정보를 넘겨줘서 이후 패턴을 이어 갈 수 있도록
--stageevent로 다른패턴의 위치값 or 범위값을 받아서 기믹 동작하도록 제작

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.battle_zone = nil

	self.area = {
		none = 0,
		left_up = 1,
		right_up = 2,
		left_down = 3,
		right_down  = 4
	}

	self.proj_state = {
		none = 0,
		attack_range = 1,
		move = 2,
		wait = 3,
		done = 4
	}

	--파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockbackForce", 1.5)

	local casting_Effect_offset = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, "CastingEffectOffset")
	if casting_Effect_offset == nil then
		self.casting_effect_offset = vector(0, 0, 1)
	else
		self.casting_effect_offset = vector(casting_Effect_offset[1], casting_Effect_offset[2], casting_Effect_offset[3])
	end

	self.marker_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MarkerCount", 16)
	self.marker_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'MarkerName', 'ww_blue_proj_marker_')

	--발사 갯수는 선택된 OrderInfo내에서 가져와야한다.
	self.proj_ready_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjReadyDuration", 0.1)
	self.proj_interval_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjIntervalDuration", 0.1)
	self.proj_action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjActionDuration", 0.1)
	self.proj_prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjPrepareDuration", 1)
	self.proj_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjDuration", 30)
	self.proj_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjDamageTerm", 0.5)
	self.proj_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjRadius", 1)
	self.proj_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjSpeed", 7)
	self.proj_hit_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ProjHitCount", 3)
	self.is_mad_action = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsMadAction", false)
	self.wall_check_margin = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "WallCheckMargin", 0.5)

	--up, right, down, left순
	self.shot_order_info = self:get_shot_order_info_data(params, "ShotOrderInfo")
	self.shot_offset_list =  self:get_shot_offset_info_data(params, "ShotOffsetList")
	
	self.purple_proj_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjDuration", 1.5)
	self.purple_proj_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjRadius", 0.75)
	self.purple_proj_damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjDamageterm", 0.5)
	self.purple_proj_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjDamageModifier", 1)
	self.purple_proj_explosion_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjExplosionDuration", 0.3)
	self.purple_proj_explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjExplosionDamageModifier", 1)
	self.purple_proj_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjExplosionRadius", 4)
	self.purple_proj_knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PurpleProjKnockBackForce", 1)
	
	self.attack_range_list = {}
	self.attack_calc_list = {}
	for i = 1, 1 do
		local ar = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(self.proj_radius, self.proj_radius * 2), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward) 
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)

		local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.proj_radius, 1, self.proj_duration, self.proj_damage_term)
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
		table.insert(self.attack_calc_list, ac)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2, --패턴 시작캐스팅
		action_ready = 3,--발사 전 동작
		action = 4, --발사
		interval = 5, --발사 후 다음발사까지 대기
		post = 6
	}
	
	self.cause = {
		none = 1,
		purple = 2,
		pillar = 3
	}

	self.target = nil
	self.shot_count = 0
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.target_area = self.area.none
	self.projectile_info = {}
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.purple_proj_info = {}

	self.purple_attack_range_list = {}
	self.purple_attack_calc_list = {}
	local ar = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.purple_proj_explosion_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	table.insert(self.purple_attack_range_list, ar)

			self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'red_proj_explosion' then
			local is_mad_action = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(5)) == 1 and true or false
			if is_mad_action == self.is_mad_action then
				--RedPorj가 폭발한 범위에 포함되면 BlueProj를 제거
				--redproj로 인해 제거가 됐다면 flag를 customstageevent에 포함시켜서 날려준다.
				local pos = vector(tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2)), tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3)))
				local radius = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(4))
				self:check_in_explosion(pos, radius)
			end
		end

		if  e:GetParamAt(0) == 'laser_explosion' then
			--Laser범위에 포함되면 제거
			local index = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
			self:laser_explosion(index)
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'start_pillar' then
			--Pillar패턴이 시작하면 blue_proj는 모두 제거
			if self.projectile_info ~= nil then
				self:dispose_all_proj(self.cause.pillar)
			end
		end

		if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'clear_blue_proj' then
			if self.projectile_info ~= nil then
				self:dispose_all_proj(self.cause.none)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:laser_explosion(index)
	if self.projectile_info == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.projectile_info) do
		if v.is_active and v.state == self.proj_state.wait then
			if v.index == index then
				self:dispose_proj(v, self.cause.purple)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_in_explosion(pos, radius)
	if self.projectile_info == nil then return end

	for _,v in pairs(self.projectile_info) do
		if v.is_active and v.state == self.proj_state.wait then
			local diff = (pos - v.current_pos).magnitude
			if diff <= radius then
				self:dispose_proj(v, self.cause.purple)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_shot_order_info_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)

	local order_list = {}
	if has_value then
		for _, info in pairs(value) do
			local index = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(info, "Index", _)

			local order_data = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(info, "Order")

			local list = {}
			for i = 1, #order_data do
				table.insert(list, order_data[i])
			end

			table.insert(order_list, list)
		end
	end

	return order_list
end

function local_class:get_shot_offset_info_data(params, data_name)
	local has_value, value = params:TryGetValue(data_name)
	if not has_value then
		return nil
	end

	local list = {}
	for _, info in pairs(value) do
		local x = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, "OffsetX", 0)
		local y = 0
		local z = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(info, "OffsetY", 0)
		table.insert(list, vector(x, y, z))
	end

	return list
end

function local_class:get_attack_range()
	if #self.attack_range_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_range_list)
	else
		local ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				unity_class.vector2(self.proj_radius, self.proj_radius), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		ar:Hide()
		return ar
	end
end

function local_class:return_attack_range(ar)
	ar:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

	if self.attack_range_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, ar)
	end
end

function local_class:get_attack_calculator()
	if #self.attack_calc_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_calc_list)
	end

	local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.proj_radius, self.proj_duration, self.proj_damage_term)
	local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	return ac
end

function local_class:return_attack_calculator(ac)
	ac:End()

	if self.attack_calc_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_calc_list, ac)
	end
end

function local_class:get_purple_attack_range()
	if #self.purple_attack_range_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.purple_attack_range_list)
	end

	local ar = battle_range_util.create_circle(self.purple_proj_explosion_radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)
	ar:Hide()
	return ar
end

function local_class:return_purple_attack_range(ar)
	ar:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

	if self.purple_attack_range_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.purple_attack_range_list, ar)
	end
end

function local_class:get_purple_attack_calculator()
	if #self.purple_attack_calc_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.purple_attack_calc_list)
	else
		local info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.purple_proj_radius,
				self.purple_proj_duration + self.purple_proj_explosion_duration, self.purple_proj_damage_term)
		local ac = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
		return ac
	end
end

function local_class:return_purple_attack_calculator(ac)
	ac:End()

	if self.purple_attack_calc_list ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.purple_attack_calc_list, ac)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	self.marker_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.marker_count do
		local marker = CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.Field:GetMarker(self.marker_name .. i)
		table.insert(self.marker_list, marker)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	-- 패턴 진행 중 타겟이 변경될 수 있다.
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self:dispose_all_proj(self.cause.none)
	self.target = target
	self.shot_count = 0
	self.current_shot_count = 0
	self.projectile_info = {}
	self.purple_proj_info = {}

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	if self.projectile_info ~= nil then
		self:dispose_all_proj(self.cause.none)
	end

	if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
		self.cast_effect = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_ready then
		if self.projectile_info ~= nil and self.current_shot_count > 0 then
			self.projectile_info[self.current_shot_count].attack_range:Hide()
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
					self.projectile_info[self.current_shot_count].attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if next_state == self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", nil)

		self.target_area = self:get_target_area(self.character.Position)
		self.proj_start_pos = self.character.Position + self.casting_effect_offset
		self.shot_count = #self.shot_order_info[self.target_area]
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		
	elseif next_state == self.state.action_ready then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action_ready")
		if self.cast_effect == nil then
			self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('action_ready', self.proj_start_pos)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action_ready", nil)
		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1
		self:init_proj()

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		if self.current_shot_count <= 1 then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		end

		self.projectile_info[self.current_shot_count].is_active = true
		self.projectile_info[self.current_shot_count].state = self.proj_state.none

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		if self.cast_effect ~= nil then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.cast_effect = nil
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:init_purple_proj(pos)
	local ar = self:get_purple_attack_range()
	local ac = self:get_purple_attack_calculator()
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('purple_proj', pos)

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(ar, pos, battle_util.get_height(pos))
	ar:Show(self.purple_proj_duration)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, ar))

	ac.Position = pos
	ac:Start()

	table.insert(self.purple_proj_info, {
		is_active = true,
		is_explosion = false,
		pos = pos,
		time_passed = 0,
		attack_range = ar,
		attack_calc = ac
	})
end

function local_class:remove_all_purple_proj()
	for _,v in pairs(self.purple_proj_info) do
		self:remove_purple_proj(v)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_purple_proj(info)
	if info ~= nil and info.is_active then
		info.is_active = false
		self:return_attack_range(info.attack_range)
		self:return_attack_calculator(info.attack_calc)
		info = nil
	end
end

function local_class:get_target_area(pos)
	local dx = pos.x - self.battle_zone.center.x
	local dz = pos.z - self.battle_zone.center.z
	local area = self.area.none

	--완전히 겹치면 보정해준다.
	if dx == 0 then
		dx = 1
	end
	if dz == 0 then
		dz = 1
	end

	if dx < 0 and dz > 0 then
		area = self.area.left_up
	elseif dx > 0 and dz > 0 then
		area = self.area.right_up
	elseif dx < 0 and dz < 0 then
		area = self.area.left_down
	elseif dx > 0 and dz < 0 then
		area = self.area.right_down
	end

	return area
end

function local_class:init_proj()
	local ar = self:get_attack_range()
	local ac = self:get_attack_calculator()
	local pos = self.character.Position
	if self.shot_offset_list ~= nil and #self.shot_offset_list >= self.current_shot_count then  
		pos = pos + self.shot_offset_list[self.current_shot_count]
	end
	
	local proj_effect, proj_trail = self:init_proj_effect(pos)
	local marker_index = self.shot_order_info[self.target_area][self.current_shot_count]
	local target_pos = self.marker_list[marker_index].position
	local move_dir = (target_pos - pos):GetX0z().normalized

	table.insert(self.projectile_info, {
		index = self.current_shot_count,
		state = self.proj_state.none,
		is_active = false,
		attack_range = ar,
		attack_calc = ac,
		start_pos = pos,
		current_pos = pos,
		target_pos = target_pos,
		proj_effect = proj_effect,
		proj_trail = proj_trail,
		move_dir = move_dir,
		is_move = false,
		time_passed = 0,
		left_hit_count = self.proj_hit_count
	})
end

function local_class:init_proj_effect(pos)
	local proj_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj', pos)
	proj_effect.transform.localScale = vector_util.zero
	local proj_trail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_trail', pos)
	return proj_effect, proj_trail
end

function local_class:dispose_all_proj(cause)
	if self.projectile_info ~= nil then
		for _,v in pairs(self.projectile_info) do
			self:dispose_proj(v, cause)
		end

		self.projectile_info = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_proj(info, cause)
	info.is_active = false

	self:return_attack_range(info.attack_range)
	self:return_attack_calculator(info.attack_calc)
	if info.proj_effect ~= nil then
		info.proj_effect:Dispose()
		info.proj_effect = nil

		if cause == self.state.none then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', info.current_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
		end
	end

	if info.proj_trail ~= nil then
		info.proj_trail:Dispose()
		info.proj_trail = nil
	end

	--외부요인으로 red, laser 보라프로젝타일 폭발 이 있을때만 사용 한다.
	if cause == self.cause.purple then
		self:init_purple_proj(info.current_pos)
	end

	if info.state ~= self.proj_state.none then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
				{
					'blue_proj_remove', --이벤트 이름
					info.current_pos.x, info.current_pos.y, info.current_pos.z, --위치
					info.index
				}))
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_purple_proj(dt)

	if self.projectile_info ~= nil and #self.projectile_info > 0 then
		self:update_proj(dt)
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action_ready)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_ready then
		if self.time_passed >= self.proj_ready_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.proj_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.proj_interval_duration then
			if self.current_shot_count < self.shot_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.action_ready)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	for _,v in pairs(self.projectile_info) do
		if v.is_active then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			if v.state == self.proj_state.none then
				--시작 어택레인지 온
				local mag = (v.target_pos - v.start_pos).magnitude

				v.attack_range:Resize(mag, self.proj_radius * 2)
				battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(v.attack_range, v.start_pos, v.move_dir)
				v.attack_range:Show(self.proj_prepare_duration)
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, v.attack_range))
				v.state = self.proj_state.attack_range
				v.time_passed = 0
			elseif v.state == self.proj_state.attack_range then
				local max_scale = 1.5
				local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(v.time_passed, 0, max_scale, self.proj_prepare_duration)
				v.proj_effect.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * math.min(progress, max_scale)

				if v.time_passed >= self.proj_prepare_duration then
					v.attack_range:Hide()
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
							v.attack_range))

					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shot', v.current_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

					v.attack_calc.Position = v.current_pos
					v.attack_calc:Start()

					v.state = self.proj_state.move
					v.time_passed = 0

					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
				end
			elseif v.state == self.proj_state.move then
				v.current_pos = v.current_pos + (v.move_dir * dt * self.proj_speed)

				if v.current_pos.x < self.battle_zone.min.x + self.wall_check_margin or v.current_pos.x > self.battle_zone.max.x - self.wall_check_margin or
				   v.current_pos.z < self.battle_zone.min.z + self.wall_check_margin or v.current_pos.z > self.battle_zone.max.z - self.wall_check_margin then

					v.state = self.proj_state.none
					self:dispose_proj(v, self.cause.none)
					return
				end

				v.proj_effect.transform.position = v.current_pos
				v.proj_trail.transform.position = v.current_pos
				v.attack_calc.Position = v.current_pos

				if (v.current_pos - v.target_pos).magnitude <= 0.2 then
					v.current_pos = v.target_pos
					v.proj_effect.transform.position = v.current_pos
					v.proj_trail.transform.position = v.current_pos
					v.attack_calc.Position = v.current_pos

					v.state = self.proj_state.wait

					--proj가 목표위치에 도달하면 index와 pos를 보내준다.
					--기둥패턴 용
					message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
							{
								'blue_proj_ready', --이벤트 이름
								v.index, --index
								v.current_pos.x, v.current_pos.y, v.current_pos.z --위치

							}))
					self.is_groggy = true

					v.time_passed = 0
				end
			elseif v.state == self.proj_state.wait then
				if v.time_passed >= self.proj_duration then
					--대기시간 끝나서 종료?는 안쓸것 같지만 추가
					v.state = self.proj_state.done
					v.time_passed = 0
				end
			elseif v.state == self.proj_state.done then
				self:dispose_proj(v, self.cause.none)
			end

			if v.state > self.proj_state.attack_range then
				self:update_damage(dt, v)
			end

			if v.left_hit_count <= 0 then
				self:dispose_proj(v, self.cause.none)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt, info)
	if not info.attack_calc.IsStarted then
		info.attack_calc:Start()
	end
	local objects = info.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(info.current_pos - fo.Position).normalized
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = info.move_dir:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * info.move_dir
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * info.move_dir
			end

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			info.left_hit_count = info.left_hit_count - 1
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_purple_proj(dt)
	if self.purple_proj_info == nil then
		return
	end

	for _, v in pairs(self.purple_proj_info) do
		if v.is_active then
			v.time_passed = v.time_passed + dt
			if not v.is_explosion then
				if v.time_passed < self.purple_proj_duration then
					self:update_purple_proj_damage(dt, v.attack_calc, v.pos)
				else
					v.attack_range:Hide()
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v.attack_range))
					self:init_explosion_purple_proj(v)

					v.attack_calc:End()
					v.is_explosion = true
					v.time_passed = 0
				end
			else
				self:explosion_damage(v)
				self:dispose_purple_proj(v)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
				
				--if v.time_passed < self.purple_proj_explosion_duration then
				--	self:explosion_damage(v)
				--	self:dispose_purple_proj(v)
				--end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_purple_proj(info)
	info.is_active = false
	self:return_purple_attack_range(info.attack_range)
	self:return_purple_attack_calculator(info.attack_calc)
end

function local_class:init_explosion_purple_proj(info)
	--info.ac_info.calc_info.Radius = self.purple_proj_explosion_radius
	--self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', info.pos)
	--self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion")
end

function local_class:explosion_damage(info)
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(info.pos, self.purple_proj_explosion_radius)

	for _,v in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 공격 가능한 타겟에게
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, v) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(v.Bounds.center - info.pos).normalized

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v
			damage_info.modifier = self.purple_proj_explosion_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.purple_proj_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	--- pooled list 해제
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_purple_proj_damage(dt, ac, pos)
	if not ac.IsStarted then
		ac:Start()
	end
	local objects = ac:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
			damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.purple_proj_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knock_back_dir = -direction
			damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.purple_proj_knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.shot_order_info = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calc_list = nil
	self.target_area = nil
	self.projectile_info = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.casting_effect_offset = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.battle_zone = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		else
			local progress = (self.time_passed - self.laser_rotate_delay) / self.laser_rotate_duration
			progress = math.min(progress, 1) -- progress는 1을 넘지 않도록 제한
			local current_angle = v.start_angle + (v.target_angle - v.start_angle) * progress
			local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, current_angle, 0) * self.target_dir
			v.current_dir = dir

			local rotY = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(
					unity_class.vector3.right, vector_util.get_x0z(v.current_dir)).eulerAngles.y
			v.effect.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rotY, 0)
			self.attack_calc_list[i].Direction = v.current_dir

			if self.is_sfx_run == false then
				self.is_sfx_run = true
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("move", nil)
			end
			
		end

		local function is_within_laser_area(laser_info, blue_proj_pos)
			local half_width = self.laser_width / 2 + 0.5
			local half_distance = self.laser_distance / 2

			-- 레이저의 중심 위치 계산
			local laser_center = (self.character.Position + self.laser_offset) + laser_info.current_dir * half_distance

			-- 레이저의 방향 벡터를 기준으로 직교하는 벡터 계산
			local right_vector = unity_class.vector3.Cross(unity_class.vector3.up, laser_info.current_dir).normalized

			-- 블루 프로젝타일의 위치가 레이저 영역 내에 있는지 확인
			local to_proj = blue_proj_pos - laser_center
			local proj_distance = vector_util.dot(to_proj, laser_info.current_dir)
			local proj_width = vector_util.dot(to_proj, right_vector)

			return math.abs(proj_width) <= half_width and proj_distance >= -half_distance and proj_distance <= half_distance
		end

		for _, blue_proj in pairs(self.blue_proj_info) do
			if is_within_laser_area(v, blue_proj.pos) then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{
							'laser_explosion', --이벤트 이름
							blue_proj.index
						}))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_damage(dt)
	for i,v in pairs(self.attack_calc_list) do
		if not v.IsStarted then
			v:Start()
		end
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local laser_info = self.laser_info_list[i]
				local laser_center = laser_info.pos + self.laser_offset
				local half_distance = self.laser_distance / 2

				-- 충돌한 사각형의 중심을 기준으로 수직 방향 계산
				local collision_center = laser_center + laser_info.current_dir * half_distance
				local to_fo = fo.Bounds.center - collision_center
				local right_vector = unity_class.vector3.Cross(unity_class.vector3.up, laser_info.current_dir).normalized
				local proj_width = vector_util.dot(to_fo, right_vector)

				-- 넉백 방향을 충돌 위치에 따라 결정
				local dir
				if proj_width > 0 then
					dir = vector_util.get_x0z(right_vector).normalized
				else
					dir = vector_util.get_x0z(-right_vector).normalized
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = dir
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.target_dir = nil
	self.target = nil

	self.laser_move_info = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calc_list = nil
	self.laser_info_list = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character,
				self.attack_range))
		--self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action_ready then
		
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then

		if next_state == self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	end

				self.target_dir, -1, -1, nil, false)

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action", nil)
		self.current_shot_count = self.current_shot_count + 1

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position + self.proj_offset, self.target_dir)

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		self.target_dir = (self.target.Position - (self.character.Position + self.proj_offset)):GetX0z().normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position + self.proj_offset, self.target_dir)

			self:change_state(self.state.action_ready)
		end

		end

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position + self.proj_offset, self.target_dir)

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithPosition(self.character, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.center_pos))

	-- 회전 방향
	info:AppendNumber(random_util.get_random_int(0, 1))

	-- 시작 방향
	if self.enhanced then
		-- 상하좌우 랜덤
		local r = random_util.get_random_int(1,4)

		if r == 1 then
			info:AppendDirection(unity_class.vector3.left)
		elseif r == 2 then
			info:AppendDirection(unity_class.vector3.right)
		elseif r == 3 then
			info:AppendDirection(unity_class.vector3.forward)
		else
			info:AppendDirection(unity_class.vector3.back)
		end
	else
		-- 타겟에 가장 가까운 방향
		local dir_vec = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vec)
		if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
		end
		info:AppendDirection(direction_util.to_vector3(dir))
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)

	self.initial_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.shot_count = 0
	self.consume_count = 0

	local dir_to_look = direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(self.initial_direction))
	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))

				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()

function local_class:turn_on_barrier()

function local_class:turn_off_barrier()

		self.barrier_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.barrier_effect = nil

	if self.barrier_sfx_holder ~= nil then

function local_class:remove_all_projectiles()

		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do

			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil

			-- 계산기 반납
			self:return_calculator(self.projectiles[i].calculator)
			self.projectiles[i].calculator = nil

			table.remove(self.projectiles, i)

function local_class:cancel()

	-- 어떻게든 캔슬 됐다면 일단 버프랑 스탯옵션 제거
	self:turn_off_barrier()
	self:remove_all_projectiles()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post and next_state ~= self.state.groggy then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		-- 마무리 일격 후 버프 및 옵션 제거
		self:turn_off_barrier()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

		-- 첫 투사체 준비
		local range = self:get_attack_range()
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, self.character.Position, self.initial_direction)
		range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range")
		local p_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + self.initial_direction * self.shot_distance
		local calculator = self:get_calculator()
		calculator.Position = p_pos

		self.shot_count = 1
		self.projectiles = {}
		table.insert(self.projectiles, {
			started = false,
			time_passed = -self.prepare_duration,
			position = p_pos,
			calculator = calculator,
			direction = -self.initial_direction,
			attack_range = range
		})

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		-- self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.shot_timer = self.shot_interval
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attacked = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("attack")
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
		-- 그로기 진입 시 버프 및 옵션 제거
		self:turn_off_barrier()
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:attack_calculate(calculator, dt)
	local hit = false

	local objects = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			-- 타격 가능 대상이 맞았다면 버프를 걸어준다.
			buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo, self.def_buff_name, self.def_buff_lv, false, false)
			hit = true
			break
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	return hit
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 갱신
	if self.projectiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 시간 계산
			local proj_time_passed = self.projectiles[i].time_passed + dt
			self.projectiles[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if self.projectiles[i].started then
				local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + dt * self.shot_speed * self.projectiles[i].direction
				self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
				self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
				local finish = self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)
				local consume_position = calc_pos

				-- 대상 맞지 않았고 경과 시간 도달 시 흡수
				if not finish and proj_time_passed >= self.shot_move_duration - 0.1 then -- 한칸 빨리 먹도록.
					finish = true
					-- 자기 자신에게 공격력 버프 및 카운트 증가
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.attack_buff_name, self.attack_buff_lv, false, false)
					self.consume_count = self.consume_count + 1
					consume_position = self.character.Bounds.center

					-- 도네이션 애니
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("get")
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("get")
				end

				if finish then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("hit", consume_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit", consume_position)

					-- 오브젝트 제거
					if not is_unity_null(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object) then
						self.projectiles[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.projectiles[i].pooled_object = nil

					-- 어택 레인지 반납
					self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
					self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil

					-- 계산기 반납
					self:return_calculator(self.projectiles[i].calculator)
					self.projectiles[i].calculator = nil

					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
				end
			else
				if proj_time_passed >= 0 then
					self.projectiles[i].started = true
					local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + proj_time_passed * self.shot_speed * self.projectiles[i].direction
					self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
					self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
					self.projectiles[i].calculator:Start()
					self.projectiles[i].pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("projectile", calc_pos)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	self.barrier_ticker = self.barrier_ticker + dt

	-- TODO: FIXME: 배리어 남은 카운터 표시
	if self.last_displayed_barrier ~= self.remain_barrier_count and self.barrier_ticker >= 0.1 then
		self.last_displayed_barrier = self.remain_barrier_count
		self.barrier_ticker = 0
		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(self.character, self.remain_barrier_count, self.barrier_num_color, self.character.Position)
	end

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 투사체 발사
		if self.shot_count < self.num_shot then
			self.shot_timer = self.shot_timer + dt
			if self.shot_timer >= self.shot_interval then
				self.shot_timer = self.shot_timer - self.shot_interval

				local angle = self.shot_angle * self.shot_count
				if not self.isCW then
					angle = -angle
				end
				local calc_shot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0) * self.initial_direction
				local range = self:get_attack_range()
				battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, self.character.Position, calc_shot_dir)
				range:Show(self.shot_interval)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range")
				local calc_pos = self.character.Bounds.center + calc_shot_dir * self.shot_distance
				local calculator = self:get_calculator()
				calculator.Position = calc_pos

				table.insert(self.projectiles, {
					started = false,
					time_passed = -self.shot_interval,
					position = calc_pos,
					calculator = calculator,
					direction = -calc_shot_dir,
					attack_range = range
				})

				self.shot_count = self.shot_count + 1
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			-- 흡수 갯수에 따라 상태가 달라짐
			if self.consume_count == 0 then
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		-- 전체 공격
		if not self.attacked and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self.attacked = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("attack", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack1")
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("attack2")

			local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
			if targets ~= nil then
				for i = 0, targets.Count-1 do
					local fo = targets[i]
					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

						local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
						local knock_direction = direction

						if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
							knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
						end

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = direction
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				targets:Dispose()
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('BossCarmenDonationGuildBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- prepare
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 2)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 13)
	self.num_shot = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "NumShot", 12)
	self.shot_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "Angle", 30)
	self.shot_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDistance", 10)
	self.shot_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotMoveDuration", 1)
	self.shot_speed = self.shot_distance / self.shot_move_duration
	self.shot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadius", 0.5)
	self.shot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotInterval", 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 5)
	self.knockback_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1)
	self.is_forward = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsForward", true)
	self.is_use_riskmap = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, 'IsUseRiskMap', true)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.5)

	-- 레인지/충돌계산기 미리 생성
	self.attack_ranges = {}
	self.attack_calculators = {}
	for _ = 1, self.num_shot do
		local size = vector(self.shot_distance, self.shot_radius * 2)
		local range = self.is_forward and CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayReverse)
				or CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, range)

		local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = -1
		info.Duration = self.action_duration
		info.Radius = self.shot_radius
		local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculators, calculator)
	end

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_attack_range()
	if #self.attack_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_ranges)
	end

	local size = vector(self.shot_distance, self.shot_radius * 2)
	local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayReverse)
	return range
end

function local_class:return_attack_range(range)
	-- 이 액션은 어택레인지 이벤트 안씀
	range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))

	if self.attack_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:get_calculator()
	if #self.attack_calculators > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_calculators)
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.Radius = self.shot_radius
	local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
	return calculator
end

function local_class:return_calculator(calculator)
	calculator:End()
	if self.attack_calculators ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_calculators, calculator)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithPosition(self.character, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.center_pos))
	info:AppendDirection(vector_util.forward)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.initial_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.shot_count = 0

	local dir_to_look = direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(self.initial_direction))
	self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))

	-- 순간이동 처리
	local cp = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", cp, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.character.Position = cp
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink")

	-- 순간이동 한 위치에 적이 있다면 튕기기
	local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(cp, 0.5, 2)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects.Values[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = 0
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self:remove_all_projectiles()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:remove_all_projectiles()
	if self.projectiles == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
		local proj = self.projectiles[i]

		-- 오브젝트 제거
		if not is_unity_null(proj.pooled_object) then
			proj.pooled_object:Dispose()
		end
		proj.pooled_object = nil

		-- 어택 레인지 반납
		self:return_attack_range(proj.attack_range)
		proj.attack_range = nil

		-- 계산기 반납
		self:return_calculator(proj.calculator)
		proj.calculator = nil

		-- 제거
		table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
	end
	self.projectiles = nil
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
	self:remove_all_projectiles()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

		-- 첫 투사체 준비
		self.projectiles = {}
		self:set_projectile(-self.prepare_duration, self.initial_direction)
		--self.shot_count = 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_timer = self.shot_interval

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attacked = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("attack")

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:attack_calculate(calculator, dt)
	local hit = false
	local objects = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = (fo.Position - calculator.Position).normalized
			local knock_direction = direction
			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			hit = true
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
	return hit
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_protile(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 투사체 발사
		self:shoot_proj(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_proj(dt)
	if self.shot_count >= self.num_shot then
		return
	end

	self.shot_timer = self.shot_timer + dt

	if self.shot_timer < self.shot_interval then
		return
	end

	self.shot_timer = self.shot_timer - self.shot_interval

	local angle = self.shot_angle * self.shot_count
	local dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, angle, 0) * self.initial_direction
	self:set_projectile(-self.shot_interval, dir)
end

-- 투사체 갱신
function local_class:update_protile(dt)
	if self.projectiles == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
	for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
		local proj = self.projectiles[i]
		-- 시간 계산
		local proj_time_passed = proj.time_passed + dt
		proj.time_passed = proj_time_passed

		if proj.started then
			local calc_pos = proj.position + dt * self.shot_speed * proj.direction
			proj.position = calc_pos
			proj.calculator.Position = calc_pos
			CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(proj.pooled_object, calc_pos, proj.direction)

			local finish = self:attack_calculate(proj.calculator, dt)
			local consume_position = calc_pos

			-- 대상 맞지 않았고 경과 시간 도달 시 흡수
			if not finish and proj_time_passed >= self.shot_move_duration - 0.1 then
				-- 한칸 빨리 먹도록.
				finish = true
				consume_position = self.character.Bounds.center

				-- 도네이션 애니
				if self.is_forward then
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("get")
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("get")
				end
			end

			if finish then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("hit", consume_position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("hit", consume_position)

				-- 오브젝트 제거
				if not is_unity_null(proj.pooled_object) then
					proj.pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				proj.pooled_object = nil

				-- 어택 레인지 반납
				self:return_attack_range(proj.attack_range)
				proj.attack_range = nil

				-- 계산기 반납
				self:return_calculator(proj.calculator)
				proj.calculator = nil

				-- 제거
				table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
			end
		else
			if proj_time_passed >= 0 then
				proj.started = true
				local calc_pos = proj.position + proj_time_passed * self.shot_speed * proj.direction
				proj.position = calc_pos
				proj.calculator.Position = calc_pos
				proj.calculator:Start()
				proj.pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", calc_pos, proj.direction)
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("projectile", calc_pos)

				if not self.is_forward then
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("get")
					self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("get")
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_projectile(time_passed, dir)
	local pos = self.is_forward and self.character.Bounds.center + dir * self.shot_distance or self.character.Position
	local calculator = self:get_calculator()
	calculator.Position = pos

	local range = self:get_attack_range()
	range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, dir, self.character.Position.y)
	range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
	if self.is_use_riskmap then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range")

	table.insert(self.projectiles, {
		started = false,
		time_passed = time_passed,
		position = pos,
		calculator = calculator,
		direction = self.is_forward and -dir or dir,
		attack_range = range
	})
	self.shot_count = self.shot_count + 1
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.center_pos = bound.center
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
