	self.summon_margin = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SummonMargin", 0.5)

	self.fan_count = math.min(CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "FanNumbers", 2), 4)

	-- 팬 캐릭터 빈 리스트 생성 및 이름 캐싱
	self.fan_name_base = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "FanNameBase", "carmen_fan_")
	self.fan_characters = {}

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target) and battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.attack_radius
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.fan_positions == nil then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)

	local picker = {}
	for _,p in ipairs(self.fan_positions) do
		table.insert(picker, p)
	end

	local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(picker, {count = self.fan_count})

	for _, point in ipairs(random_points) do
		info:AppendPosition(battle_util.get_ground_pos(point))
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	-- 팬 소환은 시작하자마자 즉시 하도록 한다.
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	local summon_points = info.Positions
	local count = 0
	for _, fan_char in ipairs(self.fan_characters) do
		if fan_char.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead or not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(fan_char) then

			local pos = summon_points[count]
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon", pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			fan_char.Position = pos
			fan_char.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
			heal_info.heal = fan_char.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = fan_char

			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(fan_char, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(fan_char.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(fan_char, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			count = count + 1

			if count >= summon_points.Count then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if self.sfx_holder ~= nil then
			self.sfx_holder:Stop()
			self.sfx_holder = nil
		end
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_started = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("init")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_started = false
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if not self.attack_started and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			self.attack_started = true
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("stomp", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		end

		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	-- 모든 살아있는 팬 전부 강제 킬
	for _, fan_char in ipairs(self.fan_characters) do
		if not is_unity_null(fan_char) then
			if not fan_char.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
				if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(fan_char.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
					fan_char.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				else
					fan_char.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
					fan_char.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = fan_char
				damage_info.target = fan_char
				damage_info.noCritical = true
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(fan_char.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10)

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				fan_char.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- NOTE: 이 액션은 Dispose땐 force_cancel 불필요
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.attack_delay = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.fan_count = nil
	self.fan_name_base = nil

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.fan_positions = nil
	self.fan_characters = nil
end

-- 배틀존 세팅 필요할 시 조건부
function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	local min = bound.min
	local max = bound.max
	local center = bound.center

	-- 존 상하좌우 위치
	self.fan_positions = {
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, max.z - self.summon_margin),
		unity_class.vector3(min.x + self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(max.x - self.summon_margin, 0, center.z),
		unity_class.vector3(center.x, 0, min.z + self.summon_margin)
	}
end

-- 팬 캐릭터 리스트 생성
function local_class:initialize_fan_list()
	-- 팬 캐릭터
	self.fan_characters = {}

	for i = 1, 99 do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.fan_name_base, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			table.insert(self.fan_characters, obj)
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

function local_class:change_state_ring(next_state)

	end

	if self.current_state_ring == self.ring_state.action then

		if self.fx_field ~= nil then

			self.fx_field = nil

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.ring_virtual_range))

	if next_state == self.ring_state.action then

		self.field_calc:Start()
		self.fx_field = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("field", self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero)

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)

function local_class:update_ring(dt)

	self.ring_time_passed = self.ring_time_passed + dt

function local_class:dispose()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

			local grids = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.GetDonutIntersectGrids(self.character.Position, self.ring_out_radius, self.ring_in_radius)

function local_class:check_ring_area(dt)
	for i = #self.remain_cool_times, 1, -1 do
		self.remain_cool_times[i].remain_time = self.remain_cool_times[i].remain_time - dt
		if self.remain_cool_times[i].remain_time <= 0 then
			table.remove(self.remain_cool_times, i)
		end
	end

	local candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.ring_out_radius)
	for index = 0, candidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = candidates[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local fo_dist = battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, fo)
			if fo_dist >= self.ring_in_radius then
				-- 쿨타임 확인
				local is_hited = false
				if #self.remain_cool_times > 0 then
					for _,v in pairs(self.remain_cool_times) do
						if lua_helper.reference_equals(v.fo, fo) then
							is_hited = true
						end
					end
				end

				if not is_hited then
					local fo_info =
					{
						fo = fo,
						remain_time = self.field_tick_time
					}
					table.insert(self.remain_cool_times, fo_info)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.field_tick_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	candidates:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.projectiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 시간 계산
			local proj_time_passed = self.projectiles[i].time_passed + dt
			self.projectiles[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if proj_time_passed >= self.explosion_delay then
				-- 폭발 판정
				local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.projectiles[i].position, self.explosion_radius, 2)
				for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
					local fo = objects.Values[index]

					-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
						local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
						local knock_direction = direction

						if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
							knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
						end

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
						damage_info.direction = direction
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
					end
				end
				objects:Dispose()

				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.projectiles[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				if self.projectiles[i].play_sfx then
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.projectiles[i].position)
				end


				-- 어택 레인지 반납
				self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
				self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil

				-- 제거
				table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 강화상태라면 장판 업데이트 데미지
		if self.enhanced then
			self:check_ring_area(dt)
		end

		-- 시간 경과에 따라 싱크 커맨드
		if self.sliced_zone_bounds ~= nil then
			if self.random_shot_counter < self.num_random_shot then
				self.random_shot_timer = self.random_shot_timer + dt

				if self.random_shot_timer >= self.random_shot_interval then
					self.random_shot_timer = self.random_shot_timer - self.random_shot_interval
					self.random_shot_counter = self.random_shot_counter + 1

					-- 폭발 위치 선택
					local available_shoot_points = {}
					for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
						-- 현재 캐릭터가 존재하지 않는 곳을 후보로
						if not bound:Intersects(self.character.Bounds) then
							table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound)
						end
					end

					local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)

					local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, {count = self.amount_per_random_shot})
					for _, bound in ipairs(random_points) do
						local rand_x = (math.random() - 0.5) * (bound.max.x - bound.min.x) / 2 + bound.center.x
						local rand_z = (math.random() - 0.5) * (bound.max.z - bound.min.z) / 2 + bound.center.z
						local final_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(unity_class.vector3(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
						info:AppendPosition(final_pos)
					end

					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end

			if self.manual_shot_counter < self.num_manual_shot then
				self.manual_shot_timer = self.manual_shot_timer + dt

				if self.manual_shot_timer >= self.manual_shot_interval then
					self.manual_shot_timer = self.manual_shot_timer - self.manual_shot_interval
					self.manual_shot_counter = self.manual_shot_counter + 1

					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target.Position)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
				end
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 싱크 위치에 폭발 정보 추가
		local exp_poses = info.Positions
		-- 소리 너무 겹쳐서 매뉴얼 찍고 쓸때만 쏘도록
		local play_sfx = false
		if exp_poses.Count == 1 then
			play_sfx = true
		end
		for i = 0, exp_poses.Count - 1 do
			local aim_pos = exp_poses[i]
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("core", aim_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			if play_sfx then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("core", aim_pos)
			end
			local range = self:get_attack_range()
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(range, aim_pos)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			-- 이펙트랑 겹쳐서 별로라 안보이게 변경
			-- range:Show(0)
			table.insert(self.projectiles, {
				position = aim_pos,
				time_passed = -0.5*i*self.random_shot_interval/self.amount_per_random_shot,
				attack_range = range,
				play_sfx = play_sfx
			})
		end
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.attack_ranges = {}
	for _ = 1, 6 do
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, range)
	end

	-- 상태 초기화

function local_class:get_attack_range()
	if #self.attack_ranges > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.attack_ranges)
	else
		local range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.explosion_radius)
		range:Hide()
		return range
	end
end

function local_class:return_attack_range(range)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, range))

	if self.attack_ranges ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, range)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

end

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

		self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))

		self:remove_all_object()

		self:change_state(self.state.prepare)

			self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil

			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if next_state ~= self.state.groggy then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.random_shot_counter = 0
		self.random_shot_timer = 0
		self.manual_shot_counter = 0
		self.manual_shot_timer = 0
	elseif next_state == self.state.groggy then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("groggy")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_explosion(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:update_explosion_sync(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion(dt)
	if self.projectiles == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
	for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
		-- 시간 계산
		local proj_time_passed = self.projectiles[i].time_passed + dt
		self.projectiles[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

		if proj_time_passed >= self.explosion_delay then
			-- 폭발 판정
			local objects = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.projectiles[i].position, self.explosion_radius, 2)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects.Values[index]

				-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
					local knock_direction = direction

					if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
						knock_direction = -direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(fo))
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", self.projectiles[i].position, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			if self.projectiles[i].play_sfx then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", self.projectiles[i].position)
			end


			-- 어택 레인지 반납
			self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil

			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_explosion_sync(dt)
	if self.sliced_zone_bounds == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 시간 경과에 따라 싱크 커맨드
	if self.random_shot_counter < self.num_random_shot then
		self.random_shot_timer = self.random_shot_timer + dt

		if self.random_shot_timer >= self.random_shot_interval then
			self.random_shot_timer = self.random_shot_timer - self.random_shot_interval
			self.random_shot_counter = self.random_shot_counter + 1

			-- 폭발 위치 선택
			local available_shoot_points = {}
			for _, bound in ipairs(self.sliced_zone_bounds) do
				-- 현재 캐릭터가 존재하지 않는 곳을 후보로
				if not bound:Intersects(self.character.Bounds) then
					table.insert(available_shoot_points, bound)
				end
			end

			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)

			local random_points = random_util.get_values_in_array(available_shoot_points, { count = self.amount_per_random_shot })
			for _, bound in ipairs(random_points) do
				local rand_x = (math.random() - 0.5) * (bound.max.x - bound.min.x) / 2 + bound.center.x
				local rand_z = (math.random() - 0.5) * (bound.max.z - bound.min.z) / 2 + bound.center.z
				local final_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(unity_class.vector3(rand_x, 0, rand_z))
				info:AppendPosition(final_pos)
			end

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end

	if self.manual_shot_counter < self.num_manual_shot then
		self.manual_shot_timer = self.manual_shot_timer + dt

		if self.manual_shot_timer >= self.manual_shot_interval then
			self.manual_shot_timer = self.manual_shot_timer - self.manual_shot_interval
			self.manual_shot_counter = self.manual_shot_counter + 1

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, self.target.Position)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		-- 싱크 위치에 폭발 정보 추가
		local exp_poses = info.Positions
		-- 소리 너무 겹쳐서 매뉴얼 찍고 쓸때만 쏘도록
		local play_sfx = false
		if exp_poses.Count == 1 then
			play_sfx = true
		end
		for i = 0, exp_poses.Count - 1 do
			local aim_pos = exp_poses[i]
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("core", aim_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

			if play_sfx then
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("core", aim_pos)
			end
			local range = self:get_attack_range()
			range:SetupByPosition(aim_pos, aim_pos.y)
			range:Show(self.explosion_delay)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			-- 이펙트랑 겹쳐서 별로라 안보이게 변경
			-- range:Show(0)
			table.insert(self.projectiles, {
				position = aim_pos,
				time_passed = -0.5 * i * self.random_shot_interval / self.amount_per_random_shot,
				attack_range = range,
				play_sfx = play_sfx
			})
		end
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

local local_class = newclass('BossCarmenReturnShotBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced")
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MoveDuration", 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)
	self.shot_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDistance", 10)
	self.shot_move_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotMoveDuration", 1)
	self.shot_speed = self.shot_distance / self.shot_move_duration
	self.shot_return_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ReturnSpeed", self.shot_speed)
	self.shot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadius", 0.5)
	self.repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RepeatCount", 2)

	-- 레인지/충돌계산기 4개 미리 생성
	self.attack_ranges = {}
	self.attack_calculators = {}
	for _ = 1, 4 do
		local range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.shot_distance, self.shot_radius * 2, 0)
		table.insert(self.attack_ranges, range)

		local info = CS.Oak.SphereCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
		info.DamageTerm = 0.5
		-- 시간이 정해지지 않았으므로 적당히 길게 잡음
		info.Duration = 30
		info.Radius = self.shot_radius
		local calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info)
		table.insert(self.attack_calculators, calculator)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		interval = 4,
		recall = 5,
		post = 6
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target) and battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.shot_distance
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)

	if self.enhanced then
		-- 모든 적에게 발사
		local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
		if targets ~= nil then
			for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
				local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, targets[index])
				info:AppendDirection(target_dir)
			end

			info:AppendNumber(targets.Count)
			targets:Dispose()
		end
	else
		-- 타겟에게만 발사
		local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, target)
		info:AppendDirection(target_dir)
		info:AppendNumber(1)
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.shot_directions = {}
	local shot_num = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0))
	for index = 0, shot_num - 1 do
		table.insert(self.shot_directions, info:GetDirectionAt(index))
	end

	self:remove_all_projectiles()
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	-- 캔슬 됐을때 투사체도 바로 지움
	self:remove_all_projectiles()
end

function local_class:remove_all_projectiles()
	if self.projectiles ~= nil then
		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object) then

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recall then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true

		self.current_action_count = 0
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")

	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true

		self.current_action_count = self.current_action_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")

		-- 투사체 발사
		self.projectiles = {}
		for i = 1, #self.shot_directions do
			local dir = self.shot_directions[i]
			local range = self:get_attack_range()
			range.Size = unity_class.vector2(self.shot_distance, self.shot_radius * 2)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(range, self.character.Position, dir)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			local center_pos = self.character.Bounds.center
			local calculator = self:get_calculator()
			calculator.Position = center_pos
			calculator:Start()
			table.insert(self.projectiles, {
				phase = 1,
				position = center_pos,
				direction = dir,
				time_passed = 0,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", center_pos, dir),
				attack_range = range,
				calculator = calculator,
				sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("projectile", center_pos)
			})
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = false
		-- 걷는 애니메이션 나올것이므로 배틀액션 애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif next_state == self.state.recall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true

		self.synced = false

		-- 투사체들 방향 바꾸고, 어택 레인지 업데이트
		for i = 1, #self.projectiles do
			self.projectiles[i].phase = 3
			local pos_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.projectiles[i].position - self.character.Position)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range.Size = unity_class.vector2(pos_diff.magnitude, self.shot_radius * 2)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.projectiles[i].attack_range, self.character.Position, pos_diff.normalized)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.projectiles[i].attack_range))
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("recall")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("recall")

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = nil

	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:attack_calculate(calculator, dt)
	local objects = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.projectiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
			local proj_time_passed =  self.projectiles[i].time_passed + dt
			self.projectiles[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if self.projectiles[i].phase == 1 then
				local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + dt * self.shot_speed * self.projectiles[i].direction
				self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
				self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)

				-- 이동 완료 됐다면 페이즈 넘김
				if proj_time_passed >= self.shot_move_duration then
					self.projectiles[i].phase = 2
				end
			elseif self.projectiles[i].phase == 2 then
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)
			elseif self.projectiles[i].phase == 3 then
				local diff_to_character = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.projectiles[i].position)
				local diff_mag = diff_to_character.magnitude
				local move_mag = dt * self.shot_return_speed
				local is_done = false

				if move_mag >= diff_mag then
					move_mag = diff_mag
					is_done = true
				end

				local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + move_mag * diff_to_character.normalized
				self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
				self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)

				if is_done then
					-- 사라지는 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("finish", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					-- 오브젝트 삭제
					if not is_unity_null(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object) then
						self.projectiles[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.projectiles[i].pooled_object = nil
					-- 어택레인지 반환
					self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
					self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil
					-- 계산기 반납
					self:return_calculator(self.projectiles[i].calculator)
					self.projectiles[i].calculator = nil
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
				else
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
					-- sfx position
					if self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
						self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder:SetPosition(calc_pos)
					end

					-- 돌아오는 이펙트 스케일링
					if diff_mag  < 4.0 then
						-- 사운드 중지 (페이드)
						if self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
							self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.4)
							self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder = nil
						end
						local final_scale = 0.6
						local calc_scale = final_scale + (1 - final_scale) * diff_mag / 4.0
						self.projectiles[i].pooled_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(calc_scale, calc_scale, calc_scale)
					end

				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.recall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recall then
		if self.synced == false and #self.projectiles == 0 then
			self.synced = true

			-- Sync Command
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(self.current_action_count + 1)
			if self.enhanced then
				-- 모든 적에게 발사
				local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
				if targets ~= nil then
					for index = 0, targets.Count-1 do
						local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, targets[index])
						info:AppendDirection(target_dir)
					end

					info:AppendNumber(targets.Count)
					targets:Dispose()
				end
			else
				-- 타겟에게만 발사
				local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.action_target)
				info:AppendDirection(target_dir)
				info:AppendNumber(1)
			end

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.current_state == self.state.recall then
		local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1))
		if self.current_action_count + 1 == idx then
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self.shot_directions = {}
				local shot_num = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(1))
				for index = 0, shot_num - 1 do
					table.insert(self.shot_directions, info:GetDirectionAt(index))
				end

				self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_ranges = nil
	self.attack_calculators = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
			end

			local center_pos = self.character.Bounds.center
			local calculator = self:get_calculator()
			calculator.Position = center_pos
			calculator:Start()
			table.insert(self.projectiles, {
				phase = 1,
				position = center_pos,
				direction = dir,
				time_passed = 0,
				pooled_object = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("projectile", center_pos, dir),
				attack_range = range,
				calculator = calculator,
				sfx_holder = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("projectile", center_pos)
			})
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = false
		-- 걷는 애니메이션 나올것이므로 배틀액션 애니메이션 제거
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif next_state == self.state.recall then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true

		self.synced = false

		-- 투사체들 방향 바꾸고, 어택 레인지 업데이트
		for i = 1, #self.projectiles do
			self.projectiles[i].phase = 3
			local pos_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.projectiles[i].position - self.character.Position)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range.Size = unity_class.vector2(pos_diff.magnitude, self.shot_radius * 2)
			self.projectiles[i].attack_range:SetupByDirection(self.character.Position, pos_diff.normalized)

			if self.is_use_riskmap then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.projectiles[i].attack_range))
			end
		end

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("recall")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("recall")

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.cs_battle_action.IsControllingCharacter = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:attack_calculate(calculator, dt)
	local objects = calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 투사체 업데이트
	if self.projectiles ~= nil then
		-- 중간에 하나씩 지워지는 처리 간단히 하기 위해 역순으로.
		for i = #self.projectiles, 1, -1 do
			local proj_time_passed =  self.projectiles[i].time_passed + dt
			self.projectiles[i].time_passed = proj_time_passed

			if self.projectiles[i].phase == 1 then
				local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + dt * self.shot_speed * self.projectiles[i].direction
				self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
				CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
				self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)

				-- 이동 완료 됐다면 페이즈 넘김
				if proj_time_passed >= self.shot_move_duration then
					self.projectiles[i].phase = 2
				end
			elseif self.projectiles[i].phase == 2 then
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)
			elseif self.projectiles[i].phase == 3 then
				local diff_to_character = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position - self.projectiles[i].position)
				local diff_mag = diff_to_character.magnitude
				local move_mag = dt * self.shot_return_speed
				local is_done = false

				if move_mag >= diff_mag then
					move_mag = diff_mag
					is_done = true
				end

				local calc_pos = self.projectiles[i].position + move_mag * diff_to_character.normalized
				self.projectiles[i].position = calc_pos
				self.projectiles[i].calculator.Position = calc_pos
				self:attack_calculate(self.projectiles[i].calculator, dt)

				if is_done then
					-- 사라지는 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("finish", calc_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					-- 오브젝트 삭제
					if not is_unity_null(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object) then
						self.projectiles[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
					end
					self.projectiles[i].pooled_object = nil
					-- 어택레인지 반환
					self:return_attack_range(self.projectiles[i].attack_range)
					self.projectiles[i].attack_range = nil
					-- 계산기 반납
					self:return_calculator(self.projectiles[i].calculator)
					self.projectiles[i].calculator = nil
					-- 제거
					table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
				else
					CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.projectiles[i].pooled_object, calc_pos, self.projectiles[i].direction)
					-- sfx position
					if self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
						self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder:SetPosition(calc_pos)
					end

					-- 돌아오는 이펙트 스케일링
					if diff_mag  < 4.0 then
						-- 사운드 중지 (페이드)
						if self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder ~= nil then
							self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder:FadeOut(0.4)
							self.projectiles[i].sfx_holder = nil
						end
						local final_scale = 0.6
						local calc_scale = final_scale + (1 - final_scale) * diff_mag / 4.0
						self.projectiles[i].pooled_object.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(calc_scale, calc_scale, calc_scale)
					end

				end
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.recall)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.recall then
		if self.synced == false and #self.projectiles == 0 then
			self.synced = true

			-- Sync Command
			local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			info:AppendNumber(self.current_action_count + 1)
			local targets = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
			if targets ~= nil then
				for index = 0, targets.Count - 1 do
					local target_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, targets[index])
					info:AppendDirection(target_dir)
				end

				info:AppendNumber(targets.Count)
				targets:Dispose()
			end

			local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
			command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.current_state == self.state.recall then
		local idx = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(0, -1))
		if self.current_action_count + 1 == idx then
			if self.current_action_count < self.repeat_count then
				self.shot_directions = {}
				local shot_num = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(info:GetNumberAt(1))
				for index = 0, shot_num - 1 do
					table.insert(self.shot_directions, info:GetDirectionAt(index))
				end

				self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.attack_ranges = nil
	self.attack_calculators = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossChancellorBasicAttackBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	local has_action, action_animation_info = self.cs_battle_action.AnimationInfos:TryGetValue('action')
	self.has_action_anim = has_action
	if self.has_action_anim then
		local action_animation_name = action_animation_info.name
		local action_animation_time = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.character.SpineController, action_animation_name)
		self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', action_animation_time)
		self.shoot_duration = self.action_duration * 0.9
		self.action_timescale = self.action_duration / action_animation_time
	else
		self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 4)
		self.action_timescale = 1
	end

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)

	self.beam_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamWidth', 2)
	self.beam_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamLength', 10)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 0.2)

	self.beam_offset_forward = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'BeamOffsetForward', 1)
	self.beam_offset = unity_class.vector3(-0.2, 1.3, -1.4)
	self.initial_dir = unity_class.vector3(-0.81, 0.00, 0.58)

	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(self.beam_length, self.beam_width))

	self.attack_calc_y_extent = bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(self.beam_length, self.attack_calc_y_extent * 2, self.beam_width),
			self.action_duration, damage_term, true
	)
	self.attack_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character,
			info, true, 0.1, self.wave_max_hit)

	-- side 고정임
	local bone_shoulder_name = 'side_armB_shoulder'
	local bone_hand_name = 'side_handB'

	self.fx_target_bone_shoulder = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController, bone_shoulder_name)
	self.fx_target_bone_hand = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController, bone_hand_name)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end



function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local actual_shoot_z_offset = 2.5
	local from = self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3.forward * actual_shoot_z_offset
	local to = target.Position
	return vector_util.get_x0z(to - from).magnitude <= self.beam_length + self.beam_offset_forward
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.has_action_anim and next_state == self.state.action then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.attack_calculator)
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = 1

		if self.beam_fx ~= nil then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.beam_fx)
			self.beam_fx = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local shoulder_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
				self.fx_target_bone_shoulder, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
		local character_pos_y = self.character.Position.y
		shoulder_pos = unity_class.vector3(shoulder_pos.x, character_pos_y, shoulder_pos.y + shoulder_pos.z - character_pos_y)
		local pos = shoulder_pos + self.initial_dir * self.beam_offset_forward
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.initial_dir)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.has_action_anim then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		end

		area_collision_util.start(self.attack_calculator)
		self.character.SpineController.TimeScale = self.action_timescale

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.shoot_duration then
			self:update_beam(dt)
		elseif self.beam_fx ~= nil then
			if not is_unity_null(self.beam_fx) then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.beam_fx)
			end
			self.beam_fx = nil
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.attack_calculator)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_beam(dt)
	local character_pos_y = self.character.Position.y
	local shoulder_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.fx_target_bone_shoulder, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	shoulder_pos = unity_class.vector3(shoulder_pos.x, character_pos_y, shoulder_pos.y + shoulder_pos.z - character_pos_y)
	local hand_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.fx_target_bone_hand, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	hand_pos = unity_class.vector3(hand_pos.x, character_pos_y, hand_pos.y + hand_pos.z - character_pos_y)
	local shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(hand_pos - shoulder_pos)
	local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(hand_pos + shoot_dir * self.beam_offset_forward,
			character_pos_y + 0.5) + self.beam_offset

	if self.beam_fx == nil then
		self.beam_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fire', shoot_pos, shoot_dir)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('fire')
	end

	shoot_pos.y = character_pos_y + self.attack_calc_y_extent
	effect_util.update_object(self.beam_fx, shoot_pos, shoot_dir)
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.attack_calculator, shoot_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.attack_calculator, shoot_dir)

	local fo_table = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.attack_calculator, dt)
	for _, fo in ipairs(fo_table) do repeat
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.direction = shoot_dir
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	until true end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
	self.beam_offset = nil
	self.initial_dir = nil

	self.fx_target_bone_shoulder = nil
	self.fx_target_bone_hand = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		return false

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return
	end

	self.character.Direction = direction_util.left
	if self.hand_follower == nil then
		local shooter_bone_name = 'side_handA2'
		self.hand_follower = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject('boss_chancellor_hand_bone_follower')
		local bone_follower = self.hand_follower:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
		bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
		bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = self.character.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
		bone_follower:SetBone(shooter_bone_name)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx, true)
		end
		self.cast_fx = nil

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		self:update_shoot_dir()

		-- 캐릭터 방향은 왼쪽 고정인 것으로 가정
		-- character_util.set_direction(self.character, vector_util.to_direction(dir))
		local transform = self.hand_follower.transform
		local pos = transform.position + self.cast_fx_offset
		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', pos, vector_util.zero, transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_shoot_dir()
	-- 총구 위치로 변경 필요
	local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset
	local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - shoot_pos)
	local dir = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, shoot_pos, dir)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local prev_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_shoot_dir()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed < self.attack_delay then
			self:update_shoot_dir()
		elseif prev_time_passed <= self.attack_delay and self.time_passed >= self.attack_delay then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

			-- 총구 위치로 변경 필요
			local shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - shoot_pos)
			local dir =vector_util.normalized(diff)
			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos,
					dir, 1, vector_util.magnitude(diff), nil, false)

			-- 발사 연출
			local transform = self.hand_follower.transform
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('shoot', transform.position + self.shot_fx_offset,
					unity_class.vector3.left, transform)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot')
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.hand_follower) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.hand_follower)
	end
	self.hand_follower = nil
	self.shoot_offset = nil
	self.cast_fx_offset = nil
	self.shot_fx_offset = nil
end

-- 프로젝타일 슈터 구현 시 조건 부 함수
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	else
		return false
	end

	-- hit 연출
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', hit_info.position)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion')

	local target = hit_info.target
	if hit_info.hitType ~= projectile_hit_type.field_object or target == nil then
		return true
	end

	if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
		return true
	end

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.poison_ailment_buff_id = self.poison_buff_id

	damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1)
	damage_info.force_ailment = true

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	return true
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()

function local_class:is_loaded()

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	end

function local_class:trigger()

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.has_action_anim and next_state == self.state.action then

		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

		local pos = self.character.Position

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.target_direction)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if self.has_action_anim then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		end

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		local pos = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Position = pos
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		-- 공걱 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('slash', pos, self.target_direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('slash')

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state

		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:calculate_attack(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:calculate_attack(dt)
	-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			break
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = self.target_direction
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = self.target_direction
		damage_info.knock_back_force = self.knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.attack_radius = nil
	self.knock_back_force = nil

	self.target_direction = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
