	obj.owner = owner
	obj.is_active = false

	return obj
end

function tick_damage_class:set_param(tick_duration, damage_term, damage_modifier, tick_preset)
	self.tick_duration = tick_duration
	self.damage_term = damage_term
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	self.tick_preset = tick_preset
	self.max_tick_count = math.floor(tick_duration / damage_term)
end

function tick_damage_class:unset_param()
	self.tick_duration = nil
	self.damage_term = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.tick_preset = nil
	self.max_tick_count = nil
end

function tick_damage_class:activate(target)
	self.target = target
	self.is_active = true

	self.tick_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.tick_preset,
			target.Position, vector_util.zero, target.transform)
	self.tick_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function tick_damage_class:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= (self.tick_count + 1) * self.damage_term then
		self.tick_count = self.tick_count + 1

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = self.target
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

		if self.tick_count >= self.max_tick_count then
			self.is_active = false
		end
	end
end

function tick_damage_class:deactivate(is_immediate)
	if self.tick_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.tick_fx, is_immediate)
		self.tick_fx = nil
	end

	self.target = nil
	self.is_active = false
	self.time_passed = nil
end

function tick_damage_class:dispose()
	self:deactivate(true)

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	local has_action, action_animation_info = self.cs_battle_action.AnimationInfos:TryGetValue('action')
	local action_animation_name = action_animation_info.name
	local action_animation_time = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetAnimationDuration(self.character.SpineController, action_animation_name)

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 2)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', has_action and action_animation_time or 0.75)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)

	self.max_target_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'MaxTargetCount', 3)

	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 1)
	local damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 0.2)
	local damage_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageDuration', 10)
	tick_damage_class:set_param(damage_duration, damage_term, damage_modifier, 'tick')

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.tick_instance_pool = {}
	self.active_tick_table = {}

	self.cast_animation_time = 0.333

	table.insert(self.tick_instance_pool, tick_damage_class:new(self, self.character))

	self.cast_fx_target_bone = CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.GetBone(self.character.SpineController, 'side_handA2')
	self.cast_fx_offset = unity_class.vector3(-0.27,2,-0.6)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(_)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:get_tick_instance()
	local pool_count = #self.tick_instance_pool
	if pool_count == 0 then
		local new_instance = tick_damage_class:new(self, self.character)
		table.insert(self.active_tick_table, new_instance)
		return new_instance
	end

	local pooled_instance = self.tick_instance_pool[pool_count]
	self.tick_instance_pool[pool_count] = nil
	table.insert(self.active_tick_table, pooled_instance)
	pooled_instance.table_index = #self.active_tick_table
	return pooled_instance
end

function local_class:return_tick(instance, index)
	instance:deactivate(false)
	table.remove(self.active_tick_table, index)
	table.insert(self.tick_instance_pool, instance)
end

function local_class:start_cast_fx()
	-- 캐스팅 이펙트
	local cast_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.cast_fx_target_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	cast_pos.z = cast_pos.z + cast_pos.y
	cast_pos.y = self.character.Position.y
	cast_pos = cast_pos + self.cast_fx_offset
	self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', cast_pos)
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', cast_pos)
end

function local_class:mark_targets()
	-- 타겟 탐색
	self.target_list = {}
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(self.character.Position, self.zone_bound)

	local count = 0
	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo)
		-- TODO: 임시로 베이스 오브젝트 제외 로직 제거
		--		and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.base_obj, fo)
		then
			table.insert(self.target_list, fo)
			count = count + 1

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('marker',
					fo.Position, vector_util.zero, fo.Transform)

			if count >= self.max_target_count then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	--if count < self.max_target_count then
		--local tick = self:get_tick_instance()
		--tick:activate(self.base_obj)
		--count = count + 1
	--end

	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_cast_fx_pos()
	if is_unity_null(self.cast_fx_target_bone) or is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
		return
	end

	local cast_pos = CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonExtensions.GetWorldPosition(
			self.cast_fx_target_bone, self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	cast_pos.z = cast_pos.z + cast_pos.y
	cast_pos.y = self.character.Position.y
	cast_pos = cast_pos + self.cast_fx_offset
	effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, cast_pos)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.prepare_duration
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		end
		self.cast_fx = nil

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.target_list = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.action_duration

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.post_duration

	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')

		if self.target_list ~= nil then
			for _, target in ipairs(self.target_list) do
				local tick = self:get_tick_instance()
				tick:activate(target)
			end
			self.target_list = nil
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.time_passed = 0

	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_tick_damage(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
			return
		end

		if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
			self:update_cast_fx_pos()
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.cast_animation_time then
			self:start_cast_fx()
			self:mark_targets()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:update_tick_damage(dt)
	local count = #self.active_tick_table
	for index = count, 1, -1 do
		local tick = self.active_tick_table[index]
		tick:update_frame(dt)

		if not tick.is_active then
			self:return_tick(tick, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:return_all_ticks()
	local count = #self.active_tick_table
	for index = count, 1, -1 do
		local tick = self.active_tick_table[index]
		if tick ~= nil then
			self:return_tick(tick, index)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:return_all_ticks()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	tick_damage_class:unset_param()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	for _, v in ipairs(self.active_tick_table) do
		v:dispose()
	end
	self.active_tick_table = nil

	for _,v in ipairs(self.tick_instance_pool) do
		v:dispose()
	end
	self.tick_instance_pool = nil
	self.cast_fx_target_bone = nil
	self.cast_fx_offset = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.zone_bound = nil
	self.base_obj = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

function local_class:set_base_object(obj)
	self.base_obj = obj
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossChoumaAcidShotBattleAction')

local acid_projectile_class = {
	state = {
		none = 0,
		wait = 1,
		up = 2,
		down = 3
	},
	action = nil,
	cs_action = nil,
	index = nil,
	position = nil,
	delay = nil,
	down_duration = nil,
	up_duration = nil,
	fall_height = nil,
	preset_info = nil,
}
acid_projectile_class.mt = { __index = acid_projectile_class }

function acid_projectile_class:new(parent_class, index, delay, down_duration, up_duration, fall_height, preset_info)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.index = index
	obj.position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	obj.delay = delay
	obj.down_duration = down_duration
	obj.up_duration = up_duration
	obj.fall_height = fall_height
	obj.preset_info = preset_info

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	return obj
end

function acid_projectile_class:init(target, shoot_pos, radius, on_projectile_fall)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.target = target
	self.pos = shoot_pos
	self.shoot_pos = shoot_pos

	self.proj_fx = nil
	self.trail_fx = nil
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero,
			radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()
	self.on_projectile_fall = on_projectile_fall

	self:change_state(self.state.up)
end

function acid_projectile_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.up then
		self:remove_fx()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.down then
		self:remove_fx()
		self:remove_attack_range()
	end

	if next_state == self.state.up then
		self.shoot_dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.up
		self.proj_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.preset_info.proj, self.shoot_pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
		self.trail_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.preset_info.trail, self.shoot_pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
	elseif next_state == self.state.wait then
	elseif next_state == self.state.down then
		self.target_pos = self.target.Position
		self.shoot_dir_vector = unity_class.vector3.down
		self.proj_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.preset_info.proj, self.shoot_pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
		self.trail_fx = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect(self.preset_info.trail, self.shoot_pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.down_duration)
	else
		if self.on_projectile_fall then
			self.on_projectile_fall(self.action, self, self.target_pos)
			self.on_projectile_fall = nil
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function acid_projectile_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.up then
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.up_duration
		local current_height = math.sqrt(progress) * self.fall_height
		self.pos = self.shoot_pos + current_height * unity_class.vector3.up
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_fx, self.pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)

		if progress > 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.wait)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wait then
		if self.time_passed >= self.delay then
			self:change_state(self.state.down)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.down then
		local progress = self.time_passed / self.down_duration
		local current_height = (1 - progress * progress) * self.fall_height
		self.pos = self.target_pos + current_height * unity_class.vector3.up
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_fx, self.pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.trail_fx, self.pos, self.shoot_dir_vector)

		if progress > 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function acid_projectile_class:remove_fx()
	if self.proj_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_fx)
		self.proj_fx = nil
	end

	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end
end

function acid_projectile_class:remove_attack_range()
	if self.attack_range then

		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	else

		self.target = nil

		self.shoot_offset = nil
		self.fire_effect_offset = nil
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:shoot()
	self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1
	self.shoot_pos = self.character.Position + self.shoot_offset
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.shoot_sfx_key, self.shoot_pos)

	local index = self:get_first_nil_index(self.projectiles)
	local projectile = acid_projectile_class:new(self, index, self.projectile_fall_delay,
			self.projectile_fall_duration, self.projectile_ascend_duration, self.fall_height, self.preset_key_info)
	projectile:init(self.target, self.shoot_pos, self.aoe_spec.radius, self.on_projectile_fall)

	self.projectiles[index] = projectile

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.preset_key_info.shoot, self.character.Position + self.fire_effect_offset)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.15)
end

function local_class:on_projectile_fall(proj, fall_pos)
	self.projectiles[proj.index] = nil
	proj:dispose()

	local floor_height = field:GetTileInfoAt(fall_pos):GetHeightAt(fall_pos)
	local mod_pos = fall_pos:GetX0z(floor_height)

	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.explosion_sfx_key, fall_pos)

	stage.AreaOfEffectManager:StartAoe(self.character, mod_pos,
			self.cs_battle_action:GetEffectPool(self.preset_key_info.aoe), self.aoe_spec)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.1, 0.2)
end

function local_class:get_first_nil_index(table)
	local i = 1
	while table[i] ~= nil do
		i = i + 1
	end
	return i
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	-- 투사체 aoe
	self.aoe_spec = nil

	-- 투사체 제거
	if self.projectiles then
		for i,v in pairs(self.projectiles) do
			v:dispose()
			table.remove(self.projectiles, i)
		end
		self.projectiles = nil
	end

	-- 사운드 프리로드
	self.shoot_sfx_name = nil
	self.explosion_sfx_name = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function medusa_laser:update_frame(dt, pos, rot)

function medusa_laser:update_transform(pos, rot)
	self.pos = pos
	self.rotation = rot
	local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.initial_rotation + rot, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
	dir = unity_class.vector3(dir.z,0,-dir.x)
	effect_util.update_object(self.fx, self.pos, dir)

function medusa_laser:update_damage(dt, pos, dir)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = pos + self.max_length * 0.5 * dir
	self.attack_calculator.Direction = unity_class.vector3(dir.z,0,-dir.x)

function medusa_laser:get_ray_dist_to_bound(dir_vector3)
	local origin = unity_class.vector2(self.pos.x, self.pos.z)
	local dir = unity_class.vector2(dir_vector3.x, dir_vector3.z)

	if dir.y < 0 and origin.y > self.battle_zone.min.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.y > 0 and origin.y < self.battle_zone.max.z then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	if dir.x < 0 and origin.x > self.battle_zone.min.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.min.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	elseif dir.x > 0 and origin.x < self.battle_zone.max.x then
		local v1 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.min.z)
		local v2 = unity_class.vector2(self.battle_zone.max.x,self.battle_zone.max.z)
		local result, intersection = CS.GeometryUtils.FindLineSegmentRayIntersection2D(origin, dir, v1, v2)
		if result then
			return math.sqrt((intersection.x - origin.x) ^ 2 + (intersection.y - origin.y) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	return 0
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	-- RiskMap 형성용 가상 어택레인지

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	if self.battle_zone == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.battle_zone = battle_zone_bound
	end
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.battle_zone.center)
	cmd:AppendPosition(self.battle_zone.size)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true

function local_class:start(info)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	if self.battle_zone == nil then
		self.battle_zone = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(info:GetPositionAt(0), info:GetPositionAt(1))
	end

	if self.battle_zone == nil then
		local battle_zone_bound = battle_util.get_zone_bound(self.character.Position)
		if battle_zone_bound == nil then
			battle_zone_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector3.one * 10)
		end
		self.battle_zone = battle_zone_bound
	end

	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare_charge)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then return end
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.travel_dist >= self.charge_len then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		else
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.charge_direction
			move_info.magnitude = dt * self.charge_speed
			self.travel_dist = self.travel_dist + move_info.magnitude

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.charge_direction),
					true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]
				if fo.Position.z > self.charge_dest.z then
					local fo_pos = fo.Position
					fo.Position = unity_class.vector3(fo_pos.x, fo_pos.y, self.charge_dest.z)
				end

				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
					local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = 0.5
					damage_info.direction = direction
					damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
					damage_info.knockBackDirection = unity_class.vector3.back
					damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * 1.5

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.estimate_action_time then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_virtual_range))
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.estimate_action_time - self.end_delay then
			local rotation = self.laser.rotation + dt * self.laser_angular_velocity
			self.laser:update_frame(dt, self.laser.pos, rotation)
			local arc_angle = math.min(self.max_angle - math.abs(self.time_passed * self.laser_angular_velocity) * 0.9, self.max_angle)
			self.laser_virtual_range.Position = self.laser.pos + unity_class.vector3.forward
			self.laser_virtual_range.ArcAngle = arc_angle
			local rotate_angle = self.max_angle - arc_angle / 2
			self.laser_virtual_range.RotationAngle = self.shoot_clockwise and - rotate_angle or 180 + rotate_angle
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.laser_virtual_range))
		else
			self.laser:update_frame(dt, self.laser.pos, self.laser.rotation)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.attack_calculator = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.charge_effect:Dispose()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.fx_casting:Dispose()
		self.sfx_casting:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.fx_casting = nil
		self.sfx_casting = nil

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		for i = 1, #self.virtual_ranges do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_ranges[i]))
		end
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.laser:dispose()
		self.sfx_laser:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.laser = nil
		self.sfx_laser = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare_charge')
		self.charge_dest = self.battle_zone.center + unity_class.vector3(0,0,self.battle_zone.extents.z - self.character.Bounds.extents.z) + (self.character.Position - self.character.Bounds.center)
		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.charge_dest - self.character.Position)
		if diff:IsAlmostZero() then
			self.charge_len = 0
			self.charge_direction = unity_class.vector3.zero
		else
			self.charge_len = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
			self.charge_direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		end
		local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.charge_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_charge_duration))
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('charge')
		self.travel_dist = 0

		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = self.character.Position
		info.DamageTerm = -1
		info.Duration = self.charge_len / self.charge_speed
		info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_width, 2, self.charge_width)
		info.IsCenterToSide = true
		self.charge_duration = info.Duration
		self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.charge_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.charge_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Bounds.center, self.charge_direction, self.character.Transform)

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key, self.character.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.shoot_pos = self.character.Position + unity_class.vector3(0,0,self.shoot_height)
		self.fx_casting = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.casting_key, self.shoot_pos,
						unity_class.vector3.zero, self.character.transform)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		self.shoot_clockwise = self.target.Position.x >= self.battle_zone.center.x
		local rad = self.max_angle * 0.5 * unity_class.mathf.Deg2Rad
		local dir = self.shoot_clockwise and
				unity_class.vector3(1, 0, -math.tan(rad)).normalized or unity_class.vector3(-1, 0, -math.tan(rad)).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.shoot_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward, dir, self.character.Position.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.sfx_casting = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.casting_key, self.character.Position)

		for i = 1, #self.virtual_ranges do
			local range = self.virtual_ranges[i]
			range.Position = self.shoot_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward
			range.RotationAngle = self.shoot_clockwise and - range.ArcAngle / 2 or 180 + range.ArcAngle / 2
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, range))
		end

		self.virtual_wall.Position = self.charge_dest
		self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.laser_angular_velocity = math.abs(self.laser_angular_velocity)
		local start_angle = self.start_angle

		if not self.shoot_clockwise then
			self.laser_angular_velocity = - self.laser_angular_velocity
			start_angle = 180 - self.start_angle

		end

		local laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_key, self.shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.estimate_action_time = math.abs((end_angle - start_angle) / self.laser_angular_velocity) + self.end_delay
		self.laser = medusa_laser:new(self, self.max_laser_length, self.laser_width, self.estimate_action_time, self.shoot_pos,

		self.charge_direction = nil
		self.charge_len = nil
		self.shoot_pos = nil
		self.target = nil
		self.virtual_wall.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:set_phase(phase)

end
--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 3)

	-- 타겟 추적에 걸리는 시간
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TraceDuration", 1)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 0.3)

	-- 공격 연출 시간
	self.swing_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SwingDuration", 0.4)

	self.melee_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeDamageModifier", 1)
	self.melee_attack_move_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeAttackMoveLength", 1)
	self.melee_attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeAttackRadius", 3)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeAttackAngle", 150)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeAttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MeleeAttackDuration", 0.5)
	self.melee_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MeleeCount", 2)

	self.current_melee_count = 0
	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.melee_attack_radius, attack_angle, 3, attack_duration, attack_delay, 0)
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.melee_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.melee_attack_radius,
			attack_angle, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.melee_attack_range:Hide()

	-- fx 표시까지 시간
	self.slash_fx_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "SlashFxDelay", 0.2)

	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 5)
	self.is_slash_fx_run = false

	-- 내부 스테이트
	-- 공격후 폭발이 아니라 공격에 폭발이 포함되어있는 느낌으로..
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		attack_1 = 3,
		attack_2 = 4,
		post = 7
	}

	-- 준비기간중 상태
	self.prepare_state = {
		pre = 1,
		post = 2
	}
	self.current_prepare_state = self.prepare_state.pre

	self.start_position = unity_class.vector3.zero
	self.explosion_duration = 0

	self.prepare_left_key = 'prepare_left'
	self.prepare_right_key = 'prepare_right'
	self.attack_1_key = 'attack_1'
	self.attack_2_key = 'attack_2'
	self.post_key = 'post'
	self.field_key = 'field'

	-- for sfx
	self.attack_key = 'attack'

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.target_direction = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)

	self.target = target
	if not is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, self.target) <= self.melee_attack_radius
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟의 4way 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
	if direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.character)
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithDirection(self.character, direction_util.to_vector3(direction))
	info:AppendTarget(self.target)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.move_speed = 0
	self.current_melee_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()

	if not is_unity_null(self.melee_attack_range) then
		self.melee_attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end


function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		if next_state ~= self.state.attack_1 and next_state ~= self.state.attack_2 then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_1 then
		-- 휘두르기 1차 종료
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.melee_attack_range:Hide(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_2 then
		-- 휘두르기 2차 종료
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.melee_attack_range:Hide(0)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		if(self.current_melee_count % 2 == 0) then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_left_key)
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_right_key)
		end
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)

		-- 준비 시간부터 공격 범위 출력
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.melee_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.melee_attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))

		-- 준비시간 실행단계 나누기
		self.current_prepare_state = self.prepare_state.pre
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack_1 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.start_position = self.character.Position

		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		-- 캐릭터 방향을 2 방향으로 고정
		self.effect_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.effect_dir)
		self.current_melee_count = self.current_melee_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.attack_1_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.attack_key)

		self.is_slash_fx_run = false
		self.move_speed = battle_util.short_dash_speed_for_distance(self.melee_attack_move_length, self.swing_duration)
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_battle_action, nil, self.target_direction,
				0, self.swing_duration,
				self.move_speed, self.move_speed,
				nil, false, 0
		)
	elseif next_state == self.state.attack_2 then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.start_position = self.character.Position
		-- 다른거 계산전에 타겟 방향 구해야..
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		-- 캐릭터 방향을 2 방향으로 고정
		self.effect_dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.effect_dir)
		self.current_melee_count = self.current_melee_count + 1
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.attack_2_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.attack_key)
		self.is_slash_fx_run = false

		self.move_speed = battle_util.short_dash_speed_for_distance(self.melee_attack_move_length, self.swing_duration)
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
				self.cs_battle_action, nil, self.target_direction,
				0, self.swing_duration,
				self.move_speed, self.move_speed,
				nil, false, -1
		)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.melee_attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.current_prepare_state == self.prepare_state.pre then
			self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, 0) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0))
			local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.melee_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.melee_attack_range))
			if self.character.LockedDirection ~= dir then
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)
			end
			if self.time_passed >= self.trace_duration then
				self.current_prepare_state = self.prepare_state.post
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
				if(self.current_melee_count % 2 == 0) then
					self:change_state(self.state.attack_1)
				else
					self:change_state(self.state.attack_2)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_1 then
		--첫번째 공격
		self:update_attack(dt)
		if not self.is_slash_fx_run then
			if self.time_passed >= self.slash_fx_delay then
				local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0)
				if self.effect_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_1_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				else
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_2_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				end
				self.is_slash_fx_run = true
			end
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.swing_duration then
			if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack_2 then
		-- 두번째 공격
		self:update_attack(dt)
		if not self.is_slash_fx_run then
			if self.time_passed >= self.slash_fx_delay then
				local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position, 0)
				if self.effect_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_2_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				else
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_1_key, fx_pos, self.target_direction)
				end
				self.is_slash_fx_run = true
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.swing_duration then
			if self.current_melee_count < self.melee_count then
				-- 공격 카운트 끝나지 않았으면 다시 반대편 공격
				self:change_state(self.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack(dt)
	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			local knock_direction = direction

			if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
				knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.melee_damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.melee_attack_range = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.melee_damage_modifier = nil
	self.melee_attack_move_length = nil
	self.melee_attack_radius = nil
	self.move_speed = nil
	self.melee_count = nil
	self.current_melee_count = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.start_position = nil
	self.prepare_left_key = nil
	self.prepare_right_key = nil
	self.attack_1_key = nil
	self.attack_2_key = nil
	self.post_key = nil
	self.field_key = nil
	self.target_direction = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:start(info)
	self.center = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	local min = info:GetPositionAt(1)
	local max = info:GetPositionAt(2)
	self.time_passed = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare_charge)
	if self.mine_positions == nil then
		self.mine_positions = {}
		self.shooting_mine = {}

		local sqr_rad = self.lv3_radius * self.lv3_radius

		for x = math.ceil(min.x), math.floor(max.x) do
			for z = math.ceil(min.z), math.floor(max.z) do

				local diff_x = self.center.x - x
				local diff_z = self.center.z - z
				local sqr_dist = diff_x * diff_x + diff_z * diff_z
				if (sqr_dist >= sqr_rad) then
					table.insert(self.mine_positions, field:GetGroundPositionAt(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z)))
					table.insert(self.shooting_mine, false)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not battle_util.can_trigger(self.cs_battle_action, self) then
		return false
	end

	local center_pos = self.center
	center_pos.y = field:GetTileInfoAt(center_pos):GetHeightAt(center_pos)

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithPosition(self.character, center_pos)
	info:AppendPosition(self.min)
	info:AppendPosition(self.max)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
	return true
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(b)
	local battle_zone = b

	self.min = b.min
	self.max = b.max
	self.center = vector_util.get_x0z(battle_zone.center)

end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if self.character.LockedDirection ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		self.character.Direction = self.character.LockedDirection
		self.character.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	end
	if #self.mine_effects ~= 0 then
		for i = 1, #self.mine_effects do
			if self.mine_effects[i] ~= nil then
				self.mine_effects[i]:Dispose()
				self.mine_effects[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end
	for i,v in pairs(self.mine_y_calculators) do
		v:Dispose()
		self.mine_y_calculators[i] = nil
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:distribute_mine()
	local start_pos = self.character.Position
	self.updating_mine = true
	self.time_passed_mine = 0
	for i = 1, #self.mine_positions do
		table.insert(self.mine_effects, self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.mine_key, start_pos))
		table.insert(self.mine_y_calculators, CS.CalculatorFreeFall(self.mine_vertical_speed, self.mine_gravity, 0, 0))
		self.mine_y_calculators[i]:ScaleTime(self.mine_horizontal_speed)
		self.shooting_mine[i] = true
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.mine_key)
end

function local_class:update_mine(dt)
	for i = #self.mine_positions, 1, -1 do
		if self.mine_effects[i] == nil then
			goto continue
		end

		if self.shooting_mine[i] then
			if(self.mine_y_calculators[i]:IsDone()) then
				self.mine_effects[i].transform.position = self.mine_positions[i]
				self.shooting_mine[i] = false
			else
				self.mine_y_calculators[i]:Proceed(dt)

				local progress = self.mine_y_calculators[i]:GetProgress()
				local move_pos = self.character.Position * (1-progress) + self.mine_positions[i] * progress
				move_pos.y = self.mine_y_calculators[i]:GetDistance() + self.mine_positions[i].y
				self.mine_effects[i].transform.position = move_pos
			end
		elseif self.time_passed_mine < self.mine_life_time then
			if self:check_damage(self.mine_positions[i], 0.5) then
				self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.mine_explosion_key, self.mine_positions[i])
				self.mine_effects[i]:Dispose()
				self.mine_effects[i] = nil
			end
		else
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.mine_explosion_key, self.mine_positions[i])
			self.mine_effects[i]:Dispose()
			self.updating_mine = false
		end

		:: continue ::
	end

	self.time_passed_mine = self.time_passed_mine + dt
	if self.updating_mine == false then
		self.mine_effects = {}
		for i,v in pairs(self.mine_y_calculators) do
			v:Dispose()
			self.mine_y_calculators[i] = nil
		end
		self.mine_y_calculators = {}
	end
end

function local_class:check_damage(check_pos, check_radius)
	if (self.character == nil) then
		return true
	end

	local hit = false

	local list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(check_pos, check_radius)
	for i = 0, list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = list[i]

		if  not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo)
				or fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
				or lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character) then
			goto continue
		end

		local dmg_dir = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z((fo.Position - check_pos)))
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.mine_atk_mod
		damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
		damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		hit = true
		:: continue ::
	end
	list:Dispose()

	return hit
end

function local_class:spout(idx)
	if idx > 2 then
		return true
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.spout_key)
	local candidates = nil
	local excepts = nil
	if idx == 0 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_1))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.spout_attack_range_2, self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_2))

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.lv1_spout_key, self.character.Position)
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.lv1_radius)
		excepts = nil
	elseif idx == 1 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_2))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.spout_attack_range_3, self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_3))

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.lv2_spout_key, self.character.Position)
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.lv2_radius)
		excepts = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.lv1_radius)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.lv3_spout_key, self.character.Position)
		candidates = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.lv3_radius)
		excepts = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.lv2_radius)
	end
	for i = 0, candidates.Count - 1 do
		local fo = candidates[i]
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo)
				or fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead
				or lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.character) then
			goto continue
		end

		if (excepts ~= nil and excepts:Contains(fo)) then
			goto continue
		end

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.spout_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.hitEffect = CS.Oak.BasicMeHitEffect.Create(fo.Bounds.center)
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorNormalStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.volcano_knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

		:: continue ::
	end
	candidates:Dispose()
	if excepts ~= nil then
		excepts:Dispose()
	end
	return false
end

--update
function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	if self.updating_mine then
		self:update_mine(dt)
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self:update_charge(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.charge_duration then
			self:distribute_mine()
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_spout)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_spout then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_spout_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.spout)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spout then
		if self.time_passed >= self.spout_interval then
			if self:spout(self.current_spout_count) then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self.time_passed = 0
				self.current_spout_count = self.current_spout_count + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

--돌진 전용 update
function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	if(self.camera_shake_time < self.time_passed) then
		self.camera_shake_time = self.camera_shake_time + 0.2
		stage_camera:Shake(0.1, 0.1)
	end
	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_direction
	move_info.magnitude = dt * self.charge_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

			-- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
			local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
			local xz_move_direction = self.target_direction:GetXz().normalized
			local knock_direction
			if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.target_direction
			else
				knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.target_direction
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.charge_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

--상태 변경 (exit & enter 포함)
function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.charge_effect:Dispose()
		self.charge_attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_spout then
		if next_state ~= self.state.spout then
			battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_1))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.spout then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_3))
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	--enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.camera_shake_time = 0.2
		self.target_direction = vector_util.get_x0z(self.center) - vector_util.get_x0z(self.character.Position)
		self.charge_len = vector_util.magnitude(self.target_direction)
		self.target_direction = vector_util.normalized(self.target_direction)
		local dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_prepare_duration))

		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_attack_range) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.charge_attack_range)
		end
		self.charge_attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(self.character.Position, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_len, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.charge_attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.charge_attack_range:Show(self.charge_prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.charge_attack_range))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_charge_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.charge_key)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
		info.Center = self.character.Position
		info.DamageTerm = -1
		info.Duration = self.charge_len / self.charge_speed
		info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.charge_width, 2, self.charge_width)
		info.IsCenterToSide = true
		self.charge_duration = info.Duration
		self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.target_direction
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.charge_key)
		self.charge_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.charge_key, self.character.Bounds.center, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)
	elseif next_state == self.state.prepare_spout then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_spout_duration))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.spout_attack_range_1));

		self.current_spout_count = 0

		--FIXME
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_spout_key)
	elseif next_state == self.state.spout then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.prepare_spout_key)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.spout_key)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:force_cancel()

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	--돌진 관련 값
	self.charge_modifier = nil
	self.charge_speed = nil
	self.knockback_force = nil
	self.charge_prepare_duration = nil
	self.charge_width = nil
	self.charge_duration = nil
	if not is_unity_null(self.charge_attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.charge_attack_range)
	end
	self.charge_attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	--폭발 관련 값
	self.prepare_spout_duration = nil
	self.spout_interval = nil
	self.lv1_radius = nil
	self.lv2_radius = nil
	self.lv3_radius = nil
	self.spout_attack_range_1 = nil
	self.spout_attack_range_2 = nil
	self.spout_attack_range_3 = nil
	self.current_spout_count = nil
	self.spout_modifier = nil

	--지뢰 관련 값
	self.mine_life_time = nil
	self.mine_atk_mod = nil
	self.mine_positions = nil
	self.mine_effects = nil
	self.mine_y_calculators = nil
	self.shooting_mine = nil

	self.post_duration = nil

	self.prepare_charge_key = nil
	self.charge_key = nil

	self.prepare_spout_key = nil
	self.lv1_spout_key = nil
	self.lv2_spout_key = nil
	self.lv3_spout_key = nil
	self.spout_key = nil

	self.mine_key = nil
	self.mine_explosion_key = nil

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.target_direction = nil

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossClaraChainBattleAction')

local chain = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	shooter = nil,

	duration = nil,
	hit_timing = nil,
	damage_modifier = nil,
	knock_back_force = nil,
	range_radius = nil,
	damage_radius = nil,

	target_pos = nil,
	range_fx = nil,
	attack_range = nil
}
chain.mt = { __index = chain }

function chain:new(parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.shooter = parent_class.character

	obj.is_active = false
	obj.time_passed = 0

	return obj
end

function chain:set_param(fx_duration, range_radius, damage_radius, hit_timing, damage_modifier,
						 knock_back_force, range_preset, chain_preset)
	self.duration = fx_duration
	self.range_radius = range_radius
	self.damage_radius = damage_radius
	self.hit_timing = hit_timing
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	self.knock_back_force = knock_back_force
	self.range_preset = range_preset
	self.chain_preset = chain_preset
end

function chain:unset_param()
	self.chain_preset = nil
	self.range_preset = nil
end

function chain:shoot(pos)
	self.is_active = true
	self.attack_processed = false
	self.target_pos = pos
	self.range_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.range_preset, pos)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05,
			self.range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.hit_timing)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function chain:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.attack_processed then
		if self.time_passed < self.hit_timing then
			return
		end

		self.attack_processed = true

		-- 이펙트 처리
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.chain_preset, self.target_pos)

		-- 원형 범위 데미지
		local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.target_pos, self.damage_radius)
		local hit_count = collide_objs.Count
		for i = 0, hit_count - 1 do
			local fo = collide_objs[i]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.shooter, fo) then
				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.target_pos).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
				damage_info.sender = self.shooter
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		collide_objs:Dispose()

		-- 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack', self.target_pos)
		if hit_count > 0 then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', self.target_pos)
		end

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range = nil
	elseif self.time_passed > self.duration then
		self:dispose()
	end
end

function chain:dispose()
	if self.is_active then
		self.is_active = false

		if self.range_fx then
			self.range_fx:Dispose()
			self.range_fx = nil
		end
	end

	if self.attack_range then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.shooter = nil
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootDuration", 0.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	local hit_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HitTiming", 0.4)
	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootInterval", 0.2)
	local trace_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TraceSpeed", 4);
	self.drive_amount = trace_speed * self.shoot_interval
	self.shoot_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShootCount", 10)

	local range_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeRadius", 1)
	local damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageRadius", 0.75)
	local damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	local knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 0.1)
	local chain_preset = 'attack'
	local range_preset = 'attack_range'

	chain:set_param(self.shoot_duration, range_radius, damage_radius, hit_timing, damage_modifier,
			knock_back_force, range_preset, chain_preset)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		shoot_interval = 4,
		post = 5
	}

	self.projectile_list = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.shoot_count = 0

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot_interval and next_state ~= self.state.post then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_interval then
		if next_state ~= self.state.shoot then
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast')
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		if not self.shoot_init then
			self.shoot_init = true
		end

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		self.dir_vector = diff.normalized;
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)

		self.last_shoot_pos = self.target.Position
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot_interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		for i = #self.projectile_list, 1, -1 do
			local projectile = self.projectile_list[i]
			projectile:dispose()
			self.projectile_list[i] = nil
		end
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_projectile(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		-- shoot
		local diff = (self.target.Position - self.last_shoot_pos):GetX0z()
		local dir = diff.normalized
		local dist = diff.magnitude
		local shoot_pos = self.last_shoot_pos + dir * math.min(dist, self.drive_amount)

		local new_projectile = chain:new(self)
		new_projectile:shoot(shoot_pos)
		table.insert(self.projectile_list, new_projectile)

		self.last_shoot_pos = shoot_pos
		self.shoot_count = self.shoot_count + 1

		if self.shoot_count >= self.shoot_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot_interval)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot_interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_projectile(dt)
	for i,projectile in pairs(self.projectile_list) do
		if projectile.is_active then
			projectile:update_frame(dt)
		else
			table.remove(self.projectile_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	chain:unset_param()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			local hp = character_util.get_max_hp_mod(fo)
			local shield = fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.ActualShield
			local kill_damage = math.floor((hp + shield) * 2)

	end

	return true

	end

	self.move_time_passed = self.move_time_passed + dt

	local is_rise = self.current_move == self.move_state.rise
	local dir = is_rise and vector_util.up or vector_util.down
	local s_pos = is_rise and self.rise_start_pos or self.downfall_start_pos
	local duration = is_rise and self.move_duration or self.downfall_duration

	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.move_time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
	progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress)
	local pos = s_pos + dir * (self.move_distance * progress)

	self.character.Position = pos

	end

	self.character.Position = is_rise and self.downfall_start_pos or self.rise_start_pos
