		self:on_expedition_end_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExpeditionEndEvent), self.on_expedition_end_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self.action_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self:hide_attack_range()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if next_state == self.state.action then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
			self:hide_attack_range()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		if self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.odd then
			self:change_attack_type(self.attack_type.even)
		else
			self:change_attack_type(self.attack_type.odd)
		end

		if next_state == self.state.interval or next_state == self.state.post then
			self:summon_monsters()
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self:hide_attack_range()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('start')

		self:update_trakcing(0)
		self:show_attack_range(self.prepare_duration)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))


	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.current_state == self.state.action then
			self:show_attack_range(self.interval_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.interval_duration))
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:show_attack_effect()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack')

		local add = self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.odd and 45 or 0
		for i = 1, self.attack_amount do
			local angle = (i - 1) * 90 + add
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
			local dir = rot * vector_util.forward
			local calc = self:pop_calc()

			calc.Position = self.character.Position
			calc.Direction = dir
			calc:Start()
			table.insert(self.active_calcs, calc)
		end

		self.action_count = self.action_count + 1

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self:hide_attack_range()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:change_attack_type(new_type)
	if self.current_attack_type == new_type then
		return
	end

	local add = new_type == self.attack_type.odd and 45 or 0
	for i, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		local angle = (i - 1) * 90 + add
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		local dir = rot * vector_util.forward
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(v, self.character.Position, dir)
	end

	self.current_attack_type = new_type
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_calc(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed <= self.tracking_duration then
			self:update_trakcing(dt)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.action_count >= self.action_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_trakcing(dt)
	local dir = (self.character.Position - self.target.Position).normalized
	local angle = unity_class.mathf.Atan2(-dir.z, dir.x) * unity_class.mathf.Rad2Deg
	if angle < 0 then
		angle = angle + 360.0
	end

	local divide_angle = 360.0 / (self.action_amount * self.attack_amount)
	local a = (angle + divide_angle / 2) // divide_angle
	if a % 2 == 0 then
		self:change_attack_type(self.attack_type.even)
	else
		self:change_attack_type(self.attack_type.odd)
	end
end

function local_class:update_calc(dt)
	local is_hit = false
	for i = #self.active_calcs, 1, -1 do
		local calc = self.active_calcs[i]
		local objects = calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = (fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				is_hit = true

			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(self.gimmick_fo, fo) then
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
						{ 'expedition_s4_hidden_event_b_damage' , tostring(self.gimmick_damage) }))

			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if calc.IsFinished then
			self:push_calc(table.remove(self.active_calcs, i))
		end

		if is_hit then
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit')
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_range(duration)
	for _, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		v:Show(duration)
	end

	local add = self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.odd and 45 or 0
	for i, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		local angle = (i - 1) * 90 + add
		local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
		local dir = rot * vector_util.forward
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(v, self.character.Position, dir)
	end
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	for _, v in pairs(self.ar_list) do
		v:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:show_attack_effect()
	local add = self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.odd and 45 or 0
	for i = 1, self.attack_amount do
		local angle = (i - 1) * 90 + add
		local fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack', self.character.Position)
		fx.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, angle, 0)
	end

	self.is_show_fx_attack = true
end

function local_class:summon_monsters()
	if self.summon_monster_ids == nil then
		return
	end

	if self.monster_zone_bound == nil then
		local offset = 2
		local range = self.monster_size_max * 2 + offset
		local size = vector(self.zone_bound.size.x - range, self.zone_bound.size.y, self.zone_bound.size.z - range)
		self.monster_zone_bound = unity_class.bounds(self.zone_bound.center, size)
	end

	local summon_count = 0
	local add = self.current_attack_type == self.attack_type.odd and 45 or 0
	for _, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if summon_count >= self.summon_amount then
			break
		end

		if v.state == self.monster_state.idle then
			local monster = v.fo
			local angle = summon_count * 90 + add
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, unity_class.vector3.up)
			local dir = rot * vector_util.forward
			local pos = self.character.Position + dir * (self.attack_radius - self.monster_size_max)

			if not self.monster_zone_bound:Contains(pos) then
				pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.monster_zone_bound, pos, 0)
			end

			monster.Position = pos

			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
			heal_info.sender = self.character
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.skipEffect = true
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

			local thebattle = stage.BattleManager:GetBattleForMyParty()
			if thebattle == nil then
				print('### GetBattleForMyParty is null!!!')
				break
			end

			thebattle:AddEnemy(monster)
			monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false

			character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'enabled')

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
			message_system:Send(monster.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(
					monster, self.target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

			v.state = self.monster_state.battle
			summon_count = summon_count + 1
		end
	end

	local remain = self.summon_amount - summon_count
	self:add_buff(remain)
end

function local_class:clear_monster()
	for _, v in pairs(self.monster_list) do
		if v.state == self.monster_state.battle then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = v.fo
			damage_info.damage = character_util.get_max_hp(v.fo) * 10
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
end

-- 사도 소환 남은 횟수 만큼 스택 버프
function local_class:add_buff(count)
	if count <= 0 then
		return
	end

	buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, self.character, self.buff_name, count, false, false)
end

function local_class:pop_calc()
	if #self.attack_calcs <= 0 then
		local info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.attack_radius, self.attack_degree, self.character.Position.y,
				self.attack_duration, self.attack_term)
		local calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay)
		table.insert(self.attack_calcs, calc)
	end

	return table.remove(self.attack_calcs)
end

function local_class:push_calc(calc)
	calc:End()
	table.insert(self.attack_calcs, calc)
end

function local_class:routine_load_monster()
	if self.summon_monster_ids == nil then
		return
	end

	self.monster_list = {}
	self.monster_size_max = 0

	local stage_data = game_data_service.GetData('StageData')
	local exps_data = game_data_service.GetData('ExpsData')
	local exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, 80)
	if stage ~= nil then
		if stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId) ~= nil then
			local stage_level = stage_data:GetStage(stage.StageId).StageStandardLevel
			exp = CS.Oak.ExpsDataLevelExpExtensions.GetTotalExpForLevel(exps_data, stage_level)
		end
	end

	for i, id in pairs(self.summon_monster_ids) do
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('Characters'):GetSpec(id)
		if spec == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND MONSTER SPEC!!! ID = ' .. id)
			break
		end

		local loader = CS.Oak.CharacterLoader(spec)
		coroutine.yield(loader)
		local monster = loader.Character
		if monster == nil then
			print('### CANT FIND Character!!! ID = ' .. id)
			break
		end

		monster.Name = 'apostles_'.. i
		monster.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
		monster.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviour();
		monster.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.MonsterCharacterController('battle', CS.Oak.PatrolAI.Watch)
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.NoticeLinkName = 'battle2'
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.EventGroupName = 'battle2'
		monster.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		monster.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create(CS.Oak.DeathType.Disppear)
		monster.DamagedBehaviour.DeathType = CS.Oak.DeathType.SmallExplosion
		monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:AddExp(exp)
		monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
		monster.Position = vector(999, 0 , 999)
		monster.Owner = CS.Oak.Player.Local
		CS.Oak.NetworkEntityManager.Instance:RegisterEntity(monster)
		character_util.set_active_state(monster, 'disabled')
		local changed_weapon = false
		--디폴트 무기 설정
		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end

		if monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id > -1 then
			local weapon_spec = CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetById(monster.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon2Id)
			local weapon  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(weapon_spec)
			monster:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon2, weapon, false)
			changed_weapon = true
		end
		stage.CharacterManager:RegisterCharacterByName(monster)

		coroutine.yield(monster:UpdateAndBattleAndStageOptions())

		self.monster_size_max = math.max(self.monster_size_max, monster.Bounds.size.x)
		self.monster_size_max = math.max(self.monster_size_max, monster.Bounds.size.z)

		local data = {
			state = self.monster_state.idle,
			fo = monster,
		}

		self.monster_list[monster.Name] = data
	end
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_monster, self))
end

function local_class:on_fieldobject_destroyed(e)
	local fo = e.FieldObject
	if fo.EntityGroup ~= CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0 then
		return
	end

	local monster = self.monster_list[fo.Name]
	if monster == nil then
		return
	end

	local pos = fo.Position
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil,
			{ 'expedition_bead_drop_request', pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, self.bead_amount, self.bead_event_id }))

	monster.state = self.monster_state.idle
end

function local_class:on_expedition_end_event(e)
	self:clear_monster()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
		end

	if self.on_stage_loaded_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_func)
		self.on_stage_loaded_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func)
		self.on_fieldobject_destroyed_func = nil
	end

	if self.on_expedition_end_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.ExpeditionEndEvent), self.on_expedition_end_event_func)
		self.on_expedition_end_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.tracking then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.shoot_count >= self.shoot_amount then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.interval)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.tracking)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, dir)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
			self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_end', hit_info.position)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('end')
			return true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.gimmick_fo, hit_info.target) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
					{ 'expedition_s4_hidden_event_b_damage' , tostring(self.gimmick_damage) }))
		end

	elseif hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('proj_end', hit_info.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('end')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_party_switching_event(e)
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.CurrentParty[0]) then
		self.target = e.CurrentParty[0]
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_party_switching_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.PartySwitchingEvent), self.on_party_switching_event_func)
		self.on_party_switching_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	self.run_action_end_ani = false

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

		return
	end

	-- exit

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pre_action then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calc:End()

		if self.fx_ready ~= nil then
			self.fx_ready:Dispose()
			self.fx_ready = nil

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ready_end', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_idle then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('ready')

		self.fx_ready = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ready', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.zone_bound.center)

	elseif next_state == self.state.pre_action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('attack_idle')
		self.sfx_field = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('field1')
		self.sfx_field2 = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('field2')

		self.attack_calc.Position = self.zone_bound.center
		self.attack_calc:Start()
		self.shake_time_passed = self.action_shake_term

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field)
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field2)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post_idle then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field)
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field2)

		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field)
		self:fadeout_sfx(self.sfx_field2)

		if self.fx_ready ~= nil then
			self.fx_ready:Dispose()
			self.fx_ready = nil

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ready_end', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
		end

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character, { 'expedition_s4_shield_off' }))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self:update_shield_request(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.pre_action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.pre_action then
		if self.run_fx_field == false and self.time_passed >= self.effect_term then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack1', self.zone_bound.center, vector_util.zero)
			self.run_fx_field = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.pre_action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self:publish_damage(dt)
		self:update_shake(dt)
		self:update_effect(dt)

		if self.run_action_end_ani == false and self.time_passed >= self.action_end_ani_timing then

			self.run_action_end_ani = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.post_idle_duration > 0 then
			if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration - self.post_idle_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.post_idle)
			end
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
				self:change_state(self.state.none)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post_idle then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_idle_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_shake(dt)
	self.shake_time_passed = self.shake_time_passed + dt

	if self.shake_time_passed >= self.action_shake_term then
		stage_camera:Shake(self.action_camera_shake_magnitude, self.action_camera_shake_duration)
		self.shake_time_passed = 0
	end
end

function local_class:update_effect(dt)
	local c_num = self.time_passed // self.effect_term
	if self.fx_attack1_count >= c_num then
		return
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack1', self.zone_bound.center, vector_util.zero)
	self.fx_attack1_count = self.fx_attack1_count + 1
end

function local_class:update_shield_request(dt)
	if self.current_state < self.state.prepare or self.current_state > self.state.action then
		return
	end

	self.request_time_passed = self.request_time_passed + dt

	if self.request_count >= self.max_shield_request then
		return
	end

	if self.next_shield_request_time > self.request_time_passed then
		return
	end

	self.next_shield_request_time = self.request_time_passed + self.shield_request_delay + self.shield_duration
	self.request_count = self.request_count + 1

	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
			{ 'expedition_s4_shield_on', tostring(self.shield_duration) }))
end

function local_class:publish_damage(dt)
	local is_hit = false
	local objects = self.attack_calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) and self:check_shield(fo.Position) == false then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_ratio)
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			local dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
			if dir == vector_util.zero then
				dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - self.zone_bound.center).normalized
			end
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('attack2', fo.Position, vector_util.zero)
			is_hit = true
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.gimmick_fo, fo) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.character,
					{ 'expedition_s4_hidden_event_b_damage' , tostring(self.gimmick_damage) }))
		end
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	if is_hit then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit1')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit2')
	end
end

function local_class:check_shield(pos)
	if self.shield_data == nil then
		return false
	end

	local dist = (vector_util.get_x0z(pos) - self.shield_data.position).magnitude
	if dist > self.shield_data.radius then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:set_null_damage_behaviour()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:reset_damage_behaviour()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
end

function local_class:set_ailment_resist()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun |  CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action, options)
end

function local_class:reset_ailment()
	self.character.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_battle_action)
end

function local_class:fadeout_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	sfx:FadeOut(1)
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'expedition_s4_shield_position' then
		local x = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))
		local z = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(2))
		local radius = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(3))
		self.shield_data =
		{
			position = vector(x, 0, z),
			radius = radius
		}
	end

	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'expedition_s4_shield_end' then
		self.shield_data = nil
		self.next_shield_request_time = self.shield_request_delay + self.request_time_passed
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)
		self.on_custom_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil

	if self.fx_ready ~= nil then
		self.fx_ready:Dispose()
		self.fx_ready = nil

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ready_end', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local x = bound.extents.x * 2
	local z = bound.extents.z * 2

	local u_inner = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(223, 28, 28, 80)
	local u_outer = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 45, 45, 150)
	local o_inner = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 53, 53, 64)
	local o_outer = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 0)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, vector(x, z), u_inner, u_outer, o_inner, o_outer, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.FadeIn)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- hidden stage용 오브젝트 때리기 위해 존 사이즈 보다 약간 더 늘려준다
	local offset = 4
	local info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
			vector(x + offset, 99, z + offset), self.action_duration, self.damage_term)
	self.attack_calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossClaraLaserBattleAction')

local laser_shooter = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	character = nil,

	laser_preset = nil,
	shoot_duration = nil,
	laser_length = nil,
	laser_range_width = nil,
	laser_damage_width = nil,
	length_scale = nil,
	damage_term = nil,
	damage_modifier = nil,
	knock_back_force = nil,

	shoot_pos = nil,
	laser_fx = nil,
	attack_calculator = nil,
	attack_range = nil
}
laser_shooter.mt = { __index = laser_shooter }

function laser_shooter:new(parent_class, shoot_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.character = parent_class.character

	obj.shoot_pos = shoot_pos

	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.is_active = false

	return obj
end

function laser_shooter:set_params(laser_preset, laser_end_preset, shoot_duration, laser_length, laser_range_width,
								  laser_damage_width, laser_length_scale, damage_term, damage_modifier, knock_back_force)
	self.laser_preset = laser_preset
	self.laser_end_preset = laser_end_preset
	self.shoot_duration = shoot_duration
	self.laser_length = laser_length
	self.laser_range_width = laser_range_width
	self.laser_damage_width = laser_damage_width
	self.length_scale = laser_length_scale
	self.damage_term = damage_term
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	self.knock_back_force = knock_back_force
end

function laser_shooter:shoot(attack_range)
	self.is_active = true
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.laser_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_preset, self.shoot_pos, vector_util.back)
	self.laser_fx.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(self.length_scale, 1, 1)

	-- 공격 계산기
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.DamageTerm = self.damage_term
	info.Duration = self.shoot_duration;
	info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.laser_length, 2, self.laser_damage_width)
	info.IsCenterToSide = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 0)
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.shoot_pos
	self.attack_calculator.Direction = vector_util.back
	self.attack_calculator:Start()

	-- 어택레인지 종료용으로 캐싱
	if attack_range then
		self.attack_range = attack_range
	end

	-- 공격 사운드 루프
	self.laser_loop_sfx = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack_loop', self.shoot_pos)
	self.laser_loop_sfx.Volume = 0.3
end

function laser_shooter:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed > self.shoot_duration then
		self:on_shoot_finished()
	else
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = vector_util.back

				if not lua_helper.type_compare(fo.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) then

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', self.character)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function laser_shooter:on_shoot_finished()
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.is_active = false

	if self.laser_fx then
		self.laser_fx:Dispose()
		self.laser_fx = nil
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.laser_end_preset, self.shoot_pos, vector_util.back)

	if self.attack_range then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	end

	end

	if self.is_active then

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.shoot_pos = nil

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)

	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.shoot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootDuration", 1)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowDuration", 0.8)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	local laser_damage_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserDamageWidth", 1.2)
	local default_range = 10
	local laser_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserLength", default_range)
	self.trace_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowSpeed", 7)
	self.laser_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "LaserOffset", -1)

	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageTerm", 0.3)
	self.modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 0.2)

	local laser_preset = 'laser'
	local laser_end_preset = 'laser_end'
	local laser_length_scale = laser_length / default_range

	laser_shooter:set_params(laser_preset, laser_end_preset, self.shoot_duration, laser_length, laser_range_width,
			laser_damage_width, laser_length_scale, self.damage_term, self.modifier, self.knock_back_force)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 어택레인지
	local size = unity_class.vector2(laser_length, laser_range_width)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector_util.zero, size, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.laser_shooters = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true

function local_class:trigger()

		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

function local_class:start(info)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if self.casting_fx then
			self.casting_fx:Dispose()
			self.casting_fx = nil
		end

		self.attack_range:Hide()

		self.prev_range_target_pos = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.shoot_pos = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		self.shoot_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.target.Position.x, self.character.Position.y + 0.05,
				self.character.Position.z + self.laser_offset)
		self.casting_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('casting', self.shoot_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 어택레인지
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.shoot_pos, vector_util.back, self.character.Position.y)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.prev_range_target_pos = self.target.Position

		-- 캐스팅 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

		local laser = laser_shooter:new(self, self.shoot_pos)
		laser:shoot(self.attack_range)
		table.insert(self.laser_shooters, laser)

		-- 발사 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('attack', self.shoot_pos)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_lasers(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			local target_pos_diff = self.target.Position - self.prev_range_target_pos
			local new_range_target_pos = self.prev_range_target_pos
					+ target_pos_diff.normalized * math.min(self.trace_speed * dt, target_pos_diff.magnitude)
			self.shoot_pos = unity_class.vector3(new_range_target_pos.x, self.character.Position.y + 0.05,
					self.character.Position.z + self.laser_offset)
			effect_util.update_object(self.casting_fx, self.shoot_pos)

			local dir_vector = vector_util.back
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.shoot_pos, dir_vector)
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			self.prev_range_target_pos = new_range_target_pos;
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_lasers(dt)
	for i = #self.laser_shooters, 1, -1 do
		local shooter = self.laser_shooters[i]

		shooter:update_frame(dt)
		if not shooter.is_active then
			shooter:dispose()
			table.remove(self.laser_shooters, i)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	for i = #self.laser_shooters, 1, -1 do
		local laser = self.laser_shooters[i]
		laser:dispose()
		self.laser_shooters[i] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	self.attack_range = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.laser_shooters = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossClaraStoneBattleAction')

local stone_ready = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,

	ready_preset = nil,
	projectile_preset = nil,

	ready_pos = nil,
	shoot_pos = nil,
	projectile_init_pos = nil,
	projectile_pos = nil
}
stone_ready.mt = { __index = stone_ready }

function stone_ready:new(parent_class, ready_pos, shoot_pos)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.ready_pos = ready_pos
	obj.shoot_pos = shoot_pos
	obj.projectile_init_pos = ready_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.2
	obj.projectile_pos = obj.projectile_init_pos

	obj.projectile_move_duration = 1
	obj.time_passed = 0

	obj.is_active = false

	return obj
end

function stone_ready:set_param(ready_effect_duration, ready_preset, projectile_preset, trail_preset, break_preset)
	self.ready_effect_duration = ready_effect_duration
	self.ready_preset = ready_preset
	self.projectile_preset = projectile_preset
	self.trail_preset = trail_preset
	self.break_preset = break_preset
end

function stone_ready:unset_param()
	self.ready_preset = nil
	self.projectile_preset = nil
	self.trail_preset = nil
	self.break_preset = nil
end

function stone_ready:start()
	self.is_active = true
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.ready_preset, self.ready_pos)
end

function stone_ready:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return nil
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if not self.projectile_fx then
		if self.time_passed >= self.ready_effect_duration then
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.projectile_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.projectile_preset, self.projectile_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.trail_preset, self.projectile_pos,
					unity_class.vector3.zero, self.projectile_fx.transform)
			self:update_frame(self.time_passed - self.ready_effect_duration)
		end
	else
		if self.time_passed < self.projectile_move_duration then
			local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.projectile_move_duration)
			self.projectile_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.projectile_init_pos, self.shoot_pos, progress)
			effect_util.update_object(self.projectile_fx, self.projectile_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
		else
			self.isActive = false
			return self.projectile_fx
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function stone_ready:dispose(dispose_fx)
	if dispose_fx and self.projectile_fx then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.break_preset, self.projectile_fx.transform.position)
		self.projectile_fx:Dispose()
	end

	self.projectile_fx = nil

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.ready_pos = nil
	self.shoot_pos = nil
	self.projectile_init_pos = nil
	self.projectile_pos = nil
end

local stone_projectile = {
	action = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,
	shooter = nil,

	damage_modifier = nil,
	damage_radius = nil,
	range_radius = nil,
	projectile_speed = nil,
	knock_back_force = nil,
	break_preset = nil,

	projectile_init_pos = nil,
	projectile_pos = nil,
	target_pos = nil,
	projectile_fx = nil
}
stone_projectile.mt = { __index = stone_projectile }

function stone_projectile:new(parent_class, projectile_fx)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_battle_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj.shooter = parent_class.character
	obj.projectile_init_pos = projectile_fx.transform.localPosition
	obj.projectile_pos = obj.projectile_init_pos
	obj.projectile_fx = projectile_fx

	obj.time_passed = 0
	obj.is_active = false

	return obj
end

function stone_projectile:set_param(damage_modifier, damage_radius, range_radius, projectile_speed, knock_back_force, break_preset)
	self.damage_radius = damage_radius
	self.range_radius = range_radius
	self.damage_modifier = damage_modifier
	self.projectile_speed = projectile_speed
	self.break_preset = break_preset
	self.knock_back_force = knock_back_force
end

function stone_projectile:unset_param()
	self.damage_radius = nil
	self.range_radius = nil
	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.projectile_speed = nil
	self.break_preset = nil
	self.knock_back_force = nil
end

function stone_projectile:shoot(target_pos)
	self.is_active = true
	self.target_pos = target_pos

	self.duration = (target_pos - self.projectile_init_pos):GetX0z().magnitude / self.projectile_speed
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(self.target_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * 0.05,
			self.range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.duration)
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
end

function stone_projectile:update_frame(dt)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self:deactivate(true)
	else
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.duration)
		self.projectile_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.projectile_init_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
		effect_util.update_object(self.projectile_fx, self.projectile_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	end
end

function stone_projectile:deactivate(crashed)
	if not self.is_active then
		return
	end

	-- 투사체 이동 종료
	self.is_active = false;

	self.projectile_fx:Dispose()
	self.projectile_fx = nil

	self.attack_range:Hide()
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.action.character, self.attack_range))
	self.attack_range = nil

	-- 충격 이펙트
	local pos = self.time_passed >= self.duration and self.target_pos or self.projectile_pos
	self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.break_preset, pos)

	if not crashed then
		self.target_pos = nil
		return
	end

	-- 충격 연출
	stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('stone', 0.1, 0.1, false))
	self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', pos)

	-- 원형 범위 데미지
	local collide_objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.damage_radius)
	for i = 0, collide_objs.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_objs[i]

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.shooter, fo) then
			local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - pos).normalized

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
			damage_info.sender = self.shooter
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
			damage_info.direction = direction
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = direction
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	collide_objs:Dispose()
	self.target_pos = nil
end

function stone_projectile:dispose()
	self:deactivate(false)

	self.action = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.shooter = nil

	self.projectile_init_pos = nil
	self.projectile_pos = nil

	if self.projectile_fx then
		self.projectile_fx:Dispose()
		self.projectile_fx = nil
	end
end

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1.5)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.shoot_interval = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShootInterval", 0.1)
	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeFollowDuration", 1)
	self.trace_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetFollowSpeed", 6)

	local modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	local damage_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageRadius", 1.25)
	local range_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "RangeRadius", 1.25)
	local knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 0.3)
	local projectile_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ProjectileSpeed", 6)

	local has_value, offset_json = params:TryGetValue('ProjectileOffsets')
	if has_value then
		local prepare_offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(offset_json, 'prepare')
		local shoot_offset_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(offset_json, 'shoot')
		local prepare_x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'X')
		local prepare_y_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'Y')
		local prepare_z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(prepare_offset_json, 'Z')
		local shoot_x_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'X')
		local shoot_y_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'Y')
		local shoot_z_offsets = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(shoot_offset_json, 'Z')
		self.projectile_number = math.min(
				prepare_x_offsets.Count, prepare_y_offsets.Count, prepare_z_offsets.Count,
				shoot_x_offsets.Count, shoot_y_offsets.Count, shoot_z_offsets.Count)
		self.projectile_offsets = {
			prepare = {},
			shoot = {}
		}
		for i = 0, self.projectile_number - 1 do
			table.insert(self.projectile_offsets.prepare,
					unity_class.vector3(prepare_x_offsets[i], prepare_y_offsets[i], prepare_z_offsets[i]))
			table.insert(self.projectile_offsets.shoot,
					unity_class.vector3(shoot_x_offsets[i], shoot_y_offsets[i], shoot_z_offsets[i]))
		end
	else
		self.projectile_number = 6
		self.projectile_offsets = {
			prepare = { unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.left, unity_class.vector3.left,
						unity_class.vector3.right, unity_class.vector3.right, unity_class.vector3.right },
			shoot = { unity_class.vector3(3.2, 2, 0.5), unity_class.vector3(2.2, 2, 1.8), unity_class.vector3(0.8, 2, 2.5),
					  unity_class.vector3(-3.2, 2, 0.5), unity_class.vector3(-2.2, 2, 1.8), unity_class.vector3(-0.8, 2, 2.5) }
		}
	end

	local prepare_fx_duration = 0.5
	local ready_preset = 'stone_ready'
	local projectile_preset = 'stone'
	local break_preset = 'stone_break'
	local trail_preset = 'stone_trail'

	stone_ready:set_param(prepare_fx_duration, ready_preset, projectile_preset, trail_preset, break_preset)
	stone_projectile:set_param(modifier, damage_radius, range_radius, projectile_speed, knock_back_force, break_preset)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shoot = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.stone_prepare_list = {}
	self.stone_shoot_list = {}
	self.remove_list = {}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(_)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.shoot_count = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.animation_coroutine = nil
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('start')
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		local dir_vector = diff.normalized;
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		self.character.Direction = dir;

		self.prev_range_target_pos = self.target.Position

		stage_camera:Shake(CS.Oak.ShakeInfo('stone_prepare', 0.1, 0.5, false))

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', self.character)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shoot then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		local diff = self.target.Position - self.character.Position
		self.dir_vector = diff.normalized
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, dir)

		self.shoot_index = 1

		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('projectile_ready', self.target.Position)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.animation_coroutine = coroutine.create(self.update_character_animation)
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

		for i = #self.stone_prepare_list, 1, -1 do
			local projectile = self.stone_prepare_list[i]
			projectile:dispose(true)
			self.stone_prepare_list[i] = nil
		end

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_stones(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shoot)
		elseif self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self:chase_target(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shoot then
		if self.shoot_index > self.projectile_number then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		else
			if self.time_passed >= self.shoot_interval * (self.shoot_index - 1) then
				local stone = stone_ready:new(self,
						self.character.Position + self.projectile_offsets.prepare[self.shoot_index],
						self.character.Position + self.projectile_offsets.shoot[self.shoot_index])
				stone:start()
				table.insert(self.stone_prepare_list, stone)

				self.shoot_index = self.shoot_index + 1
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		else
			coroutine.resume(self.animation_coroutine, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_stones(dt)
	local prepare_count = #self.stone_prepare_list

	if prepare_count > 0 then
		self:chase_target(dt)
	end

	for i, stone in ipairs(self.stone_shoot_list) do
		stone:update_frame(dt)

		if not stone.is_active then
			stone:dispose()
			table.insert(self.remove_list, prepare_count + i)
		end
	end

	for i, stone in ipairs(self.stone_prepare_list) do
		local res = stone:update_frame(dt)

		if res then
			local projectile = stone_projectile:new(self, res)
			projectile:shoot(self.prev_range_target_pos)
			table.insert(self.stone_shoot_list, projectile)

			stone:dispose(false)
			table.insert(self.remove_list, i)
		elseif not stone.is_active then
			stone:dispose(true)
			table.insert(self.remove_list, i)
		end
	end

	local remove_count = #self.remove_list

	for i = remove_count, 1, -1 do
		local index = self.remove_list[i]

		if index > prepare_count then
			index = index - prepare_count
			table.remove(self.stone_shoot_list, index)
		else
			table.remove(self.stone_prepare_list, index)
		end
	end

	for _ = 1, remove_count do
		table.remove(self.remove_list)
	end
end

function local_class:update_character_animation()
	while #self.stone_shoot_list == 0 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('shoot')

	local current_time = self.time_passed
	while self.time_passed < current_time + 0.5 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('end')
end

function local_class:chase_target(dt, change_direction)
	lua_helper.get_or_default(change_direction, true)

	local target_pos_diff = self.target.Position - self.prev_range_target_pos
	local new_range_target_pos = self.prev_range_target_pos
			+ target_pos_diff.normalized * math.min(self.trace_speed * dt, target_pos_diff.magnitude)
	self.prev_range_target_pos = new_range_target_pos

	if change_direction then
		local diff = new_range_target_pos - self.character.Position
		local dir_vector = diff.normalized
		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(dir_vector)
		self.character.Direction = dir
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

	if self.stone_shoot_list then
		for i = #self.stone_shoot_list, 1, -1 do
			local projectile = self.stone_shoot_list[i]
			projectile:dispose()
			self.stone_shoot_list[i] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:force_cancel()

	stone_ready:unset_param()
	stone_projectile:unset_param()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.remove_list = nil

	self.stone_prepare_list = nil
	self.stone_shoot_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fade_out then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fade_in then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'enabled')

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.repeat_cnt = 0
		self.teleport_pos = self:get_teleport_point()
		self:set_null_damage_behaviour()
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	elseif next_state == self.state.fade_out then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.spine_controller:ResetAllColors()
		self.spine_controller:AddFadeColor('ClaraTeleport', unity_class.color(1, 1, 1), 1, self.fade_out_duration)

		self.is_fx_appear_run = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.disappear then
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('disappear', self.zone_bound.center)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, 'disabled')

	elseif next_state == self.state.fade_in then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('appear', self.teleport_pos, vector_util.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport1', self.zone_bound.center)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('teleport2', self.zone_bound.center)

		self.character.Position = self.teleport_pos
		self:publish_knockback()

		self.spine_controller:RemoveFadeColor('ClaraTeleport', self.fade_in_duration)
		self.is_fx_appear_run = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self:reset_damage_behaviour()

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.spine_controller:ResetAllColors()
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fade_out)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fade_out then
		if self.is_fx_appear_run == false and self.fade_effect_ratio >= self.time_passed / self.fade_out_duration then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('appear', self.character.Position, vector_util.zero)
			self.is_fx_appear_run = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.fade_out_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.disappear)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.disappear then
		if self.time_passed >= self.disappear_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.fade_in)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.fade_in then
		if self.time_passed >= self.fade_in_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:change_teleport_type(new_type)
	if self.current_teleport_type == new_type then
		return
	end

	self.current_teleport_type = new_type
end

function local_class:publish_knockback()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.knockback_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local knockback_direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
			if knockback_direction == vector_util.zero then
				knockback_direction = vector_util.down
			end

			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = knockback_direction.normalized
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:get_teleport_point()
	self.repeat_cnt = self.repeat_cnt + 1

	if #self.marker_list < 2 then
		return self.zone_bound.center
	end

	if self.current_teleport_type == self.teleport_type.none then
		return self.zone_bound.center
	end

	if self.current_teleport_type == self.teleport_type.center then
		return self.zone_bound.center
	end

	if self.repeat_cnt >= 20 then
		return self.zone_bound.center
	end

	-- rand tp
	local r_idx = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.marker_list)
	local pos = self.marker_list[r_idx].position
	local dist = (self.character.Position - pos).magnitude
	if dist <= 1 then
		return self:get_teleport_point()
	end

	return pos
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_clara_teleport' then
		local pettern_str = e:GetParamAt(1)

		if pettern_str == 'center' then
			self:change_teleport_type(self.teleport_type.center)

		elseif pettern_str == 'random' then
			self:change_teleport_type(self.teleport_type.random)

		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_null_damage_behaviour()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:reset_damage_behaviour()
	self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_custom_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_event_func)
		self.on_custom_event_func = nil
	end

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossClaymanDemonBlasterBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	--teleport
	self.teleport_key = 'teleport'
	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportDuration', 0.5)

	--cast
	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.cast_dragon_key = 'cast_dragon'
	self.dragon_timing = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DragonTiming', 1)
	self.cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 2)
	self.float_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FloatHeight', 1)
	self.float_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FloatDuration', 1)
	self.float_speed = self.float_height / self.float_duration
	self.is_floating = false
	self.shadow_min_scale = 0.5

	--attack
	self.attack_key = 'attack'
	self.damage_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageDelay', 0.5)
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration', 1)
	self.damage_rate = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageRate', 0.2)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockBackForce', 1)

	--post
	self.post_key = 'post'
	self.descend_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DescendDuration', 1)
	self.descend_speed = self.float_height / self.descend_duration
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		teleport = 1,
		cast = 2,
		attack = 3,
		post = 4,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.character.Position = self.zone_center
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.up * self.float_height
		self:sync_shadow_scale()

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self:remove_invincible()
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
		self:sync_shadow_scale()
		self.is_floating = false
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.character.Position = vector(999,999,999)


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.is_floating = true

		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))

		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.cast_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.character.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.character.Direction)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.attack_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.attack_key)
		self:set_invincible()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.post_key)

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		if self.is_floating then
			self.is_floating = false
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
			self:sync_shadow_scale()
		end

		if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
			self.cast_fx = nil
		end

		if self.dragon_fx ~= nil then
			self.dragon_fx:Dispose()
			self.dragon_fx = nil
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_dragon_key .. '_end', self.character.Position)
		end

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)

	end
end

function local_class:execute_attack()
	self.attack_calculator:Start()
	self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

	local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.character.Position)
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
			dir = vector_util.back
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.IgnoreDefense
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.damage = math.floor(fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.damage_rate)
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

		local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
		ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Down
		ailment_info.AilmentGauge = 100
		damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, ailment_info, 1)
		damage_info.force_ailment = true

		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_light_04')

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self.attack_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:set_invincible()
	if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	end
end
function local_class:remove_invincible()
	if self.character.DamagedBehaviour ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(self.character.DamagedBehaviour, CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour) == false then
		self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour.Create();
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.cast)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed < self.float_duration then
			self:update_float(dt)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.float_duration and self.time_passed < self.float_duration - dt then
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.up * self.float_height
			self:sync_shadow_scale()
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.dragon_timing and self.time_passed - dt < self.dragon_timing then
			self.dragon_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_dragon_key, self.character.Position)
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.attack)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.attack then

		if self.time_passed > self.damage_delay and self.time_passed - dt < self.damage_delay then

			if self.cast_fx ~= nil then
				self.cast_fx:Dispose()
				self.cast_fx = nil
			end

			if self.dragon_fx ~= nil then
				self.dragon_fx:Dispose()
				self.dragon_fx = nil
			end

			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_key, self.character.Position)
			self:execute_attack()
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.attack_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed < self.descend_duration then
			self:update_descend(dt)
		elseif self.time_passed > self.descend_duration and self.time_passed < self.descend_duration - dt then
			self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector_util.zero
			self:sync_shadow_scale()
		end

		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_float(dt)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset + vector_util.up * self.float_speed * dt
	self:sync_shadow_scale()
end

function local_class:update_descend(dt)
	self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset = self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset + vector_util.down * self.descend_speed * dt
	self:sync_shadow_scale()
end

function local_class:sync_shadow_scale()
	local p = self.character.SpineController.SpineOffset.y / self.float_height
	self.character.SpineController.ShadowScale = (1 - (1 - self.shadow_min_scale) * p)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_center = bound.center

	local range_radius = math.max(bound.extents.x, bound.extents.z) * 2
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, range_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(range_radius, 2, self.attack_duration, -1)
	self.attack_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--region orb_controller
local orb_controller = {
	attack_key = 'attack'
}

function orb_controller:new(prefix, c, cs_battle_action, params)
	local controller_instance = {}
	setmetatable(controller_instance, {__index = self})

	controller_instance.controller_lower_prefix = string.lower(prefix) .. '_'
	controller_instance.controller_prefix = prefix

	controller_instance:init(c, cs_battle_action, params)

	return controller_instance
end

function orb_controller:init(c, cs_battle_action, params)
	self.character = c
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.orb_prefix = self.controller_lower_prefix .. 'orb_'
	self.orb_table = {}
	self.orb_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, self.controller_prefix .. 'OrbModifier', 1)
	self.orb_attack_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, self.controller_prefix .. 'OrbAttackTerm', 0.5)
	self.orb_offset_dict = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(params, self.controller_prefix .. 'OrbOffset')
	self.orb_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, self.controller_prefix .. 'OrbCount', 2)
	self.orb_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, self.controller_prefix .. 'OrbExplosionRadius', 1)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.orb_explosion_radius)

	self.target = nil
end

function orb_controller:set_shoot_helper(shoot_helper)
	self.shoot_helper = shoot_helper
end

function orb_controller:set_target(target)
	self.target = target
end

function orb_controller:lock_target_pos()
	self.target_pos = self.target.Position

	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_pos)
	self.attack_range:Show()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
end

function orb_controller:get_orb_offset(index)
	local current_json = CS.Utils.GetJsonObjectFromDictionary(self.orb_offset_dict, self:get_direction_string())
	local list = CS.Utils.GetFloatListFromDictionary(current_json, self.orb_prefix .. index)
	return vector(list[0], list[1], list[2])
end

function orb_controller:get_direction_string()
	if self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		return 'left'
	elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		return 'right'
	elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		return 'up'
	elseif self.character.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		return 'down'
	end
end

function orb_controller:instantiate_orbs()
	self.orb_table = {}

	for i = 1, self.orb_count do
		table.insert(self.orb_table, self:generate_orb(i))
	end
end

function orb_controller:generate_orb(index)
	return {
		position = self.character.Position + self:get_orb_offset(index),
		fx = nil,

		time_passed = 0,
		shoot_timing = index * self.orb_attack_term,

		activated = false,

		activate = function(this)
			this.time_passed = 0
			this.activated = true
			this.position = self.character.Position + self:get_orb_offset(index)
			this.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.attack_key, this.position)
		end,

		shoot_to = function(this, target_pos)
			this.fx:Dispose()
			this.fx = nil

			self.attack_range:Hide()
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(this.position, vector_util.normalized(target_pos - this.position))

			this.activated = false
		end,

		update_frame = function(this, dt)
			if not this.activated then
				return
			end

			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt

			if this.time_passed > this.shoot_timing then
				this:shoot_to(self.target_pos)
			end
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			if this.fx ~= nil then
				this.fx:Dispose()
				this.fx = nil
			end
		end
	}

end

function orb_controller:update_frame(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.orb_table do
		self.orb_table[i]:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

function orb_controller:activate_all_orb()
	for i = 1, #self.orb_table do
		self:activate_orb(i)
	end
end

function orb_controller:activate_orb(index)
	self.orb_table[index]:activate()
end

function orb_controller:deactivate_all_orb()
	for i = #self.orb_table, 1, -1 do
		self.orb_table[i]:dispose()
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
	end
end

function orb_controller:dispose()
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.cs_battle_action = nil

	self.attack_range = nil
end

--endregion

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	--cast
	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 1)

	self.right_attack_controller:set_target(self.target)

end

function local_class:cancel()
	self.left_attack_controller:deactivate_all_orb()
	self.right_attack_controller:deactivate_all_orb()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

function local_class:configure_most_far_wall_pos()

	self.wall_pos = self:get_most_far_wall_pos(self.attack_width / 2)

	local wall_pos = self:get_most_far_wall_pos(wall_offset)
	if self:get_current_wall_distance() < self:get_wall_distance(wall_offset, wall_pos) then
		self.wall_pos = wall_pos
		self.wall_offset = wall_offset
	end

	wall_pos, wall_offset = self:get_vertex_pos_and_offset()
	if wall_offset == nil then
		return
	end

	if self:get_current_wall_distance() < self:get_wall_distance(wall_offset, wall_pos) then
		self.wall_pos = wall_pos
		self.wall_offset = wall_offset
	end
