function local_class:get_wall_distance(offset, wall_pos)
	local perp = vector(self.target_dir.z, 0, -self.target_dir.x)
	return vector_util.distance(wall_pos, self.character.Position + perp * offset)
end

function local_class:get_current_wall_distance()
	return self:get_wall_distance(self.wall_offset, self.wall_pos)
end

function local_class:get_most_far_wall_pos(offset)
	local dist_x = 0
	local dist_z = 0

	local perp = vector(self.target_dir.z, 0, -self.target_dir.x)
	local check_pos = self.character.Position + perp * offset

	if self.target_dir.x < 0 then
		dist_x = (self.left - check_pos.x) / self.target_dir.x
	elseif self.target_dir.x > 0 then
		dist_x = (self.right - check_pos.x) / self.target_dir.x
	else
		dist_x = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
	end

	if self.target_dir.z < 0 then
		dist_z = (self.bottom - check_pos.z) / self.target_dir.z
	elseif self.target_dir.z > 0 then
		dist_z = (self.top - check_pos.z) / self.target_dir.z
	else
		dist_z = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
	end

	return check_pos + self.target_dir * math.min(dist_x, dist_z)
end

function local_class:get_vertex_pos_and_offset()
	--top left
	local vertex = vector(self.left, 0, self.top)

	local is_vertex_contained, offset = self:is_range_contains_point(vertex)

	if is_vertex_contained then
		if self.target_dir.x <= 0 and self.target_dir.z >= 0 then
			return vertex, offset
		end
	end

	--top right
	vertex = vector(self.right, 0, self.top)

	is_vertex_contained, offset = self:is_range_contains_point(vertex)

	if is_vertex_contained then
		if self.target_dir.x >= 0 and self.target_dir.z >= 0 then
			return vertex, offset
		end
	end

	--bottom left
	vertex = vector(self.left, 0, self.bottom)

	is_vertex_contained, offset = self:is_range_contains_point(vertex)

	if is_vertex_contained then
		if self.target_dir.x <= 0 and self.target_dir.z <= 0 then
			return vertex, offset
		end
	end

	--bottom right
	vertex = vector(self.right, 0, self.bottom)

	is_vertex_contained, offset = self:is_range_contains_point(vertex)

	if is_vertex_contained then
		if self.target_dir.x >= 0 and self.target_dir.z <= 0 then
			return vertex, offset
		end
	end

	return nil, nil
end

function local_class:is_range_contains_point(point)
	local perp = vector(self.target_dir.z, 0, -self.target_dir.x)

	local offset = vector_util.dot(perp, point) - vector_util.dot(perp, self.character.Position)
	if math.abs(offset) < self.attack_width / 2 then
		return true, offset
	else
		return false, nil
	end
end

local orb = {

}

	--orb_info

	self.orb_life_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OrbLifeTime', 5)

	--explosion
	self.explosion_key = 'explosion'
	self.orb_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OrbExplosionRadius', 4)
	self.orb_explosion_cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OrbExplosionCastDuration', 1)
	self.orb_explosion_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OrbExplosionDamageModifier', 1)
	self.orb_explosion_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'OrbExplosionKnockBackForce', 1)

	--general
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		cast = 1,
		explode = 2,
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

function orb:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.orb_life_time then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode)
		elseif self:is_target_in_radius() then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		if self.time_passed > self.orb_explosion_cast_duration then

			if self.instantiate_explode_fx ~= nil then
				self:instantiate_explode_fx()
			end

			if self.dispose_cast_ash ~= nil then
				self:dispose_cast_ash()
			end

			self:explode()

			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function orb:is_target_in_radius()
	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		if vector_util.distance(self.pos, user_party[i].Position) < self.orb_radius then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function orb:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.pos)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.orb_explosion_cast_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	else
		for i = #orb.active_orbs, 1, -1 do
			if orb.active_orbs[i] == self then
				table.remove(orb.active_orbs, i)
				self:dispose()
			end
		end
	end
end

function orb:explode()
	self.calculator:Start()
	self.calculator.Position = self.pos

	local objects = self.calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		local dir = vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.pos)
		if vector_util.is_almost_zero(dir) then
			dir = vector_util.back
		end

		local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
		damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.orb_explosion_damage_modifier
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = dir
		damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.orb_explosion_knock_back_force

		command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()

	self.calculator:End()
end

function orb:new()
	local orb_instance = {}
	setmetatable(orb_instance, {__index = orb})

	table.insert(orb.active_orbs, orb_instance)

	return orb_instance
end

function orb:update_all_orb(dt)
	for i = #self.active_orbs, 1, -1 do
		self.active_orbs[i]:update_frame(dt)
	end
end

function orb:dispose_all_orb()
	for i = #self.active_orbs, 1, -1 do
		local orb_instance = table.remove(orb.active_orbs, i)
		orb_instance:dispose()
	end
end

function orb:dispose()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end

	if self.fx ~= nil then
		self.fx:Dispose()
		self.fx = nil
	end

	self.calculator = nil
	self.attack_range = nil
end
--endregion

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	orb:init(c, params, cs_battle_action)

	--cast
	self.cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 1)
	self.cast_key = 'cast'

	--generate_orb
	self.orb_key = 'orb'
	self.generate_orb_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'GenerateOrbDuration', 1)
	self.orb_instantiate_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'InstantiateOffset', 1.5)

	--teleport
	self.teleport_key = 'teleport'
	self.teleport_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportDuration', -1)
	self.teleport_min_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportMinDist', 4)
	self.teleport_max_dist = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TeleportMaxDist', 6)

	self. teleport_origin_min_dist = 2
	self.origin_pos = nil

	self.teleport_candidate = {}
	self.teleport_candidate_unit_degree = 5

	--general
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.state = {
		none = 0,
		cast = 1,
		generate_orb = 2,
		teleport = 3,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	self.cool_time_calculator = {
		time_passed = 99,
		cool_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CoolTime', 8),

		can_trigger = function(this)
			return this.time_passed >= this.cool_time
		end,

		update = function(this, dt)
			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt
		end,

		initialize = function(this)
			this.time_passed = 0
		end
	}

end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target) and self.cool_time_calculator:can_trigger()
end

function local_class:trigger()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, vector_util.to_4way_vector(vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.character.Position)))
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cast_fx:Dispose()
		self.cast_fx = nil

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate_orb then
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then

		self.character.Position = self:determine_teleport_pos()
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.origin_pos = nil

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))

		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction))

		self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.cast_key)
		self.cast_ash = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.cast_key, self.character.Position)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate_orb then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction))
		self.orb = self:instantiate_orb()

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.orb_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.teleport_key, self.character.Position)
		self.origin_pos = self.character.Position
		self.character.Position = vector(999,999,999)

		self:substitute_orb()

	else
		self.cool_time_calculator:initialize()
		self.cast_ash = nil
		self.orb_ash = nil
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

	end
end

function local_class:substitute_orb()
	if self.orb ~= nil and self.orb.fx ~= nil then
		self.orb.fx:Dispose()
		self.orb.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.orb_key .. '_big', self.orb.pos)
	end
end

function local_class:determine_teleport_pos()
	local dir = -direction_util.to_vector3(self.target.Direction)

	local pos = self:get_random_teleport_pos_by_dir(dir)
	if pos == nil then
		dir = -dir
		pos = self:get_random_teleport_pos_by_dir(dir)
	end

	if pos == nil then
		pos = vector(random_util.get_random_value() * (self.right - self.left) + self.left, 0, random_util.get_random_value() * (self.top - self.bottom) + self.bottom)
	end

	return pos
end

function local_class:get_random_teleport_pos_by_dir(dir)
	local max_distance, max_pos = self:get_vertex_max_distance(dir)

	if max_distance > self.teleport_min_dist then
		if max_distance > self.teleport_max_dist then
			self:configure_teleport_candidate(unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * dir * self.teleport_max_dist)
			if #self.teleport_candidate > 0 then
				return self.teleport_candidate[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.teleport_candidate)]
			end
		else
			return max_pos
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_vertex_max_distance(dir)
	if dir.x == 0 and dir.z == 0 then
		dir = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)

		if dir == vector_util.zero then
			dir = vector_util.right
		end
	end

	local pos_a = nil
	local pos_b = nil

	if dir.x < 0 then
		pos_a = vector(self.left, 0, self.top)
		pos_b = vector(self.left, 0, self.bottom)
	elseif dir.x > 0 then
		pos_a = vector(self.right, 0, self.top)
		pos_b = vector(self.right, 0, self.bottom)
	elseif dir.z < 0 then
		pos_a = vector(self.right, 0, self.bottom)
		pos_b = vector(self.left, 0, self.bottom)
	elseif dir.z > 0 then
		pos_a = vector(self.right, 0, self.top)
		pos_b = vector(self.left, 0, self.top)
	end

	local dist_a = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, pos_a)
	local dist_b = vector_util.distance(self.target.Position, pos_b)

	if dist_a > dist_b then
		return dist_a, pos_a
	else
		return dist_b, pos_b
	end
end

function local_class:configure_teleport_candidate(init_vector)
	self.teleport_candidate = {}

	for i = 0, 180, self.teleport_candidate_unit_degree do
		local dest = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, i, 0)) * init_vector + self.target.Position
		if self:is_in_bound(dest) and vector_util.distance(self.origin_pos, dest) > self.teleport_origin_min_dist then
			table.insert(self.teleport_candidate, dest)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_in_bound(pos)
	return pos.x > self.left and pos.x < self.right and pos.z < self.top and pos.z > self.bottom
end

function local_class:instantiate_orb()
	local orb_pos = self.character.Position + self.target_direction * self.orb_instantiate_offset
	local orb_instance = orb:new()

	orb_instance.pos = orb_pos
	orb_instance.fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.orb_key, orb_pos)
	self.orb_ash = self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.orb_key, self.character.Position)
	orb_instance.target = self.target

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(orb_instance.orb_explosion_radius, 2)
	orb_instance.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, info)
	orb_instance.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(orb_pos, orb_instance.orb_explosion_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	orb_instance.instantiate_explode_fx = function(this)
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(this.explosion_key, this.pos)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(this.explosion_key, this.pos)
	end
	orb_instance.dispose_cast_ash = function(this)
		if self.cast_ash ~= nil then
			self.cast_ash:FadeOut(0.4)
			self.cast_ash = nil
		end

		if self.orb_ash ~= nil then
			self.orb_ash:FadeOut(0.4)
			self.orb_ash = nil
		end
	end
	orb_instance:change_state(orb_instance.state.cast)

	return orb_instance
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	orb:update_all_orb(dt)
	self.cool_time_calculator:update(dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.generate_orb)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.generate_orb then
		if self.time_passed > self.generate_orb_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.teleport)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.teleport then
		if self.time_passed > self.teleport_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	orb:dispose_all_orb()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	orb:dispose_all_orb()
	self.cool_time_calculator = nil

	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

function local_class:reset_cool_time()
	self.cool_time_calculator.time_passed = 99
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.left = bound.center.x - bound.extents.x + 2.5
	self.right = bound.center.x + bound.extents.x - 2.5
	self.top = bound.center.z + bound.extents.z - 2.5
	self.bottom = bound.center.z - bound.extents.z + 2.5
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossClevatessHuntingBeginBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region post state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')
	--- 스턴시간
	self.stun_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StunDuration')

	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	--- 트래킹 시간
	self.wave_track_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'WaveTrackDuration')
	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 쉬는시간
	self.post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PostDuration')

	--- 점프 시간
	self.jump_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpDuration')
	--- 점프 높이
	self.jump_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpHeight')
	--- 점프 횟수
	self.wave_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'WaveCount')

	--- 돌 개수
	self.rock_amount = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RockAmount')

	--- 점프 마커 위치 리스트
	self.marker_pos_list = {}

	--- 마커 이름
	local marker_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerNames')

	--- 단순히 넣어줌..
	for idx = 1, #marker_names do
		table.insert(self.marker_pos_list, field:GetMarker(marker_names[idx]).position)
	end

	--- 가로 넓이
	self.attack_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRangeWidth')

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(vector(0, 2, self.attack_width), self.action_duration, nil, true)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, false, 0, 1)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 점프 위치 인덱스
	self.jump_target_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
	--- 점프 횟수
	self.current_jump_count = 1

	--- 현재 존 캐싱
	self.zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)
	self.zone_center = self.zone_bound.center

	--- 점프 위치 캐싱
	self.jump_start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	self.jump_marker_pos = self.marker_pos_list[self.jump_target_index]
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 점프 위치 인덱스
	self.jump_target_index = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
	--- 점프 횟수
	self.current_jump_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 1)

	--- 점프 위치 캐싱
	self.jump_start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
	self.jump_marker_pos = self.marker_pos_list[self.jump_target_index]
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 어택레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(self.zone_bound.size.z, self.attack_width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 점프 인덱스가 1이면 위로 점프, 2면 밑으로 점프
	if self.jump_target_index == 1 then
		self.attack_range_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(vector(self.zone_center.x, 0, self.zone_center.z + (self.zone_bound.size.z / 2)))
		self.attack_range_direction = vector_util.back
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.forward)

	else
		self.attack_range_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(vector(self.zone_center.x, 0, self.zone_center.z - (self.zone_bound.size.z / 2)))
		self.attack_range_direction = vector_util.forward
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
	end

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'jump')
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'claw')
end

function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not next_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
		character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		-- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		--- 상태이상 면역 해제
		self.action:remove_ailment_immune()
	end

	--- 어택레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	--- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
	--- 장판 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.jump_duration) then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_time_passed / self.jump_duration)

		local h = 0

		if progress <= 0.5 then
			h = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuint(self.current_time_passed, 0, 1, self.jump_duration / 2))
		else
			h = 1 - unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuint(self.current_time_passed - (self.jump_duration / 2), 0, 1, self.jump_duration / 2))
		end

		self.current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.jump_start_pos, self.jump_marker_pos, progress)
			+ unity_class.vector3.up * h * self.jump_height

		self.owner.Position = self.current_pos
	end

	--- 캐스팅
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration) then

		--- 점프 인덱스가 1이면 위로 점프, 2면 밑으로 점프
		if self.jump_target_index == 1 then
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
		else
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.forward)
		end

		-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)

		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

		--- 점프 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'splash', self.jump_marker_pos)

		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'splash')

		--- 어택 레인지 활성화
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.attack_range_position, self.attack_range_direction)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
	end

	--- 캐스팅 추적
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration, self.jump_duration + self.wave_track_duration)
		and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then

		--- 타겟이 존재하면 트래킹하여 위치 갱신
		self.attack_range_position = vector(character_util.get_position(self.target).x, self.attack_range_position.y, self.attack_range_position.z)

		--- 어택 레인지 업데이트
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.attack_range_position, self.attack_range_direction)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
	end

	--- 공격 직전
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration + self.prepare_duration - 0.7) then
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack2')
	end

	--- 캐스팅 끝
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration + self.prepare_duration) then
		--- 어택레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

		--- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.attack_range_position)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.attack_range_direction)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local wave_pos = vector(self.attack_range_position.x, self.zone_center.y, self.zone_center.z)

		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'wave')

		--- 파도 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'wave', wave_pos, self.attack_range_direction)
	end

	--- 파도 연출
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration + self.prepare_duration, self.jump_duration + self.prepare_duration + self.action_duration)
		and area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then

		self.collision_info.Size = vector(self.zone_bound.size.z * (time_passed - self.jump_duration - self.prepare_duration) / self.action_duration, 2, self.attack_width)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do repeat

			--- 만약 기믹에 부딫힌거라면 싱크 태워 보낸다.
			if self.action:check_gimmik_obj(fo) then
				--- 웨이브가 안 끝났음
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
				--- 타겟 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_target(info, fo)
				--- 타겟 추가
				trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.attack_range_direction)
				--- 식별용 인덱스
				trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, -1)

				--- 싱크 배포
				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
				break
			end

			--- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
				break
			end

			--- 데미지 부여
			self:apply_damage(fo, self.attack_range_direction)
		until true end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.jump_duration + self.prepare_duration + self.action_duration + self.post_duration) then
		--- 장판 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		if self.current_jump_count < self.wave_count then
			--- 웨이브가 안 끝났음
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 타겟 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
			--- 타겟 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
			--- 점프 인덱스
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.jump_target_index == 1 and 2 or 1)
			--- 차지 횟수
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.current_jump_count + 1)

			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

		else
			--- 스톰프
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 타겟 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
			--- 타겟 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

			--- 대상이 정상적이면 위치를 싱크하고, 아니면 그냥 센터를 싱크한다.
			local target_pos = battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target)
				and character_util.get_position(self.target) or self.zone_center

			--- 위치 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)

			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, knock_back_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 스턴 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}

--- create action state
function stomp_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj

---- parsing battle action data
function stomp_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompDamageModifier')
	--- proj atk modifier
	self.proj_atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ProjDamageModifier')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')

	--- 추적 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompPrepareTime')
	--- 낙하 시간
	self.stomp_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompTime')
	--- 후딜
	self.post_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompAfterTime')
	--- 스톰프 점프 높이
	self.stomp_jump_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompJumpHeight')

	--- 점프 시간
	self.jump_duration = self.stomp_duration

	--- 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'StompAttackRange')

	--- 어택레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_circle(radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, false)

	self.center_gap = self.owner.Bounds.center.z - self.owner.Position.z

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function stomp_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function stomp_state_class:start(info)
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone(self.owner, self.owner).Bounds
	self.stomp_bound = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(zone_bound.center - vector(0, 0, self.center_gap), zone_bound.size - self.owner.Bounds.size);
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function stomp_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.stomp_bound, trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info), 0)
end

--- action state enter
function stomp_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 점프 시작 위치
	self.jump_start_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	--- 어택레인지 세팅
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration + self.stomp_duration)
	self:update_attack_range(self.target_pos)
end

function stomp_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil
end

function stomp_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- 상태이상 면역 해제
	self.action:remove_ailment_immune()

	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function stomp_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 어택레인지 갱신
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.prepare_duration) then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.target_pos = CS.BoundsExtensions.ConvertPositionToInsideOfBounds(self.stomp_bound, character_util.get_position(self.target), 0)
			self:update_attack_range(self.target_pos)
		end
	end

	--- 점프 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'jump')

		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')
	end

	--- 점프
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration, self.prepare_duration + self.stomp_duration) then
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.current_time_passed - self.prepare_duration / self.stomp_duration)

		local h = 0

		if progress <= 0.5 then
			h = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuint(self.current_time_passed - self.prepare_duration, 0, 1, self.stomp_duration / 2))
		else
			h = 1 - unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuint(self.current_time_passed - self.prepare_duration - (self.stomp_duration / 2), 0, 1, self.stomp_duration / 2))
		end

		self.current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.jump_start_pos, self.target_pos, progress)
			+ unity_class.vector3.up * h * self.stomp_jump_height

		self.owner.Position = self.current_pos
	end

	--- 점프 끝나기 직전
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.stomp_duration - 0.2) then
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'stomp')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.stomp_duration) then
		--- 파도 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'land', self.target_pos)
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 있으면 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do repeat
			--- 만약 기믹에 부딫힌거라면 싱크 태워 보낸다.
			if self.action:check_gimmik_obj(fo) then
				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
					self.shoot_helper[1],
					fo.Position,
					vector_util.normalized(fo.Position - self.target_pos),
					nil,
					-1
				)

				fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			end

			--- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
				break
			end

			self:apply_damage(fo)
		until true end
	end

	--- 모두 끝남
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.stomp_duration + self.post_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function stomp_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	--- 뭔가에 적중 시
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		--- 적중 가능한 대상만 적중
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
			self:apply_damage_proj(hit_info.target, hit_info.position)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function stomp_state_class:update_attack_range(position)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, position)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

function stomp_state_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function stomp_state_class:apply_damage_proj(target, hit_pos)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.proj_atk_modifier

	--- 피격 이펙트
	damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
		self.action, 'hit', hit_pos, nil, parent_follow_flag.none
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockDamageModifier')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockKnockbackForce')
	--- 스턴시간

	--- 돌 개수
	self.rock_amount = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RockAmount')

	--- 준비 시간

	--- 상태 이상 정보

	--- 충돌체 리스트

		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(bound_size, self.slide_duration)
		local calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		table.insert(self.calculator_list, calculator)
	end

	--- 바위 시퀀스 리스트
	self.sequence_list = {}
end

function field_state_class:start(info)

end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	local sequence = {}

	sequence.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	sequence.start_pos = sequence.target.Position

	sequence.time_passed = 0
	sequence.old_time_passed = 0

	sequence.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	local target_z = self.zone_bound.center + sequence.dir_vector * ((self.zone_bound.size.z / 2) - (bounds_util.get_bounds(sequence.target).size.z / 2))

	sequence.target_pos = vector(sequence.target.Position.x, sequence.target.Position.y, target_z.z)

	table.insert(self.sequence_list, sequence)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 시퀀스에 뭐가 있으면 다 비워줌
	for idx = #self.sequence_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.sequence_list[idx] then
			self.sequence_list[idx].target = nil
		end

		table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)
	end

	for idx = #self.calculator_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.calculator_list[idx] then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
		end
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 장판 판정
	for idx = #self.sequence_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		if not self.sequence_list[idx] then
			break
		end

		local sequence = self.sequence_list[idx]

		sequence.old_time_passed = sequence.time_passed
		sequence.time_passed = sequence.time_passed + dt

		--- 떨어지기 시작
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(sequence.old_time_passed, sequence.time_passed, 0) then
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], sequence.target.Position)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_list[idx])
		end

		--- 떨어지는 중
		if battle_util.check_time_between(sequence.old_time_passed, sequence.time_passed, 0, self.slide_duration) then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(sequence.time_passed / self.slide_duration)
			sequence.target.Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(sequence.start_pos, sequence.target_pos, progress)

			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_list[idx], sequence.target.Position)

			if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator_list[idx]) then
				--- 판정 체크
				local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_list[idx], dt)

				--- 무언가가 피격되었으면 돌도 같이 부숴줘야 한다.
				if 0 < #fo_list then
					for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do repeat
						self:apply_damage(fo, sequence.dir_vector)
					until true end

					sequence.target.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
					self.sequence_list[idx].target = nil
					table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)

					area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
				end
			end
		end

		--- 도중에 없어진게 아니고 다 떨어졌으면 제거
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(sequence.old_time_passed, sequence.time_passed, self.slide_duration) and self.sequence_list[idx] then
			self.sequence_list[idx].target = nil
			table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_list[idx])
		end

	until true end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, damage_dir)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = damage_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 스턴 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.stun_duration = self.stun_duration

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info.ailment_info = self.ailment_info

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 돌 개수
	local rock_amount = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'RockAmount')

	--- 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.gimmik_list = {}

	for idx = 1, rock_amount do
		local fo = get_field_object('clevatess_gimmik_' .. idx)
		table.insert(self.gimmik_list, fo)
	end

	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- stomp state
	self.stomp_state = stomp_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.stomp_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.field_state, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.stomp_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.stomp_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 시작하자마자 immune
	self:set_ailment_immune()

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.stomp_state:start(info)
	self.field_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		self.stomp_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.stomp_state)
	elseif trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info) < 0 then
		self.field_state:sync(info)
	else
		self.action_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.stomp_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:check_gimmik_obj(fo)
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do repeat
		--- 꺼져 있으면 고려하지 않음
		if fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			break
		end

		--- 같으면 바로 true
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.gimmik_list[idx]) then
			return true
		end
	until true end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_gimmik_bound_size()
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do repeat
		if not self.gimmik_list[idx] then
			break
		end

		return bounds_util.get_size(self.gimmik_list[idx])
	until true end

	return vector_util.one
end

function local_class:set_ailment_immune()
	local options = CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoStun | CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.NoAilment
	self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_action, options)
end

function local_class:remove_ailment_immune()
	self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(self.cs_action)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossClevatessRockEatingBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region prepare state

local prepare_state_class = {

--- create action state

	--- 단순히 넣어줌..
	for idx = 1, #marker_names do

	end

	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- 먼저 텔레포트 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	--- 위치 바꾸고
	self.owner.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.marker_pos_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.marker_pos_list)])

	--- 또 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

function prepare_state_class:exit(new_state)

	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not new_state then
		--- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function prepare_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 캐스팅동안 캐스팅
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.prepare_duration) then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.action:set_locked_target_side(self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 타겟 추가

		--- 타겟 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 차지 횟수
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.charge_count)
		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 어택 레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(length, width), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.gimmik_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		local fo = get_field_object('clevatess_gimmik_' .. idx)
		table.insert(self.gimmik_list, fo)
	end

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
end

function charge_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function charge_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function charge_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 현재 횟수
	self.current_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	--- 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner))
end

--- action state enter
function charge_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')
	--- 어택 레인지 활성화
	battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration)
	--- 어택레인지 갱신
	self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

	--- 캐싱된 액션이 없으면 탐색한다.
	if self.spitting_action == nil then
		self.spitting_action = battle_util.get_battle_action_by_name(self.owner, self.spitting_action_name)
	end

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.prepare_duration)
end

function charge_state_class:update_attack_range(position, direction)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, position, direction)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

function charge_state_class:exit(new_state)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 크래시 비헤이비어 제거
	battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour)
	self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
	--- 장판 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.charge_calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function charge_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 캐스팅동안 캐스팅
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.prepare_duration) then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
			self.target, self.dir_vector = self.action:set_locked_target_side(self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- 어택레인지 갱신
		self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 돌진 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		--- 어택레인지 정보 해제
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'charge')

		-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

		--- 크래시 비헤이비어 세팅
		self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'action', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.5, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.charge_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		area_collision_util.start(self.charge_calculator)
	end

	--- 돌진동안 돌진
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration, self.prepare_duration + self.charge_duration) then
		self:charge_update(dt)

		--- 판정이 종료되었을때
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.charge_calculator) then
			--- 크래시 비헤이비어 제거
			battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour)
			self.cs_action.CurrentCrashBehaviour = nil

			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.charge_calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 모두 끝남
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.charge_duration + self.post_duration) then

		--- 남은 차지 횟수가 없음
		if self.current_count <= 1 then
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
		else
			--- 트리거 정보 구성
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 싱크타입 설정
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
			--- 시작 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.target_pos)
			--- 시작 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.current_count - 1)

			--- 싱크 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	end
end

function charge_state_class:charge_update(dt)

	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.dir_vector
	move_info.magnitude = (self.charge_length / self.charge_duration) * dt

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector), true,
		CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.SlipAdjust, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.owner, move_event)

	--- 이 밑은 충돌체 충돌처리 부분
	if not area_collision_util.is_started(self.charge_calculator) then
		return
	end

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.charge_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 판정 체크
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.charge_calculator, dt)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do repeat

		--- 만약 기믹에 부딫힌거라면 부수고 파편을 발사한다.
		if self:check_gimmik_obj(fo) then
			shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
				self.shoot_helper[1],
				fo.Position,
				-self.dir_vector,
				nil,
				-1
			)

			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'break')

			--- 발사 액션이 있다면 먹었음을 알림
			if self.spitting_action then
				local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

				trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, 1)

				command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.spitting_action, info)
			end

			fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			break
		end

		--- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, fo) then
			break
		end

		local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, fo)

		--- 넉백 방향은 돌진 방향에 수직한 방향
		local xz_target_direction = direction:GetXz().normalized
		local xz_move_direction = self.dir_vector:GetXz().normalized
		local knock_direction
		if xz_move_direction:IsClockWise(xz_target_direction) then
			knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.dir_vector
		else
			knock_direction = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dir_vector
		end

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.owner
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier
		damage_info.direction = direction
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction.normalized
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_slash_01')

		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	until true end
end

function charge_state_class:check_gimmik_obj(fo)
	for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do repeat
		--- 꺼져 있으면 고려하지 않음
		if fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			break
		end

		--- 같으면 바로 true
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.gimmik_list[idx]) then
			return true
		end
	until true end

	return false
end

function charge_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)

	--- 뭔가에 적중 시
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		--- 적중 가능한 대상만 적중
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
			self:apply_damage_proj(hit_info.target, hit_info.position)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function charge_state_class:apply_damage_proj(target, hit_pos)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.proj_atk_modifier

	--- 피격 이펙트
	damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
		self.action, 'hit', hit_pos, nil, parent_follow_flag.none
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- prepare state
	self.prepare_state = prepare_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- charge state
	self.charge_state = charge_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.prepare_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.charge_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.prepare_state, self.charge_state)

		self.prepare_state = nil
		self.charge_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.charge_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.prepare_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.prepare_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.prepare_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.prepare_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.prepare_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.charge_state:sync(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.charge_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.charge_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:set_locked_target_side(target, dir_vector)
	if is_unity_null(target) or character_util.is_dead(target) then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(dir_vector))

		return nil, dir_vector
	end

	dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.cs_action.Character, target)

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(dir_vector.magnitude) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.cs_action.Character))
	end

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(dir_vector))

	return target, dir_vector
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossClevatessRockingRoarBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region post state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신

	--- 상위 클래스

	--- 오너

	--- CS 클래스

	--- damage type

	--- atk factor

	--- 이펙트 오프셋

	--- 사출 타이밍
	shoot_timings = nil,
	--- 이펙트 테이블

	--- 상태 유지시간

	--- cs projectile shooter

	--- shoot helper

	--- projectile spec

	--- 사출 오프셋

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)

	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)

	--- 액션 시간

	self.state_duration = self.action_duration
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'prepare')

	local offset = vector(0 < self.dir_vector.x and 1 or -1 ,5, 0)

	--- 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'prepare', character_util.get_position(self.owner) + offset)

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'roar')

	-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.state_duration)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end
