---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')

	--- 충돌체 폭
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 돌 개수
	self.rock_amount = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RockAmount')

	--- 준비 시간
	self.casting_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareTime')
	--- 내려오는 시간
	self.fall_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockFallDuration')

	--- 카메라 쉐이크
	self.shake_amount = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockShakeAmount')
	self.shake_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockShakeDuration')

	--- 충돌체 리스트
	self.calculator_list = {}

	--- 충돌체 3개 추가
	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		--- 충돌체 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(radius)
		local calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

		table.insert(self.calculator_list, calculator)
	end

	--- 충돌체 리스트
	self.attack_range_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, battle_range_util.create_circle(radius, attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward))
	end

	--- 마커 위치 리스트
	self.marker_pos_list = {}

	--- 마커 이름
	local marker_names = cs_util.get_string_table_from_dictionary(param, 'MarkerNames')

	--- 최대 마커 개수
	self.max_marker_count = #marker_names

	--- 단순히 넣어줌..
	for idx = 1, self.max_marker_count do
		table.insert(self.marker_pos_list, field:GetMarker(marker_names[idx]).position)
	end

	--- 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.action.gimmik_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		local fo = get_field_object('clevatess_gimmik_' .. idx)
		fo.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

		table.insert(self.action.gimmik_list, fo)
	end

	--- 바위 시퀀스 리스트
	self.sequence_list = {}
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:start_rock()

	local rand = self:get_random_list()

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		local sequence = {}

		sequence.time_passed = 0
		sequence.old_time_passed = 0

		sequence.timer = (self.casting_duration / self.rock_amount) * idx
		sequence.fall_timer = sequence.timer + self.fall_duration

		sequence.index = rand[idx]
		sequence.position = self.marker_pos_list[sequence.index]

		table.insert(self.sequence_list, sequence)
	end
end

--- 중복되지 않는 count 개의 랜덤을 1 ~ max 사이에서 반환한다.
function field_state_class:get_random_list()
	local rv = {}
	local mem = {}

	for idx = 1, self.max_marker_count do
		table.insert(mem, idx)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, #mem)
		table.insert(rv, table.remove(mem, rand))
	end

	return rv
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:dispose()
	for idx = #self.attack_range_list, 1, -1 do
		battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		table.remove(self.attack_range_list, idx)
	end

	self.attack_range_list = nil
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 어택 레인지 비활성화
	for idx = 1, #self.attack_range_list do
		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
	end

	--- 시퀀스에 뭐가 있으면 다 비워줌
	for _, sequence in pairs(self.sequence_list) do
		if sequence then
			if sequence.fx_rock then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(sequence.fx_rock)
				sequence.fx_rock = nil
			end
		end
	end

	self.sequence_list = {}
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 장판 판정
	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do repeat
		if not self.sequence_list[idx] then
			break
		end

		local sequence = self.sequence_list[idx]
		local index = sequence.index

		sequence.old_time_passed = sequence.time_passed
		sequence.time_passed = sequence.time_passed + dt

		--- 떨어지기 시작
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(sequence.old_time_passed, sequence.time_passed, sequence.timer) then
			--- 이펙트 출력
			sequence.fx_rock = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock', sequence.position)

			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range_list[idx], self.fall_duration)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[idx], sequence.position)
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])
		end

		--- 떨어지는것 끝남
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(sequence.old_time_passed, sequence.time_passed, sequence.fall_timer) then
			battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range_list[idx])
			battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range_list[idx])

			--- 판정 체크
			local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator_list[idx], sequence.position)

			--- 피격 대상이 있으면 데미지 부여
			if 0 < #fo_list then
				for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
					self:apply_damage(fo, sequence.position)
				end
			end

			self.action.gimmik_list[idx].Position = sequence.position
			self.action.gimmik_list[idx].ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

			if sequence.fx_rock then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(sequence.fx_rock)
				sequence.fx_rock = nil
			end

			--- 연출
			stage_camera:Shake(self.shake_amount, self.shake_duration)
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock_spawn', sequence.position)

			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			--- 제거
			self.sequence_list[idx] = nil
		end

	until true end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, position)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(target) - position)
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_strong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	self.gimmik_list = {}

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.field_state, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수
	self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func = function(e) self:on_fo_destroyed_event(e) end
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독
	message_system_util.subscribe(event_type.fo_destroyed, self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func)

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 구독 해제
	message_system_util.unsubscribe(event_type.fo_destroyed, self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func)
	--- 필드 오브젝트 파괴 이벤트 처리 함수 할당 해제
	self.on_fo_destroyed_event_func = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.field_state:start_rock()
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- field state reset
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:on_fo_destroyed_event(e)
	--- 이벤트 타입 검증
	if not lua_helper.type_compare(e, event_type.fo_destroyed) then return end

	--- 사망한 fo 캐싱
	local fo = e.FieldObject

	--- 내가 죽은게 아니면 하지 않음
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.owner) or not character_util.is_dead(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 내가 죽었으니 돌을 완전히 날려줌
	for _, gimmik in pairs(self.gimmik_list) do
		if gimmik.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
			gimmik.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
		end
	end

	self.gimmik_list = {}
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- 몬스터 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('BossClevatessRockSpittingBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 준비 시간
	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockSuckingPrepareTime')
	--- 액션 시간
	self.drain_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockSuckingDuration')
	--- 액션 시간
	self.shoot_prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockSpittingPrepareTime')

	--- 돌 개수
	self.rock_amount = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'RockAmount')

	--- 기믹 오브젝트 캐싱
	self.gimmik_list = {}

	for idx = 1, self.rock_amount do
		local fo = get_field_object('clevatess_gimmik_' .. idx)
		table.insert(self.gimmik_list, fo)
	end

	--- 바위 시퀀스 리스트
	self.sequence_list = {}

	--- 바위 흡수 카운팅
	self.rock_drain_count = 0
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 현재 횟수
	self.rock_drain_count = self.rock_drain_count + trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(prev_state)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 현재 존
	local zone_bound = battle_util.get_event_zone_bound(self.owner, self.owner)

	--- 먼저 텔레포트 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', character_util.get_position(self.owner))
	--- 바로 텔레포트
	self.owner.Position = zone_bound.center
	--- 또 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'teleport', character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
	--- 애니메이션 지정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'claw')
end

function action_state_class:exit(next_state)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	if not next_state then
		--- 애니메이션 해제
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
		character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
		-- 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
	attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

	--- 시퀀스에 뭐가 있으면 다 비워줌
	for idx = #self.sequence_list, 1, -1 do
		if self.sequence_list[idx] then
			if self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock)
				self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock = nil
			end

			if self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail)
				self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail = nil
			end
		end

		table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 살짝 대기시간 끝
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.drain_duration)

		--- 흡수 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'sucking', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'drain')

		--- 바위 흡수 시작
		for idx = 1, #self.gimmik_list do repeat
			local fo = self.gimmik_list[idx]

			--- 꺼져 있으면 고려하지 않음
			if fo.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				break
			end

			local sequence = {}

			sequence.fx_rock = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'rock', fo.Position)
			sequence.start_pos = fo.Position

			table.insert(self.sequence_list, sequence)

			--- 꺼주자.
			fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

			self.rock_drain_count = self.rock_drain_count + 1
		until true end
	end

	--- 바위 흡수
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration, self.prepare_duration + self.drain_duration) then
		for idx = 1, #self.sequence_list do
			local sequence = self.sequence_list[idx]

			--- 현재 fx 위치
			local fx_pos = sequence.fx_rock.transform.position

			--- 남은 시간 체크
			local remain_time = math.max(self.prepare_duration + self.drain_duration - time_passed, 0)

			--- 다음 lerp 도달점
			local next_lerp = 0

			if remain_time <= 0 then
				next_lerp = 1
			else
				next_lerp = math.min(dt / remain_time, 1)
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((self.current_time_passed - self.prepare_duration) / self.drain_duration)

			--- 현재 위치
			local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(sequence.start_pos, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + vector_util.up, progress)

			--- 위로 띄워줌
			next_pos.y = next_pos.y + unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 1

			--- 이펙트 스케일 업데이트
			sequence.fx_rock.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * (1 - progress)

			--- 이펙트 포지션 업데이트
			effect_util.update_object(sequence.fx_rock, next_pos, vector_util.normalized(next_pos - fx_pos))
		end
	end

	--- 흡수 끝
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.drain_duration) then
		-- 케스팅 게이지 활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_start(self.owner, self.shoot_prepare_duration)

		--- 시퀀스에 뭐가 있으면 다 비워줌
		for idx = #self.sequence_list, 1, -1 do
			if self.sequence_list[idx] then
				if self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock then
					effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock)
					self.sequence_list[idx].fx_rock = nil
				end

				if self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail then
					effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail)
					self.sequence_list[idx].fx_contrail = nil
				end
			end

			table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration + self.drain_duration + self.shoot_prepare_duration) then
		-- 캐스팅 게이지 비활성화
		attack_queue_util.publish_end(self.owner)

		--- 바위 개수 초기화
		local rock_count = self.rock_drain_count
		self.rock_drain_count = 0

		--- 트리거 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 타겟 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)
		--- 타겟 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 차지 횟수
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, rock_count)

		--- 싱크 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end
end

--endregion

	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스

	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk factor
	atk_factor = nil,

	--- 상태 유지시간
	state_duration = nil,
	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	calculator_list = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageModifier')
	--- 넉백
	self.knock_back_force = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'KnockbackForce')

	--- 액션 시간
	self.shoot_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RockSpittingActionDuration')

	--- 그로기
	self.groggy_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'GroggyDuration')

	--- C# 슈터 생성
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 투사체 데이터 파싱 및 생성
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 어택레인지
	self.attack_range = battle_range_util.create_rect(vector(projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1]), projectile_spec_util.get_hit_box_width(self.proj_spec[1])), attack_range_show_type.overlay_forward)

	--- 현재 바위 개수
	self.rock_count = 0
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 현재 횟수
	self.rock_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	if self.rock_count <= 0 then
		--- 먹은 바위가 없음
		self.action_duration = self.groggy_duration

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
		--- 애니메이션 지정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'groggy')
	else
		--- 먹은 바위가 있음
		self.action_duration = self.shoot_duration

		--- 발사 간격
		self.shoot_delay = (self.shoot_duration / self.rock_count)

		--- 발사 간격에 따라 쏘는 애니메이션의 스케일 조절
		local animation_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(self.owner, self.action.animation_info['action'].name)

		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = animation_duration / self.shoot_delay

		-- 우선 방향 해제
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	-- 보던 방향으로 실제 방향 변경
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	-- 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
	battle_range_util.publish_end(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 먹은 바위가 있으면 쏴야 함
	if 0 < self.rock_count then
		--- 대상 추적
		if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.action_duration)
			and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then

			self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
		end

		for idx = 1, self.rock_count do
			--- 어택레인지
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_delay * (idx - 1)) then
				--- 어택 레인지 활성화
				battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.shoot_delay)
				--- 어택레인지 갱신
				self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)
			end

			--- 애니메이션 지정
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_delay * (idx - 1) + self.shoot_delay * 0.3) then
				battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'idle')
				battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
			end

			--- 어택레인지 갱신
			if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_delay * (idx - 1), self.shoot_delay * idx) then
				self:update_attack_range(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)
			end

			--- 실제 발사
			if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_delay * idx) then
				--- 효과음 출력
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

				shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 모두 끝남
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function field_state_class:update_attack_range(position, direction)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, position, direction)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.owner, self.attack_range)
end

function field_state_class:dispose()
	battle_range_util.destroy(self.attack_range)
	self.attack_range = nil
end

function field_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 뭔가에 적중 시
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		--- 적중 가능한 대상만 적중
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
			self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, hit_info.position)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, hit_pos)
	--- 데미지 정보
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.atk_modifier

	--- 피격 이펙트
	damage_info.hit_effect = damage_info_util.create_unity_object_hit_effect(
		self.action, 'hit', hit_pos, nil, parent_follow_flag.none
	)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 배포
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- projectile state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.field_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- AI 타게팅 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 없다면 시전 실패
	if not target then
		return false
	end

	--- vector의 크기 0일때는 바라보던 방향을 사용
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
		dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	-- append target
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_target(info) then
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.state_machine:change(self.field_state)
	else
		--- 외부에서의 싱크..
		self.action_state:sync(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

	end
}

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('shoot', self.character.Position)
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(self.character.Bounds.center, self.tracking_dir)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_tracking(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	self.tracking_dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.tracking_dir)
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.tracking_dir)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
	fx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	sfx:Stop()
	sfx = nil
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function dash_class:trigger()

end

function dash_class:start(target, fx_orb, fx_contrail)
	self.target = target
	self.fx_orb = fx_orb
	self.fx_orb_contrail = fx_contrail
	self.position = fx_orb.transform.position
	self.start_pos = fx_orb.transform.position
	self.dash_count = 0
	self.dash_dist = 0
	self.expl_count = 0

end

function dash_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash then
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.dash_dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.position, self.dash_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)

		self.fx_orb_contrail.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	elseif next_state == self.state.dash then
		self.dash_dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		self.dash_count = self.dash_count + 1
		self.dash_dist = 0
		self.expl_count = 0
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dash', self.position, self.dash_dir, self.fx_orb.transform)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dash', self.position)
		if self.fx_contrail == nil then
			self.fx_contrail = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('contrail', self.position, vector_util.zero, self.fx_orb.transform)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.interval then
		self.dash_dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.position, self.dash_dir)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.interval_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then

	else
		if self.fx_contrail ~= nil then
			self.fx_contrail:Dispose()
			self.fx_contrail = nil
		end

		if self.fx_orb_contrail ~= nil then
			self.fx_orb_contrail.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function dash_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:update_explosion(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.dash_dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.position, self.dash_dir)

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.dash)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.dash then
		self:update_move(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.dash_duration then
			if self.dash_count >= self.dash_amount then
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.interval)
			end
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.interval then
		self.dash_dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.position, self.dash_dir)

		if self.time_passed >= self.interval_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.dash)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		-- fx_contrail 자연스럽게 사라지게 하기 위한 강제 post duration
		if self.time_passed >= 1 then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function dash_class:update_move(dt)
	local diff = self.dash_dir * self.dash_speed * dt
	local npos = self.position + diff
	local xmin = self.bounds.min.x
	local xmax = self.bounds.max.x
	-- 트리스 전투 맵 벽 y가 높아 구체 대쉬시 어색하다. 강제로 제한 높이를 끌어 올리자
	local zmin = self.bounds.min.z + self.dash_under_limit_offset
	local zmax = self.bounds.max.z
	npos.x = math.max(xmin, math.min(xmax, npos.x))
	npos.z = math.max(zmin, math.min(zmax, npos.z))
	local magn = (self.position - npos).magnitude

	self.position = npos
	self.dash_dist = self.dash_dist + magn

	-- 마지막에 하나 더 들어가면 안이뻐서 강제로 뺌
	local amount = (self.dash_dist / self.explosion_space) - 1
	if amount > self.expl_count then
		if self.expl_count % 2 == 0 then
			local rv = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.dash_dir
			local pos = self.position + rv * self.explosion_spread_distance
			self:add_explosion(pos)
		else
			local rv = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dash_dir
			local pos = self.position + rv * self.explosion_spread_distance
			self:add_explosion(pos)
		end
		self.expl_count = self.expl_count + 1
	end

	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_orb, self.position)
end

function dash_class:add_explosion(pos)
	table.insert(self.expl_list, {pos = pos, remain_time = self.explosion_delay})
end

function dash_class:update_explosion(dt)
	for i = #self.expl_list, 1, -1 do
		local data = self.expl_list[i]
		data.remain_time = data.remain_time - dt

		if data.remain_time <= 0 then
			self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', data.pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', data.pos)
			self:publish_damage(data.pos)
			table.remove(self.expl_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function dash_class:is_cancelable()
	return self.current_state == self.state.prepare
end

function dash_class:publish_damage(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.explosion_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_modifier
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit', pos)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function dash_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
end

function dash_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

	self.tracking_speed = proj_s

	self.knockback_force = k_force

	-- ignition
	self.ignition_duration = ig_dur

	-- explosion
	self.explosion_distance = expl_dist
	self.explosion_radius = expl_r
	self.explosion_hp_ratio = expl_hp_ratio

function proj_class:trigger()
	return self.current_state ~= nil and self.current_state == self.state.none
end

function proj_class:start(target, pos)
	self.target = target
	self.position = pos
	self:change_state(self.state.track)
end

function proj_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.track then
		if next_state ~= self.state.ignition then
			self.calc:End()
		end
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_proj)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ignition then
		self.calc:End()
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_ignition)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.expl then

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.track then
		self.fx_proj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('projectile', self.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('spawn', self.character.Position)
		self.calc:Start()
		self.coll_info.Radius = self.proj_radius

	elseif next_state == self.state.ignition then
		self.fx_ignition = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('ignition', self.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('expand', self.character.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.ignition_duration)

	elseif next_state == self.state.expl then
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('explosion', self.character.Position)

	else
		if self.calc ~= nil and self.calc.IsStarted then
			self.calc:End()
		end

		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_proj)
		self:dispose_fx(self.fx_ignition)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 00
end

function proj_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.track then
		self:update_move(dt)
		self:publish_nearby(dt)
		if self:check_closer() or self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.ignition)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.ignition then
		self:resize_collision(dt)
		self:publish_nearby(dt)
		if self.time_passed >= self.ignition_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.expl)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.expl then
		self:publish_explosion()
		self:change_state(self.state.none)
	end

function proj_class:update_move(dt)
	if self.fx_proj == nil then
		return
	end

	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.position).normalized
	local npos = dir * self.tracking_speed * dt + self.position
	self.position = npos
	CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_proj, self.position)

function proj_class:check_closer()
	-- TODO : NPC 예외처리

		local diff = (self.position - v.Position).magnitude
		if diff <= self.explosion_distance then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function proj_class:publish_nearby(dt)
	self.calc.Position = self.position
	local objects = self.calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = (fo.Position - self.position).normalized
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function proj_class:resize_collision(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.proj_expand_duration)
	local r = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.proj_radius, self.proj_expand_radius, progress)
	self.coll_info.Radius = r
end

function proj_class:publish_explosion()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.position, self.explosion_radius)
	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.damage = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(fo) * self.explosion_hp_ratio)
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction((self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized)
		local d_str = direction_util.to_str(self.character.Direction)
		local offset = self.fx_offset[d_str]
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position + offset)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('action')
		self:shoot_proj()

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	self.current_state = next_state

function local_class:update_frame(dt)

		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)

		if proj:trigger() then
			table.insert(self.idle_list, table.remove(self.active_list, i))
		else
			proj:update_frame(dt)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:create_proj()
	return proj_class:new(self, self.character, self.cs_battle_action, self.projectile_radius, self.projectile_speed,
			self.projectile_expand_radius, self.projectile_expand_duration,
			self.tracking_duration, self.damage_modifier, self.damage_term,	self.knockback_force, self.ignition_duration,
			self.explosion_distance, self.explosion_radius, self.explosion_hp_ratio)
end

function local_class:get_proj()
	if #self.idle_list > 0 then
		return table.remove(self.idle_list, 1)
	end

	return self:create_proj()
end

function local_class:return_proj(proj)
	table.insert(self.idle_list, proj)
end

function local_class:shoot_proj()
	local proj = self:get_proj()
	proj:start(self.target, self.character.Bounds.center)
	table.insert(self.active_list, proj)
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx == nil then
		return
	end

	sfx:Stop()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_companion_clear_action' then
		for _, v in pairs(self.idle_list) do

		end

		for i = #self.active_list, 1, -1 do
			local star = table.remove(self.active_list, i)
			star:cancel()
			table.insert(self.idle_list, star)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('prepare', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		if self.orb_class:trigger() then
			self.orb_class:start(self.fx_orb, self.target)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.orb_class:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self:update_tracking()

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_tracking(dt)
	local dir = (self.target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
	self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
end

function local_class:create_orb()
	return orb_class:new(self, self.character, self.cs_battle_action,
			self.orb_prepare1_duration, self.orb_prepare2_duration, self.orb_delay_duration, self.orb_interval_duration,
			self.orb_min_size, self.orb_max_size, self.missile_amount, self.shoot_helper)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not is_unity_null(self.shoot_helper) then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx ~= nil then
		fx:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_sfx(sfx)
	if sfx ~= nil then
		sfx:Stop()
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.orb_class:cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
end

function local_class:set_orb(fx_orb, fx_contrail)

	self.fx_contrail = fx_contrail
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossDarkMagicianDarkHandBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 1)
	self.shot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadius", 3)
	self.shot_repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShotRepeatCount", 3)
	self.shot_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotKnockBackForce", 1.2)
	self.shot_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDamageModifier", 1.2)
	self.shot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotSpeed", 10)
	self.shot_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotExplosionRadius", 5)
	self.shot_damage_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDamageDelay", 0.3)
	self.shot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDuration", 0.5)
	self.shot_impact_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotImpactDuration", 0.1)
	self.radial_shot_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "RadialShotCount", 8)
	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)

	self.virtual_attack_range = nil
	self.effect_start_height = 5

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.dark_hand_info_list = {}
	self.dark_hand_hit_list = {}
	self.explosion_hit_list = {}
	self.dark_hand_casting_effect = nil

	--2Phase 방사형 발사체
	if self.enhanced then
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.character)
		local proj_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "Projectile", "boss_darkmagician_radial_shot")
		local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("ProjectileData"):GetSpec(proj_name)
		local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo.GetPatternInfoFromParameter(params)
		self.shoot_helper = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot)
	end

	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.target = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.is_start_animation = false

	self.is_start_casting = false
	self.instantiate_casting_effect = false
	self.casting_effect_prepare_duration = 0.7
	self.casting_effect_post_duration = 0.5
	self.casting_effect_offset = vector(-0.85, 0, 1.55)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds

	if is_unity_null(self.virtual_attack_range) then
		self.virtual_attack_range = CS.Oak.VirtualAttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero,
				self.zone_bounds.size.x, self.shot_radius, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character,
			self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.dark_hand_info_list = {}
	self.dark_hand_hit_list = {}
	self.explosion_hit_list = {}
	self.is_start_animation = false
	self.is_start_casting = false
	self.instantiate_casting_effect = false

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if (self.dark_hand_info_list ~= nil) then
		for _, v in pairs(self.dark_hand_info_list) do
			for _, v2 in pairs(v.effect_obj_list) do
				if not is_unity_null(v2.effect_obj) then
					v2.effect_obj:Dispose()
				end
				v2.effect_obj = nil
				v2 = nil
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.virtual_attack_range) then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.dark_hand_casting_effect) then
		self.dark_hand_casting_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		local shot_start_pos1 = vector(self.zone_bounds.min.x, 0, self.target.Position.z)
		local shot_start_pos2 = vector(self.zone_bounds.max.x, 0, self.target.Position.z)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.virtual_attack_range, shot_start_pos1, unity_class.vector3.right, self.character.Position.y)
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.virtual_attack_range))

		local dest = self.zone_bounds.center
		dest.z = self.target.Position.z

		local diff1 = dest - shot_start_pos1
		local diff2 = dest - shot_start_pos2

		table.insert(self.dark_hand_info_list, {
			start_action = false,
			end_action = false,
			dest_pos = dest,
			life_time = diff1.magnitude / self.shot_speed,
			is_explosion = false,
			passed_time = 0,
			explosion_time = self.shot_impact_duration,
			explosion_passed_time = 0,

			effect_obj_list = {
				{
					effect_obj = nil,
					start_pos = shot_start_pos1,
					diff = diff1,
					direction = unity_class.vector3.right
				},
				{
					effect_obj = nil,
					start_pos = shot_start_pos2,
					diff = diff2,
					direction = unity_class.vector3.left
				}
			}
		})

		--캐스팅 사운드
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("cast")

		if not self.is_start_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("start")
			self.is_start_animation = true
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		for i = 1, 2 do
			self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].effect_obj = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dark_hand",
					self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].start_pos)
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].effect_obj_list[i].start_pos)
		end
		self.dark_hand_info_list[self.current_repeat_count + 1].start_action = true

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("end")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	self:dark_hand_update(dt)

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed <= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration and not self.is_start_casting then
			if not self.instantiate_casting_effect then
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("casting",
						self.character.Position + self.casting_effect_offset)
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
				self.instantiate_casting_effect = true
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_prepare_duration))
			self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration then
			self.is_start_casting = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

		if self.is_start_casting then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_post_duration))
			self.dark_hand_casting_effect.transform.localScale = (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.one

			if self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_post_duration then
				self.dark_hand_casting_effect:Dispose()
				self.is_start_casting = false
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dark_hand_update(dt)

	--Info가 없다면 실행하지 않음
	if #self.dark_hand_info_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	--중심으로 이동하는 dark_hand 시퀸스들
	for i = #self.dark_hand_info_list, 1, -1 do
		local info = self.dark_hand_info_list[i]
		if info.start_action and not info.end_action then

			if info.passed_time <= info.life_time then
				info.passed_time = info.passed_time + dt

				for _, v in pairs(info.effect_obj_list) do
					v.effect_obj.transform.position = v.start_pos + info.passed_time / info.life_time * v.diff

					local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.effect_obj.transform.position, self.shot_radius)

					for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do

						local is_hit_delayed = false
						for i = #self.dark_hand_hit_list, 1, -1 do
							if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].fo) then
								self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time = self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time - dt
								if self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time ~= nil and self.dark_hand_hit_list[i].life_time >= 0 then
									is_hit_delayed = true
								else
									table.remove(self.dark_hand_hit_list, i)
								end
							end
						end

						if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
								fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
								lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or is_hit_delayed then
						else
							local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - info.dest_pos).normalized
							local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
							damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
							damage_info.sender = self.character
							damage_info.target = fo
							damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
							damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
							damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
							damage_info.knockBackDirection = v.direction
							damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

							command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
							table.insert(self.dark_hand_hit_list, { fo = fo, life_time = self.shot_damage_delay })
						end
					end

					fo_list:Dispose()
				end
			else
				if info.explosion_passed_time <= info.explosion_time then
					info.explosion_passed_time = info.explosion_passed_time + dt
					if not info.is_explosion then
						for _, effect in pairs(info.effect_obj_list) do
							effect.effect_obj:Dispose()
							effect.effect_obj = nil
						end
						self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", info.dest_pos)

						--폭발 사운드
						self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", info.dest_pos)

						info.is_explosion = true
					end

					self:impact_damage(info.dest_pos)
				else
					if self.enhanced then
						self:shoot_radial_shot(info.dest_pos)
					end
					self.dark_hand_info_list[i].end_action = true
					self.explosion_hit_list = {}
					self.dark_hand_hit_list = {}
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:shoot_radial_shot(pos)
	for i = 1, self.radial_shot_count do
		local dir = (unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, i * 360 / self.radial_shot_count, 0)
				* unity_class.vector3.forward).normalized
		self.shoot_helper:ShootDirectionAtPosition(pos, dir, i, -1, nil, false, 0.3)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if self.shoot_helper ~= nil then
		self.shoot_helper:OnHit(hit_info)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:impact_damage(pos)
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(pos, self.shot_explosion_radius)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
				fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
				lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo)
				or table_util.contain_value(self.explosion_hit_list, fo) then
		else
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier

			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			table.insert(self.explosion_hit_list, fo)
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target = nil
	self.virtual_attack_range = nil
	self.dark_hand_info_list = nil
	self.dark_hand_hit_list = nil
	self.explosion_hit_list = nil
	self.dark_hand_casting_effect = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.casting_effect_offset = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

function local_class:change_state(next_state)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

			v:Hide()

	if next_state == self.state.blink_prepare then

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.blink_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_enable_delay and self.is_enabled then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
			self.is_enabled = false
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.blink_center)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.blink_center then
		if self.time_passed >= self.blink_duration then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.is_enabled = true
			self.character.Position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.zone_bounds.center)
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare then

		if self.time_passed <= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration and not self.is_start_casting then
			if not self.instantiate_casting_effect then
				self.casting_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("casting",
						self.character.Position)
				self.casting_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
				self.instantiate_casting_effect = true
			end

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_prepare_duration))
			self.casting_effect.transform.localScale = 1 * progress * unity_class.vector3.one
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_prepare_duration then
			self.is_start_casting = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion_prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explosion)
		else
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explosion then
		if self.time_passed >= self.explosion_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.explosion_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.explosion_prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.groggy)
			end
		else
			self:cross_explosion_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.groggy then
		if self.is_start_casting then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutQuad(
					self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.casting_effect_post_duration))
			self.casting_effect.transform.localScale = (1 - progress) * unity_class.vector3.one

			if self.time_passed >= self.casting_effect_post_duration then
				self.casting_effect:Dispose()
				self.is_start_casting = false
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_prepare_duration then
			if not self.is_start_groggy_animation then
				self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("groggy")
			end
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.groggy_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cross_explosion_update(dt)
	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_calculator_list) do
		local objects = v:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Bounds.center - self.character.Bounds.center).normalized

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.explosion_damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:cross_attack_range_update()
	local center_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position, battle_util.get_height(self.target.Position))
	local height = battle_util.get_height(center_pos)

	local start_dir1 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 45, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local start_dir2 = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -45, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward
	local start_pos1 = center_pos - start_dir1 * (self.explosion_distance / 2)
	local start_pos2 = center_pos - start_dir2 * (self.explosion_distance / 2)

	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[1], start_pos1, start_dir1, height)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range_list[2], start_pos2, start_dir2, height)
	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
	if not self.is_active_explosion_attack_range then
		for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
			v:Show(self.explosion_prepare_duration)
		end
		self.is_active_explosion_attack_range = true
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range", center_pos)
	end

	self.attack_calculator_list[1].Position = center_pos
	self.attack_calculator_list[1].Direction = start_dir1
	self.attack_calculator_list[2].Position = center_pos
	self.attack_calculator_list[2].Direction = start_dir2
	self.explosion_center_pos = center_pos
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel(true)

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
		end
	end
	self.target = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.attack_calculator_list = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.casting_effect = nil
	self.explosion_center_pos = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

			self:change_state(self.state.none)

function local_class:move_hell_ball_update(dt)

		if self.hell_ball_info.passed_time <= self.hell_ball_info.life_time then
			self.hell_ball_info.passed_time = self.hell_ball_info.passed_time + dt

			self.hell_ball_info.effect_obj.transform.position = self.hell_ball_info.start_pos + self.hell_ball_info.passed_time / self.hell_ball_info.life_time * self.hell_ball_info.diff
		else

		end

	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()

function local_class:dispose()

	self.hell_ball_cast_effect = nil
	self.hell_ball_offset = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

-- 알 생성, 파괴, 부화 및 부하 몬스터 제어 일임하는 배틀액션.
local local_class = newclass('BossDarkMagicianSpawningPoolBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.egg_max_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "EggMaxCount", 10)
	self.max_monster = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "MonsterMaxCount", 6)
	self.monster_summon_time = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "MonsterSummonTime", 15)
	self.monster_handle_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "MonsterHandleName", "dark_magician_minion_")

	self.egg_pool = {}
	for i = 1, self.egg_max_count do
		local v = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
