		v.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1, 2, 1))
		v.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		v.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None
		v.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

		stage.FieldUIManager:SetUI(v, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

		table.insert(self.egg_pool, v)
	end

	self.minions = nil
	self.current_eggs = {}
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:find_minions()
	-- 소환 가능 몬스터 풀
	for i = 1, self.max_monster do
		local obj = get_character(string.format("%s%d", self.monster_handle_name, i))
		if is_unity_null(obj) then
			break
		else
			obj.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			obj.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			table.insert(self.minions, obj)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start(info)
	if self.minions == nil then
		self.minions = {}
		self:find_minions()
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	-- 몹 생성 제어
	if self.current_eggs ~= nil then
		-- 헬볼 맞고 박살난 것들 제거
		for i = #self.current_eggs, 1, -1 do
			if self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
				-- 이벤트 날렸었다면 끔
				if self.current_eggs[i].started == true then
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object))
				end

				-- 오브젝트 제거
				if not is_unity_null(self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object) then
					self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
				end
				self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object = nil

				-- 가상 오브젝트 반납
				-- self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
				table.insert(self.egg_pool, self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object)
				self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object = nil

				table.remove(self.current_eggs, i)
			end
		end

		-- 현재 활성화 된 몬스터 카운트
		local active_count = 0
		for _, minion in ipairs(self.minions) do
			if not minion.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead and stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(minion) or minion.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled then
				active_count = active_count + 1
			end
		end

		-- 풀 활성화 상태
		if active_count >= #self.minions then
			-- 타이머 돌던 것 모두 끔
			for i = 1, #self.current_eggs do
				if self.current_eggs[i].started == true then
					CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object))
					self.current_eggs[i].started = false
					self.current_eggs[i].time_passed = 0
				end
			end
		else
			-- 앞에서부터 켜줌
			local can_active_num = #self.minions - active_count
			for i = 1, #self.current_eggs do
				if i <= can_active_num then
					-- 켬
					if self.current_eggs[i].started == false then
						stage.FieldUIManager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object).transform.position = self.current_eggs[i].position
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object, self.monster_summon_time))
						self.current_eggs[i].started = true
					end
					-- 타이머 업데이트
					local time = self.current_eggs[i].time_passed + dt
					self.current_eggs[i].time_passed = time
					-- 소환
					if time >= self.monster_summon_time then
						local pos = self.current_eggs[i].position
						for _, minion in ipairs(self.minions) do
							if minion.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled and (minion.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead or not stage.BattleManager:IsCharacterInActiveBattle(minion)) then
								local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
								self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("summon", pos)
								self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("summon", pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
								minion.Position = pos
								minion.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled

								-- 힐
								local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
								heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
								heal_info.heal = minion.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
								heal_info.isRevive = true
								heal_info.sender = self.character
								heal_info.target = minion

								command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)

								-- 몬스터 노티스 이벤트를 쏴준다
								message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(minion, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))
								message_system:Send(minion.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeEvent.Create(minion, target, CS.Oak.MonsterNoticeLevel.Battle))

								break
							end
						end
						-- Disable로 바꿔서 다음 프레임에 제거 되게 함
						self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
					end
				else
					-- 끔
					if self.current_eggs[i].started == true then
						CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object))
						self.current_eggs[i].started = false
						self.current_eggs[i].time_passed = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	-- 모든 알 제거
	if self.current_eggs ~= nil then
		for i = #self.current_eggs, 1, -1 do
			-- 이벤트 날렸었다면 끔
			if self.current_eggs[i].started == true then
				CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object))
			end

			-- 오브젝트 제거
			if not is_unity_null(self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object) then
				self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object:Dispose()
			end
			self.current_eggs[i].pooled_object = nil

			-- 가상 오브젝트 반납
			self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
			table.insert(self.egg_pool, self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object)
			self.current_eggs[i].virtual_object = nil

			-- 제거
			table.remove(self.current_eggs, i)
		end
	end

	-- 모든 몬스터 강제 처치
	if self.minions ~= nil then
		for _, minion in ipairs(self.minions) do
			if not is_unity_null(minion) then
				if not minion.CharacterStatsBehaviour.IsDead then
					if CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.TypeCompareSubClassOf(minion.DamagedBehaviour, typeof(CS.Oak.MonsterDamagedBehaviour)) then
						minion.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
					else
						minion.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterConstantDamagedBehaviour()
						minion.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = false
					end

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Death
					damage_info.sender = minion
					damage_info.target = minion
					damage_info.noCritical = true
					damage_info.damage = minion.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * 10

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)

					minion.DamagedBehaviour.ShowDamageNumber = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 알 생성 싱크 커맨드 받음.
function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.current_eggs ~= nil and #self.current_eggs < self.egg_max_count and not is_unity_null(self.character) and battle_manager:GetBattleFor(self.character) then
		local t_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(info:GetPositionAt(0))
		local v_obj = table.remove(self.egg_pool)

local local_class = newclass('BossDarkMagicianTombShotBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.7)
	self.shot_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDuration", 1.5)
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", 0.2)
	self.shot_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotSpeed", 30)
	self.shot_repeat_count = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "ShotRepeatCount", 4)
	self.shot_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotKnockBackForce", 1.2)
	self.shot_damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotDamageModifier", 1.2)
	self.shot_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotRadius", 2)
	self.shot_explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotExplosionRadius", 2)
	self.enhanced = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "Enhanced", false)
	self.tomb_shot_start_height = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ShotStartHeight", 10)
	self.spawning_pool_name = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, "SpawningPoolAction", 'BossDarkMagicianSpawningPool')

	self.attack_range_list = {}
	for i = 1, 2 do
		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.shot_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
		attack_range:Hide()
		table.insert(self.attack_range_list, attack_range)
	end

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		shot = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	--내부 변수들
	self.target = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.target_info_list = {}
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self.is_start_attack_animation = false
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.attack_affer_duration = 0.3
	self.cast_effect_start_delay = 0.7
	self.cast_effect_end_delay = 0.4
	self.is_start_cast_effect = false
	self.cast_effect_offset = vector(0.64, 3, 0)
	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bounds)
	self.zone_bounds = bounds
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	-- 타겟 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character,
			self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target_list = {}
	self.target_info_list = {}

	table.insert(self.target_info_list, {
		is_start = false,
		is_start_explosion_ani = false,
		target = self.target,
		start_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		dest_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		diff = 0,
		life_time = 0,
		passed_time = 0,
		hit_list = {},
		effect_list =
		{
			tomb_shot_effect = nil,
			tomb_shot_contrail_effect = nil
		}
	})

	if self.enhanced then
		self:check_target()
	end

	self.is_start_attack_animation = false
	self.is_start_explosion_ani = false
	self.is_start_cast_effect = false
	self.current_repeat_count = 0
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:check_target()
	local target_list = stage.BattleManager:GetTargets(self.character)
	if target_list == nil then
		return
	end

	table.insert(self.target_info_list, {
		is_start = false,
		is_start_explosion_ani = false,
		target = nil,
		start_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		dest_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero,
		diff = 0,
		life_time = 0,
		passed_time = 0,
		hit_list = {},
		effect_list = {
			tomb_shot_effect = nil,
			tomb_shot_contrail_effect = nil}})

	local dist = 0
	for _, v in pairs(target_list) do
		if not v.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target_info_list[1].target, v) then
			if dist < vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position) then
				self.target_info_list[2].target = v
				dist = vector_util.distance(self.character.Position, v.Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:hide_attack_range()

	for _, v in pairs(self.target_info_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v.effect_list.tomb_shot_effect) then
			v.effect_list.tomb_shot_effect:Dispose()
		end

		if not is_unity_null(v.effect_list.tomb_shot_contrail_effect) then
			v.effect_list.tomb_shot_contrail_effect:Dispose()
		end
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.cast_effect) then
		self.cast_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		if next_state ~= self.state.shot then
			self:hide_attack_range()
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		self:hide_attack_range()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		for i = 1, #self.target_info_list do
			--target이 없을 경우 랜덤위치로 포격
			local target_pos = unity_class.vector3.zero
			if is_unity_null(self.target_info_list[i].target) then
				local get_random_pos = unity_class.random.insideUnitCircle:GetX0z()
				local zone_size = self.zone_bounds.size.x
				if self.zone_bounds.size.x < self.zone_bounds.size.z then
					zone_size = self.zone_bounds.size.z
				end
				local zone_r = zone_size / 2 - self.shot_explosion_radius
				local r = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, zone_r)
				target_pos = get_random_pos * r + self.zone_bounds.center
			else
				target_pos = self.target_info_list[i].target.Position
			end


			self.target_info_list[i].dest_pos = target_pos
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range_list[i], target_pos)
			self.attack_range_list[i]:Show(self.prepare_duration)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range_list[i]))
			self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("range", target_pos)
		end

		if not self.is_start_attack_animation then
			self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack")
			self.is_start_attack_animation = true
		end
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot_mine", nil)
	elseif next_state == self.state.shot then
		if self:is_hittable(self.character, self.target) then
			self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

			self:hide_attack_range()

			for _, v in pairs(self.target_info_list) do
				local dest_pos = v.dest_pos
				local start_pos = vector(dest_pos.x, dest_pos.y + self.tomb_shot_start_height, dest_pos.z)
				local diff = dest_pos - start_pos
				v.dest_pos = dest_pos
				v.start_pos = start_pos
				v.diff = diff
				v.life_time = diff.magnitude / self.shot_speed
				v.passed_time = 0
				v.is_start_explosion_ani = false
				v.effect_list.tomb_shot_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("tomb_shot", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				v.effect_list.tomb_shot_contrail_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("trail", start_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
				v.is_start = true
				v.hit_list = {}

				--tombshot 떨어지는 사운드
				self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("shot", dest_pos)
			end

			self.current_repeat_count = self.current_repeat_count + 1
		end
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("attack_end")
	else
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:hide_attack_range()
	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		v:Hide()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, v))
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_effect_start_delay and not self.is_start_cast_effect then
			self.cast_effect = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("cast",
					self.character.Position + self.cast_effect_offset, unity_class.vector3.zero)
			self.is_start_cast_effect = true
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.shot)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.shot then
		if self.time_passed >= self.shot_duration then
			if self.current_repeat_count < self.shot_repeat_count then
				self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
			else
				self:change_state(self.state.post)
			end
		else
			self:tombshot_update(dt)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_effect_end_delay and self.is_start_cast_effect then
			self.cast_effect:Dispose()
			self.is_start_cast_effect = false
		end
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:tombshot_update(dt)
	for _, v in pairs(self.target_info_list) do
		if v.is_start then
			v.passed_time = v.passed_time + dt

			if v.passed_time <= v.life_time  then
				v.effect_list.tomb_shot_effect.transform.position = v.start_pos + v.passed_time / v.life_time * v.diff
				v.effect_list.tomb_shot_contrail_effect.transform.position = v.start_pos + v.passed_time / v.life_time * v.diff

			elseif v.passed_time - v.life_time <= self.attack_duration then
				if not v.is_start_explosion_ani then
					v.effect_list.tomb_shot_effect:Dispose()
					v.effect_list.tomb_shot_contrail_effect:Dispose()
					local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.spawning_pool_name, v.dest_pos)
					command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("explosion", v.dest_pos, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					v.is_start_explosion_ani = true

					--tombshot 폭발 사운드
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("explosion", v.dest_pos)
				end
				local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(v.dest_pos, self.shot_explosion_radius)

				for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
					if not CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) or
							fo.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead or
							lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo) or table_util.contain_value(v.hit_list, fo) then
					else
						local dmg_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(fo.Position - v.dest_pos).normalized

						if dmg_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
							dmg_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(fo.Direction)
						end

						local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
						damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
						damage_info.sender = self.character
						damage_info.target = fo
						damage_info.direction = dmg_dir
						damage_info.modifier = self.shot_damage_modifier
						damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
						damage_info.knockBackDirection = dmg_dir
						damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.shot_knock_back_force

						command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
						table.insert(v.hit_list, fo)
					end
				end
				fo_list:Dispose()
			elseif v.passed_time >= self.shot_duration - 0.7 then
				v.is_start = false
				v.is_start_explosion_ani = false
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	for _, v in pairs(self.attack_range_list) do
		if not is_unity_null(v) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(v)
		end
	end
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.target = nil
	self.target_position = nil
	self.attack_range_list = nil
	self.target_list = nil
	self.target_position_list = nil
	self.zone_bounds = nil
	self.cast_effect = nil
	self.cast_effect_offset = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('BossDreamerDreamFogBattleAction')

local fog_class = {
	cs_action = nil,
	character = nil,
	cs_battle_action = nil,

	coll_info = nil,
	calc = nil,
}
fog_class.mt = { __index = fog_class }

function fog_class:new(cs_action, c, cs_battle_action, safe_max, safe_min, dur, shrink_dur, d_term, d_mod)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)

	obj.cs_action = cs_action
	obj.character = c
	obj.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		act = 2,
	}

	self.r_max = safe_max
	self.r_min = safe_min

	self.duration = dur
	self.shrink_duration = shrink_dur

	self.damage_modifier = d_mod

	local info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(20, 1, dur, d_term, safe_max)
	obj.coll_info = info
	obj.calc = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(c, info)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	return obj
end

function fog_class:trigger()
	return self.current_state ~= nil and self.current_state == self.state.none
end

function fog_class:start(pos)
	self.position = pos
	self.curr_safe_r = self.r_max
	self:change_state(self.state.act)
end

function fog_class:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state == next_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.act then
		self.calc:End()
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('disappear', self.character.Position)
	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.act then
		self.calc:Start()
		-- fx_fog dispose는 타임리밋으로 자동으로 됨
		-- but 이벤트로 clear 요청 올수도 있으니 이렇게
		self.fx_fog = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('fog', self.position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('appear', self.character.Position)
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function fog_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.act then
		self:publish_damage(dt)

		if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function fog_class:publish_damage(dt)
	local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(self.time_passed, 0, 1, self.shrink_duration)
	self.curr_safe_r = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.r_max, self.r_min, progress)

	self.coll_info.HoleRadius = self.curr_safe_r
	self.calc.Position = self.position

	if self.fx_fog ~= nil then
		local scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.r_max, self.r_min, progress) / self.r_max
		self.fx_fog.transform.localScale = vector_util.one * scale
		CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.UpdateObject(self.fx_fog, self.position)
	end

	local objects = self.calc:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for _, fo in pairs(objects) do
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_dreamer_hit_01')
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function fog_class:dispose_fx(fx)
	if fx == nil then
		return
	end

	fx:Dispose()
	fx = nil
end

function fog_class:cancel()
	self:dispose_fx(self.fx_fog)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
	}

	-- preapre
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.2)

	-- action
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 0.6)
	self.fog_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'FogDuration', 6.0)
	self.shrink_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ShrinkDuration', 2.0)
	self.safezone_radius_max = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SafezoneRadiusMax', 5.0)
	self.safezone_radius_min = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SafezoneRadiusmin', 2.0)

	self.damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.8)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1.0)

	local main = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 183 , 121, 51)
	local outline = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 192 , 140, 153)
	local overlay_main = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 188 , 133, 128)
	local overlay_outline = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 188 , 133, 0)

	self.safe_ar = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.safezone_radius_max,
			main, outline, overlay_main, overlay_outline, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.fog_holder = fog_class:new(self, c, cs_battle_action, self.safezone_radius_max, self.safezone_radius_min,
			self.fog_duration, self.shrink_duration, self.damage_term, self.damage_modifier)

	-- post
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.0)

	-- init
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.on_custom_stage_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_custom_event(e)	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return not is_unity_null(target)
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithTarget(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, target)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)
	self.target = target
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.safe_ar:Hide()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

	end

	-- enter
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('prepare')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('prepare', self.character.Position)

		self:set_start_pos(self.target.Position)
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.safe_ar, self.fog_pos)
		self.safe_ar:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		if self.fog_holder:trigger() then
			self.fog_holder:start(self.fog_pos)
		end

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.fog_holder:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_start_pos(pos)
	if self.tl_bound:Contains(pos) then
		self.fog_pos = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and self.tr_bound.center or self.bl_bound.center

	elseif self.tr_bound:Contains(pos) then
		self.fog_pos = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and self.tl_bound.center or self.br_bound.center

	elseif self.bl_bound:Contains(pos) then
		self.fog_pos = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and self.tl_bound.center or self.br_bound.center

	else
		self.fog_pos = random_util.get_random_value() < 0.5 and self.tr_bound.center or self.bl_bound.center
	end
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	if self.on_custom_stage_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), self.on_custom_stage_event_func)
		self.on_custom_stage_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'boss_dreamer_clear_action' then
		self.fog_holder:cancel()
	end
end

function local_class:set_battle_zone(bound)
	self.zone_bound = bound

	local size = vector(bound.size.x / 2, bound.size.y, bound.size.z / 2)
	local cx = bound.center.x
	local cy = bound.center.y
	local cz = bound.center.z
	local xoff = bound.size.x / 4
	local zoff = bound.size.z / 4
	self.tl_bound = unity_class.bounds(vector(cx - xoff, cy, cz + zoff), size)
	self.tr_bound = unity_class.bounds(vector(cx + xoff, cy, cz + zoff), size)
	self.bl_bound = unity_class.bounds(vector(cx - xoff, cy, cz - zoff), size)
	self.br_bound = unity_class.bounds(vector(cx + xoff, cy, cz - zoff), size)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}
